ex.en: The test results were inconclusive.
ex.zh: 檢驗結果沒有定論。

ex.en: After hours of discussion, the meeting was inconclusive.
ex.zh: 討論了好幾個小時，會議仍沒有結論。

inconclusive.en: not giving a clear result or final answer

ex.en: My friend is designing a user interface for the new operating system.
ex.zh: 我朋友正在為新的作業系統設計使用者介面。

ex.en: I didn't like the interface of that operating system.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡那個作業系統的介面。

ex.en: The interface of this website is somewhat pedestrian, but it’s simple.
ex.zh: 這個網站的介面沒什麼新意，但很簡潔。

interface.en: the screen or controls a person uses to work with a computer

ex.en: The brand paid an influencer to promote its new shoes.
ex.zh: 這個品牌付錢請網紅宣傳新鞋。

ex.en: Many teens want to become influencers.
ex.zh: 很多青少年想當網紅。

influencer.en: a person with many followers online who affects what they buy

ex.en: What can we infer from these sales figures?
ex.zh: 我們從這些銷售數字可以推斷出什麼？

ex.en: I inferred from his tone that he was unhappy.
ex.zh: 我從他的語氣推斷他不太高興。

ex.en: Readers can infer the writer's opinion from the last paragraph.
ex.zh: 讀者可以從最後一段推斷出作者的看法。

infer.en: to decide that something is true from the facts you have

ex.en: We can draw an inference from the survey results.
ex.zh: 我們可以從調查結果得出推論。

ex.en: His inference was based on limited data.
ex.zh: 他的推論是根據有限的資料。

inference.en: a conclusion you reach from facts or signs

ex.en: My driving instructor says I should be more patient.
ex.zh: 我的駕訓班教練說我應該更有耐心一點。

ex.en: I know an English language instructor who comes from Canada.
ex.zh: 我認識一位從加拿大來的英文講師。

ex.en: The yoga instructor showed us a new pose.
ex.zh: 瑜伽老師教我們一個新的姿勢。

instructor.en: a person who teaches a practical skill or subject

ex.en: Peas and carrots are common ingredients in soups.
ex.zh: 豌豆和紅蘿蔔是湯裡常見的食材。

ex.en: He added another ingredient to the pot.
ex.zh: 他又往鍋裡加了一種食材。

ex.en: Mix the ingredients well.
ex.zh: 把材料充分攪拌均勻。

ingredient.en: one of the foods or parts used to make a dish or product

ex.en: Trust is a key ingredient of good teamwork.
ex.zh: 信任是良好團隊合作的關鍵要素。

ex.en: Hard work is the main ingredient of success.
ex.zh: 努力是成功的主要因素。

ingredient.en: an important part that helps make something happen

ex.en: Nancy enjoys indoor games.
ex.zh: 南希喜歡室內遊戲。

ex.en: The hotel has an indoor pool and a gym.
ex.zh: 這家飯店有室內游泳池和健身房。

ex.en: Indoor smoking is not allowed in this building.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓禁止在室內吸菸。

indoor.en: happening or used inside a building

ex.en: This is an innovative solution.
ex.zh: 這是個創新的解決辦法。

ex.en: The company is known for its innovative products.
ex.zh: 這家公司以創新產品聞名。

ex.en: We need more innovative ideas for the campaign.
ex.zh: 這次活動我們需要更多創新的點子。

innovative.en: using new and clever ideas or methods

ex.en: She had the courage to go and inquire about the results of the exam.
ex.zh: 她鼓起勇氣去詢問考試結果。

ex.en: "How long does it take to get to Vienna on foot?" he inquired.
ex.zh: 「走路到維也納要多久？」他問。

ex.en: I'm calling to inquire about the job opening.
ex.zh: 我打電話來詢問這個職缺。

ex.en: The committee inquired into the cause of the accident.
ex.zh: 委員會調查了事故原因。

ex.en: They are inquiring into the matter.
ex.zh: 他們正在調查這件事。

inquire.en: to study a matter carefully to find out the facts

ex.en: She was asked to write her name in ink.
ex.zh: 她被要求用墨水筆寫下名字。

ex.en: My ballpoint pen just ran out of ink.
ex.zh: 我的原子筆剛好沒水了。

ex.en: The sale prices are written in red ink.
ex.zh: 特價用紅色墨水標示。

ink.en: coloured liquid used for writing or printing

ex.en: Installation of the software takes about ten minutes.
ex.zh: 安裝這個軟體大約需要十分鐘。

ex.en: The price includes delivery and installation.
ex.zh: 價格包含運送和安裝。

installation.en: the act of putting equipment or software in place so it can be used

ex.en: Is this community safe? Are there lighting installations for the night?
ex.zh: 這個社區安全嗎？晚上有照明設施嗎？

ex.en: The museum is showing a new art installation.
ex.zh: 美術館正在展出一件新的裝置藝術。

installation.en: a piece of equipment fixed in a place, or a work of art made for a space

ex.en: Incomplete applications will not be accepted.
ex.zh: 資料不全的申請將不予受理。

ex.en: The report is still incomplete.
ex.zh: 這份報告還沒完成。

ex.en: Your address is incomplete, so the package was returned.
ex.zh: 你的地址不完整，所以包裹被退回了。

incomplete.en: not having all its parts, or not finished

ex.en: Tom is a tax inspector.
ex.zh: 湯姆是稅務稽查員。

ex.en: A safety inspector visited the factory today.
ex.zh: 今天有安全檢查員來工廠稽查。

ex.en: The health inspector checked the restaurant kitchen.
ex.zh: 衛生稽查員檢查了餐廳的廚房。

inspector.en: a person whose job is to check that things are correct or safe

ex.en: I applied for a summer internship.
ex.zh: 我申請了一份暑期實習。

ex.en: I am writing my internship report.
ex.zh: 我正在寫實習報告。

ex.en: She did an internship at a marketing firm.
ex.zh: 她在一家行銷公司實習過。

internship.en: a short job where a student or beginner learns work skills

ex.en: Please don't interrupt me while I'm talking.
ex.zh: 我說話的時候請你不要插嘴。

ex.en: Tom interrupted our conversation.
ex.zh: 湯姆打斷了我們的談話。

ex.en: Excuse me for interrupting you, but would you mind opening the window?
ex.zh: 抱歉打擾一下，可以麻煩你開個窗嗎？

interrupt.en: to stop someone who is speaking or working by saying or doing something

ex.en: The meeting was interrupted by a fire alarm.
ex.zh: 會議被火災警報打斷了。

ex.en: The power cut interrupted our internet service.
ex.zh: 停電使我們的網路服務中斷。

interrupt.en: to make something stop for a time

ex.en: You may incur extra charges for late payment.
ex.zh: 逾期付款可能會產生額外費用。

ex.en: The company incurred heavy losses last year.
ex.zh: 公司去年蒙受了重大虧損。

incur.en: to have to pay for or suffer something bad because of your actions

ex.en: Please do as they have instructed you.
ex.zh: 請照他們指示你的去做。

ex.en: The manager instructed us to finish the report today.
ex.zh: 經理指示我們今天完成報告。

instruct.en: to tell someone what they must do

ex.en: She instructs new employees in safety procedures.
ex.zh: 她負責教新進員工安全程序。

ex.en: The trainer instructed us on how to use the software.
ex.zh: 講師教我們如何使用這套軟體。

instruct.en: to teach someone a subject or skill

ex.en: His mistakes were due to inexperience.
ex.zh: 他的錯誤是因為缺乏經驗。

ex.en: Despite her inexperience, she handled the client well.
ex.zh: 雖然她經驗不足，卻把客戶處理得很好。

inexperience.en: a lack of knowledge or skill from not having done something before

ex.en: Do you know if there's an inexpensive hotel near here?
ex.zh: 你知道這附近有便宜的旅館嗎？

ex.en: Everyone says the food in this restaurant is both delicious and inexpensive.
ex.zh: 大家都說這家餐廳的菜又好吃又便宜。

ex.en: This is an inexpensive way to advertise.
ex.zh: 這是一種花費不高的廣告方式。

ex.en: The meeting will be informal, so wear whatever you like.
ex.zh: 這場會議很輕鬆，穿什麼都可以。

ex.en: We had an informal chat over coffee.
ex.zh: 我們邊喝咖啡邊隨意聊了聊。

informal.en: relaxed and not following strict rules

ex.en: This word is too informal for a business email.
ex.zh: 這個字用在商務電子郵件裡太口語了。

ex.en: Use informal language with friends, not with clients.
ex.zh: 跟朋友可以用口語，跟客戶就不行。

informal.en: suitable for everyday speech rather than serious writing

ex.en: Some people felt that Tom's behavior was inappropriate.
ex.zh: 有些人覺得湯姆的行為不太恰當。

ex.en: Tom's comment was inappropriate.
ex.zh: 湯姆的評論不恰當。

ex.en: That's totally inappropriate.
ex.zh: 這完全不恰當。

inappropriate.en: not suitable or right for a situation

ex.en: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.
ex.zh: 網路是非常寶貴的資訊來源。

ex.en: Connecting a PC to the internet isn't rocket science.
ex.zh: 把電腦連上網路並不難。

ex.en: Is there free internet in the hotel?
ex.zh: 飯店有免費網路嗎？

internet.en: the worldwide system that connects computers so people can share information

informative.zh: 提供有用資訊的、內容充實的

ex.en: This is a very informative article.
ex.zh: 這是一篇內容很充實的文章。

ex.en: The seminar was very informative.
ex.zh: 這場研討會讓人獲益良多。

informative.en: giving a lot of useful facts

ex.en: A new classroom building was built in our institute last year.
ex.zh: 去年我們學院蓋了一棟新的教學大樓。

ex.en: He works at a research institute in Taipei.
ex.zh: 他在台北一間研究機構工作。

institute.en: an organization for study, research or teaching

ex.en: The company instituted a new dress code.
ex.zh: 公司實施了新的服裝規定。

ex.en: The city will institute new parking rules.
ex.zh: 市政府將實施新的停車規定。

institute.en: to start a new rule, system or plan

ex.en: Your intonation sounds very natural.
ex.zh: 你的語調聽起來很自然。

ex.en: Intonation can change the meaning of a sentence.
ex.zh: 語調會改變一句話的意思。

intonation.en: the way the voice rises and falls when speaking

ex.en: The washing machine is a wonderful invention.
ex.zh: 洗衣機是一項很棒的發明。

ex.en: Language is one of man's most important inventions.
ex.zh: 語言是人類最重要的發明之一。

ex.en: The invention of the transistor marked a new era.
ex.zh: 電晶體的發明開啟了一個新時代。

invention.en: a new thing that someone has made, or the act of making it

ex.en: The price is inclusive of tax.
ex.zh: 價格已含稅。

ex.en: The rate is inclusive of breakfast.
ex.zh: 房價包含早餐。

inclusive.en: counting everything in the price or amount

inclusive.zh: 包容的、不排斥任何人的

ex.en: We want to create an inclusive workplace.
ex.zh: 我們希望打造一個包容的職場。

ex.en: The school has an inclusive policy for all students.
ex.zh: 這所學校對所有學生採取包容的政策。

inclusive.en: welcoming all kinds of people and not leaving anyone out

ex.en: There is insufficient light to take pictures.
ex.zh: 光線不足，沒辦法拍照。

ex.en: Your payment failed due to insufficient funds.
ex.zh: 因餘額不足，你的付款失敗了。

ex.en: There is insufficient evidence to support the claim.
ex.zh: 沒有足夠的證據支持這個說法。

ex.en: I'm taking an introductory course in accounting.
ex.zh: 我正在上會計入門課。

ex.en: The book begins with an introductory chapter.
ex.zh: 這本書以一個導論章節開頭。

introductory.en: made for people who are just beginning to learn something

ex.en: New members get an introductory discount of 20 percent.
ex.zh: 新會員可享八折的入會優惠。

ex.en: The introductory price is only available this month.
ex.zh: 首賣優惠價只到這個月。

introductory.en: offered at a special low price when something is first sold

ex.en: He is very influential in the world of medicine.
ex.zh: 他在醫學界很有影響力。

ex.en: He has a lot of influential friends.
ex.zh: 他有很多有影響力的朋友。

ex.en: She is one of the most influential designers in Asia.
ex.zh: 她是亞洲最有影響力的設計師之一。

influential.en: having a strong effect on what people think or do

ex.en: Sales growth is a key indicator of success.
ex.zh: 銷售成長是成功的關鍵指標。

ex.en: Unemployment is an important economic indicator.
ex.zh: 失業率是重要的經濟指標。

indicator.en: a sign or number that shows how something is going

ex.en: The battery indicator turned red.
ex.zh: 電池指示燈變紅了。

ex.en: Check the fuel indicator before you leave.
ex.zh: 出發前先看一下油量指示。

indicator.en: a light or device that shows the state of a machine

ex.en: The teacher spoke to each student individually.
ex.zh: 老師和每位學生個別談話。

ex.en: Each item is individually wrapped.
ex.zh: 每件商品都是單獨包裝的。

ex.en: The brand is known internationally.
ex.zh: 這個品牌享譽國際。

ex.en: Our products are sold internationally.
ex.zh: 我們的產品銷往世界各地。

internationally.en: in many countries around the world

ex.en: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.
ex.zh: 網際網路是極為寶貴的資訊來源。

ex.en: His help has been invaluable.
ex.zh: 他的幫忙真的非常寶貴。

ex.en: Your advice has been invaluable to me.
ex.zh: 你的建議對我來說非常寶貴。

ex.en: Tom is inflating a balloon.
ex.zh: 湯姆在吹氣球。

ex.en: Please inflate the tires before the trip.
ex.zh: 出發前請先把輪胎打氣。

inflate.en: to fill something with air or gas so that it gets bigger

ex.en: The figures were inflated to impress investors.
ex.zh: 這些數字被灌水，好讓投資人印象深刻。

ex.en: Hotels inflate their prices during the holidays.
ex.zh: 飯店在假期期間會哄抬價格。

inflate.en: to make a price or number seem higher than it really is

ex.en: This is an automated payphone; you use it by inserting a coin.
ex.zh: 這是自動投幣電話，投入硬幣就能使用。

ex.en: Insert your card into the machine.
ex.zh: 把卡片插入機器。

ex.en: Click here to insert a picture.
ex.zh: 點這裡插入圖片。

insert.en: to put one thing inside another

integral.zh: 不可或缺的、構成整體所必需的

ex.en: Customer feedback is an integral part of our process.
ex.zh: 客戶回饋是我們流程中不可或缺的一部分。

ex.en: She played an integral role in the project.
ex.zh: 她在這個專案中扮演了關鍵角色。

integral.en: being a necessary part of a whole

ex.en: The museum has many interactive exhibits.
ex.zh: 博物館有許多互動式展覽。

ex.en: Our English classes are small and interactive.
ex.zh: 我們的英文課是小班互動式教學。

interactive.en: letting people take part and get a response

ex.en: Don't interfere with matters that do not concern you!
ex.zh: 別插手不關你的事！

ex.en: You have no right to interfere in other people's affairs.
ex.zh: 你沒有權利干涉別人的事。

ex.en: My parents never interfere in my decisions.
ex.zh: 我爸媽從不干涉我的決定。

interfere.en: to get involved in something that is not your business

ex.en: Noises interfered with my studying.
ex.zh: 噪音妨礙了我讀書。

ex.en: Don't let your hobbies interfere with your work.
ex.zh: 別讓你的嗜好影響到工作。

ex.en: Using a phone may interfere with the plane's equipment.
ex.zh: 使用手機可能會干擾飛機的設備。

interfere.en: to stop something from going well or working properly

ex.en: The new policy will have an indirect effect on prices.
ex.zh: 新政策會對價格產生間接影響。

ex.en: We took an indirect route to avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 我們繞路以避開車潮。

indirect.en: not happening directly, or not going straight to the point

ex.en: He gave me an indirect answer.
ex.zh: 他給了我一個不直接的回答。

ex.en: Some cultures prefer an indirect style of communication.
ex.zh: 有些文化偏好委婉的溝通方式。

indirect.en: not saying something in a clear and direct way

ex.en: She has a strong wish to work as an interpreter.
ex.zh: 她非常想當口譯員。

ex.en: He is an interpreter in an international bank.
ex.zh: 他是一家國際銀行的口譯員。

ex.en: My uncle made me serve as interpreter.
ex.zh: 我叔叔要我當翻譯。

interpreter.en: a person who says in another language what a speaker says

ex.en: GCC is a compiler while Python is an interpreter.
ex.zh: GCC 是編譯器，而 Python 是直譯器。

ex.en: The interpreter runs the code line by line.
ex.zh: 直譯器會逐行執行程式碼。

interpreter.en: a program that reads and runs computer code line by line

incoming.zh: 進來的、傳入的（來電、郵件等）

ex.en: I have an incoming call, so I'll call you back.
ex.zh: 我有來電，晚點再回你電話。

ex.en: The system blocks incoming emails from unknown senders.
ex.zh: 系統會阻擋來自不明寄件者的郵件。

ex.en: The incoming CEO will start in May.
ex.zh: 新任執行長將於五月上任。

ex.en: The incoming students arrive next week.
ex.zh: 新生下週報到。

incoming.en: about to take a job or position

ex.en: What is your greatest source of inspiration?
ex.zh: 你最大的靈感來源是什麼？

ex.en: After climbing Mt. Fuji, I got the inspiration for a poem.
ex.zh: 爬完富士山後，我得到了寫一首詩的靈感。

ex.en: My inspiration has run dry.
ex.zh: 我的靈感枯竭了。

inspiration.en: a sudden good idea or a feeling that makes you want to create something

ex.en: My mother was an angel and an inspiration to me.
ex.zh: 我的母親是個天使，也是激勵我的人。

ex.en: Her courage is an inspiration to us all.
ex.zh: 她的勇氣鼓舞了我們所有人。

inspiration.en: a person or thing that makes others want to do their best

ex.en: The students listened intently to the speaker.
ex.zh: 學生們專心聽講者說話。

ex.en: He stared intently at the screen.
ex.zh: 他目不轉睛地盯著螢幕。

intently.en: with full attention and without looking away

ex.en: It is inefficient of you.
ex.zh: 你們的效率太低了。

ex.en: The old system is slow and inefficient.
ex.zh: 舊系統又慢又沒效率。

ex.en: Inefficient processes waste time and money.
ex.zh: 沒效率的流程浪費時間和金錢。

ex.en: My insurer paid for the repairs.
ex.zh: 我的保險公司支付了修理費。

ex.en: Contact your insurer after the accident.
ex.zh: 事故發生後，請聯絡你的保險公司。

insurer.en: a company that pays you money if something bad happens to your property or health

infrastructure.zh: 基礎建設；（資訊系統的）基礎架構

ex.en: The infrastructure of an application is directly related to its overall performance.
ex.zh: 應用程式的架構直接影響它的整體效能。

ex.en: The government plans to invest in public infrastructure.
ex.zh: 政府計畫投資公共基礎建設。

ex.en: Our IT infrastructure needs an upgrade.
ex.zh: 我們的資訊基礎架構需要升級。

infrastructure.en: the basic systems, such as roads, power or networks, that a place or business needs

ex.en: The integration of the two systems took six months.
ex.zh: 兩套系統的整合花了六個月。

ex.en: The app offers integration with your calendar.
ex.zh: 這個應用程式可以和你的行事曆整合。

integration.en: the act of joining things together, or of becoming part of a group

interval.zh: （時間的）間隔；at intervals 每隔一段時間

ex.en: The Olympic Games take place at intervals of four years.
ex.zh: 奧運每四年舉辦一次。

ex.en: There was a long interval before he replied.
ex.zh: 隔了好一段時間他才回答。

ex.en: It's best to go to the dentist at regular intervals.
ex.zh: 最好定期去看牙醫。

interval.en: a period of time between two events

ex.en: The country saw a large inflow of foreign investment.
ex.zh: 這個國家湧入大量外資。

ex.en: We need a steady inflow of cash.
ex.zh: 我們需要穩定的現金流入。

inflow.en: the movement of money or people into a place

ex.en: According to an industry insider, prices will rise.
ex.zh: 根據一位業內人士的說法，價格將會上漲。

ex.en: He was charged with insider trading.
ex.zh: 他被控內線交易。

insider.en: a person who belongs to a group and knows things outsiders do not

ex.en: Brand value is an intangible asset.
ex.zh: 品牌價值是一種無形資產。

ex.en: The job offers many intangible benefits.
ex.zh: 這份工作有許多無形的好處。

intangible.en: not able to be touched, but still having value

ex.en: She was appointed interim CEO.
ex.zh: 她被任命為代理執行長。

ex.en: The company released its interim report.
ex.zh: 公司發布了期中報告。

interim.en: lasting only for a short time until something permanent is ready

ex.en: The new manager starts in May; in the interim, I'll handle it.
ex.zh: 新經理五月到任，在那之前由我處理。

ex.en: In the interim, please use the old system.
ex.zh: 在此期間，請先使用舊系統。

ex.en: That wasn't my intent.
ex.zh: 那不是我的本意。

ex.en: The intent of the new policy is to reduce costs.
ex.zh: 新政策的目的是降低成本。

intent.en: the thing you plan or want to do

intent.zh: 專注的；一心想要（be intent on）

ex.en: She was intent on finishing the report by Friday.
ex.zh: 她一心想在週五前完成報告。

ex.en: He seemed intent on winning the contract.
ex.zh: 他似乎下定決心要拿下這份合約。

intent.en: giving all your attention to something, or being very determined to do it

ex.en: We signed a letter of intent with the supplier.
ex.zh: 我們和供應商簽了意向書。

ex.en: A letter of intent is usually not legally binding.
ex.zh: 意向書通常不具法律約束力。

intent.en: a written statement saying that people plan to make an agreement

ex.en: The company initiated a new training program.
ex.zh: 公司啟動了一項新的培訓計畫。

ex.en: Who initiated the conversation?
ex.zh: 是誰先開口的？

ex.en: Click here to initiate the download.
ex.zh: 點這裡開始下載。

ex.en: He was interred in the family grave.
ex.zh: 他被安葬在家族墓地。

ex.en: The soldiers were interred in a national cemetery.
ex.zh: 那些士兵安葬在國家公墓。

inter.en: to put a dead body into the ground in a formal way

ex.en: Nothing could induce me to sign that contract.
ex.zh: 無論如何我都不會簽那份合約。

ex.en: Lower prices may induce customers to buy more.
ex.zh: 降價可能促使顧客買更多。

induce.en: to persuade someone to do something

ex.en: This medicine may induce sleepiness.
ex.zh: 這種藥可能會引起嗜睡。

ex.en: Stress can induce headaches.
ex.zh: 壓力可能導致頭痛。

ex.en: Income inequality has increased in many countries.
ex.zh: 很多國家的所得不均都在擴大。

ex.en: The report highlights gender inequality in the workplace.
ex.zh: 這份報告突顯職場上的性別不平等。

inequality.en: a situation where some people have more than others in an unfair way

ex.en: I took an intensive English course last summer.
ex.zh: 我去年夏天上了英文密集班。

ex.en: The project requires intensive training.
ex.zh: 這個專案需要密集訓練。

intensive.en: involving a lot of work or effort in a short time

intensive.zh: intensive care：加護病房；重症照護

ex.en: He's in intensive care.
ex.zh: 他在加護病房。

ex.en: The patient was moved out of intensive care.
ex.zh: 病人已經轉出加護病房了。

intensive.en: hospital treatment for people who are very seriously ill

ex.en: The troubles of life are inevitable.
ex.zh: 人生的煩惱在所難免。

ex.en: Their meeting was inevitable.
ex.zh: 他們的相遇是必然的。

ex.en: Some delays are inevitable in large projects.
ex.zh: 大型專案難免會有些延誤。

inevitable.en: certain to happen and impossible to stop

ex.en: The bank acts as an intermediary between buyers and sellers.
ex.zh: 銀行在買賣雙方之間扮演中間人的角色。

ex.en: We negotiated through an intermediary.
ex.zh: 我們透過中間人進行協商。

intermediary.en: a person or group that helps two sides reach an agreement

incremental.zh: 逐步增加的、漸進的；額外增加的

ex.en: We made incremental improvements to the product.
ex.zh: 我們對產品做了漸進式的改良。

ex.en: Incremental changes are easier to manage.
ex.zh: 逐步的改變比較容易管理。

ex.en: The new service brought in incremental revenue.
ex.zh: 新服務帶來了額外營收。

incremental.en: growing by small steps or amounts

ex.en: She is a woman of great integrity.
ex.zh: 她是非常正直的人。

ex.en: Integrity is important in business.
ex.zh: 誠信在商場上很重要。

integrity.en: the quality of being honest and following strong moral rules

ex.en: The software checks the integrity of the data.
ex.zh: 軟體會檢查資料的完整性。

ex.en: The building's structural integrity was tested.
ex.zh: 這棟建築的結構安全經過檢測。

integrity.en: the state of being whole and not damaged

ex.en: In addition, coincidences inevitably come in threes.
ex.zh: 此外，巧合總是接二連三地發生。

ex.en: Prices will inevitably rise.
ex.zh: 物價必然會上漲。

ex.en: Inevitably, some customers were unhappy.
ex.zh: 難免有些顧客不滿意。

inevitably.en: in a way that cannot be avoided

info.zh: 資訊、資料（information 的口語縮寫）

ex.en: John kept gathering info.
ex.zh: 約翰一直在蒐集資訊。

ex.en: For more info, visit our website.
ex.zh: 想了解更多資訊，請上我們的網站。

info.en: facts about something, in a short and informal form

ex.en: The certificate of incorporation was issued last week.
ex.zh: 公司設立登記證明上週核發了。

ex.en: The incorporation of the company took a month.
ex.zh: 公司登記花了一個月。

incorporation.en: the legal process of forming a company

ex.en: The incorporation of user feedback improved the design.
ex.zh: 納入使用者回饋讓設計變得更好。

ex.en: We discussed the incorporation of new features.
ex.zh: 我們討論了加入新功能的事。

incorporation.en: the act of making something a part of something larger

ex.en: Insect invasions can destroy entire crops.
ex.zh: 蟲害入侵可能毀掉整片農作物。

ex.en: The island has a long history of foreign invasion.
ex.zh: 這座島長期遭受外來侵略。

invasion.en: the act of entering a place by force to take control of it

ex.en: Reading my messages is an invasion of privacy.
ex.zh: 看我的訊息是侵犯隱私。

ex.en: Customers see such calls as an invasion of their privacy.
ex.zh: 顧客認為這種電話侵犯了他們的隱私。

invasion.en: the act of entering a place or area where you are not wanted

ex.en: The job's intrinsic rewards matter more to me than money.
ex.zh: 對我來說，這份工作本身帶來的成就感比錢更重要。

ex.en: Trust is intrinsic to a good relationship.
ex.zh: 信任是良好關係的根本。

intrinsic.en: belonging to the true nature of something

ex.en: You should interact with the local culture more, to better understand some traditions.
ex.zh: 你應該多接觸當地文化，才能更了解一些傳統。

ex.en: The app lets users interact with each other in real time.
ex.zh: 這個 App 讓使用者能即時互動。

ex.en: Our teacher encourages us to interact in English.
ex.zh: 老師鼓勵我們用英文交流。

interact.en: to talk or work with other people

ex.en: Some medicines can interact with alcohol.
ex.zh: 有些藥物會和酒精產生交互作用。

ex.en: We are studying how these two chemicals interact.
ex.zh: 我們正在研究這兩種化學物質如何相互作用。

ex.en: We must intervene.
ex.zh: 我們必須介入。

ex.en: The manager had to intervene in the argument between two staff members.
ex.zh: 經理不得不出面調停兩位員工的爭執。

ex.en: The central bank may intervene to stabilize the currency.
ex.zh: 央行可能會進場干預以穩定匯率。

intervene.en: to step into a situation in order to change or stop it

inherent.zh: 固有的、內在的、與生俱來的

ex.en: She has inherent dignity.
ex.zh: 她有與生俱來的尊嚴。

ex.en: We must never forget the inherent value of every human being.
ex.zh: 我們絕不能忘記每個人與生俱來的價值。

ex.en: Every investment has some inherent risk.
ex.zh: 每一項投資都有其固有的風險。

inherent.en: existing as a natural and permanent part of something

ex.en: The parking space is inadequate for so many visitors.
ex.zh: 停車位不夠容納這麼多訪客。

ex.en: His salary is inadequate to support his family.
ex.zh: 他的薪水不足以養家。

inadequate.en: not enough, or not good enough

inadequate.zh: （覺得自己）能力不足的、不稱職的

ex.en: I felt inadequate compared to my talented colleagues.
ex.zh: 和能幹的同事相比，我覺得自己能力不足。

ex.en: Nobody should be made to feel inadequate at work.
ex.zh: 不該讓任何人在工作上覺得自己不夠好。

inadequate.en: feeling that you are not good enough

ex.en: The new product was an instant success.
ex.zh: 新產品一推出就大獲成功。

ex.en: Online banking gives you instant access to your account.
ex.zh: 網路銀行讓你隨時可以查看帳戶。

ex.en: I had instant noodles as a midnight snack.
ex.zh: 我宵夜吃了泡麵。

ex.en: If you drink instant coffee you do not need a coffee pot.
ex.zh: 如果你喝即溶咖啡，就不需要咖啡壺。

instant.en: made quickly, usually by adding hot water

ex.en: Right at that instant, the bus stopped.
ex.zh: 就在那一刻，公車停了下來。

ex.en: I'll be back in an instant.
ex.zh: 我馬上回來。

instant.en: a very short period of time

ex.en: The new law will indirectly affect small businesses.
ex.zh: 新法會間接影響到小型企業。

ex.en: She indirectly suggested that I should leave.
ex.zh: 她拐彎抹角地暗示我該走了。

indirectly.en: in a way that is not direct

ex.en: She learned to work independently.
ex.zh: 她學會了獨立作業。

ex.en: Each team works independently.
ex.zh: 每個團隊各自獨立運作。

independently.en: without help or control from others

independently.zh: 各自分別地；由第三方（獨立）

ex.en: Two scientists made the same discovery independently.
ex.zh: 兩位科學家各自獨立地有了相同的發現。

ex.en: The results were independently verified.
ex.zh: 這些結果經過第三方獨立驗證。

independently.en: separately, with no link between the people involved

ex.en: My level in English is intermediate.
ex.zh: 我的英文程度是中級。

ex.en: This course is designed for intermediate learners.
ex.zh: 這門課是為中級程度的學習者設計的。

intermediate.en: at a middle level between beginner and advanced

ex.en: There are several intermediate steps in the process.
ex.zh: 這個流程中間還有好幾個步驟。

ex.en: The product goes through an intermediate stage before packaging.
ex.zh: 產品在包裝前會經過一個中間階段。

intermediate.en: coming between two other things or stages

ex.en: John inherited a large fortune.
ex.zh: 約翰繼承了一大筆財產。

ex.en: What did Tom inherit?
ex.zh: 湯姆繼承了什麼？

inherit.en: to receive money or things from someone who has died

inherit.zh: 遺傳；接手（前任留下的事物）

ex.en: She inherited her mother's blue eyes.
ex.zh: 她遺傳了媽媽的藍眼睛。

ex.en: The new manager inherited many problems from his predecessor.
ex.zh: 新經理從前任那裡接手了許多問題。

inherit.en: to get a quality from your parents, or to take over something from a person before you

ex.en: Is Tom infected?
ex.zh: 湯姆被感染了嗎？

ex.en: He got infected with HIV.
ex.zh: 他感染了愛滋病毒。

ex.en: When the wound got infected, he experienced a bout of unbearable pain.
ex.zh: 傷口感染後，他痛得難以忍受。

infect.en: to pass a disease to a person, animal or plant

ex.en: My computer has been infected with BraveSentry.
ex.zh: 我的電腦中了 BraveSentry 病毒。

ex.en: Don't open that file; it could infect your computer.
ex.zh: 別開那個檔案，它可能會讓你的電腦中毒。

infect.en: to put a harmful program into a computer

inflationary.zh: 通貨膨脹的、造成通膨的

ex.en: Rising oil prices put inflationary pressure on the economy.
ex.zh: 油價上漲對經濟帶來通膨壓力。

ex.en: The central bank is worried about inflationary risks.
ex.zh: 央行擔心通膨風險。

inflationary.en: causing prices in general to go up

ex.en: We welcome the inclusion of two new members.
ex.zh: 我們歡迎兩位新成員加入。

ex.en: His inclusion in the team surprised everyone.
ex.zh: 他入選隊伍讓大家都很意外。

inclusion.en: the act of making someone or something part of a group or whole

ex.en: The company promotes diversity and inclusion.
ex.zh: 公司提倡多元與包容。

ex.en: Inclusion means making everyone feel welcome.
ex.zh: 包容就是讓每個人都感到被接納。

inclusion.en: the idea of making everyone feel welcome and equal

ex.en: I won't allow you to continue your interference in my daughter's life.
ex.zh: 我不會再容許你干涉我女兒的生活。

ex.en: The company rejected any government interference in its business.
ex.zh: 這家公司拒絕政府對其業務的任何干預。

interference.en: the act of getting involved in something that is not your business

ex.en: The radio signal suffered from interference.
ex.zh: 無線電訊號受到干擾。

ex.en: Mobile phones may cause interference with medical equipment.
ex.zh: 手機可能會干擾醫療設備。

interference.en: noise or disturbance that spoils a radio or TV signal

ex.en: She assumed an air of indifference.
ex.zh: 她裝出一副不在乎的樣子。

ex.en: He doesn't have the indifference typical of people from big cities.
ex.zh: 他沒有大城市人常見的那種冷漠。

ex.en: The manager's indifference to customer complaints hurt sales.
ex.zh: 經理對客訴漠不關心，影響了業績。

indifference.en: a lack of interest or concern

ex.en: Government forces captured several insurgents.
ex.zh: 政府軍逮捕了幾名叛亂分子。

ex.en: The insurgents controlled the northern region.
ex.zh: 叛亂分子控制了北部地區。

insurgent.en: a person who fights against their own government

ex.en: Political instability has hurt the economy.
ex.zh: 政治動盪傷害了經濟。

ex.en: Market instability makes investors nervous.
ex.zh: 市場不穩定讓投資人很緊張。

instability.en: a situation that is likely to change suddenly or get worse

ex.en: The position will be filled internally.
ex.zh: 這個職缺會由內部人員遞補。

ex.en: The problem was handled internally.
ex.zh: 這個問題在內部處理掉了。

internally.en: inside a company or body, not from outside

ex.en: The intensity of the storm surprised everyone.
ex.zh: 暴風雨的強度讓大家都很驚訝。

ex.en: She works with great intensity.
ex.zh: 她工作非常投入、全力以赴。

intensity.en: the great strength or force of something

ex.en: The Romans invaded Britain about 2,000 years ago.
ex.zh: 羅馬人大約在兩千年前入侵英國。

ex.en: Ants invaded our kitchen last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天螞蟻大舉入侵我們的廚房。

invade.en: to enter a country or place by force to take control of it

ex.en: This app invades users' privacy.
ex.zh: 這個 App 侵犯使用者的隱私。

ex.en: I don't want to invade your privacy.
ex.zh: 我不想侵犯你的隱私。

invade.en: to enter a place or area where you are not wanted

ex.en: I need to give you an injection.
ex.zh: 我得幫你打一針。

ex.en: I'll give you a painkilling injection.
ex.zh: 我幫你打一針止痛針。

injection.en: the act of putting medicine into the body with a needle

ex.en: The company received a cash injection from investors.
ex.zh: 公司獲得了投資人的資金挹注。

ex.en: The economy needs an injection of new money.
ex.zh: 經濟需要注入新的資金。

injection.en: an amount of money put into a business to help it

ex.en: The government is struggling to end the insurgency.
ex.zh: 政府正努力平息叛亂。

ex.en: The insurgency began five years ago.
ex.zh: 這場叛亂始於五年前。

insurgency.en: a violent fight against a government by a group of its own people

incline.zh: 傾向於（常用 be inclined to）

ex.en: I'm inclined to agree with you.
ex.zh: 我傾向同意你的看法。

ex.en: Customers are more inclined to buy when prices drop.
ex.zh: 價格下降時，顧客比較願意購買。

incline.en: to feel that you want to do or believe something

ex.en: The car rolled down the incline.
ex.zh: 車子沿著斜坡滑了下去。

ex.en: Walking up a steep incline is good exercise.
ex.zh: 走陡坡是很好的運動。

ex.en: Excessive choice results in the inability to choose.
ex.zh: 選擇太多反而讓人無法選擇。

ex.en: Superstitions derive from the inability of men to acknowledge that coincidences are merely coincidences.
ex.zh: 迷信源自人們無法接受巧合就只是巧合。

inability.en: the fact of not being able to do something

ex.en: The report pointed out several inefficiencies in the system.
ex.zh: 報告指出系統中幾個效率不彰的地方。

ex.en: Inefficiency costs the company millions every year.
ex.zh: 效率低落每年讓公司損失數百萬。

inefficiency.en: the failure to use time, money or effort well

ex.en: She hired a private investigator.
ex.zh: 她請了一位私家偵探。

ex.en: He's a seasoned investigator.
ex.zh: 他是一位經驗豐富的調查員。

ex.en: Investigators are looking into the cause of the fire.
ex.zh: 調查人員正在調查起火原因。

investigator.en: a person whose job is to find out the facts about something

ex.en: The new policy proved ineffective.
ex.zh: 新政策證實沒有效果。

ex.en: Antibiotics are ineffective against viruses.
ex.zh: 抗生素對病毒無效。

ineffective.en: not producing the result you want

ex.en: Foreign people intrigue me.
ex.zh: 我對外國人很好奇。

ex.en: That is intriguing.
ex.zh: 那真耐人尋味。

ex.en: The idea really intrigued me.
ex.zh: 這個點子讓我很感興趣。

intrigue.en: to make someone very interested and curious

ex.en: The novel is full of political intrigue.
ex.zh: 這本小說充滿了政治陰謀。

ex.en: There is a lot of office intrigue at that company.
ex.zh: 那家公司的辦公室鬥爭很多。

intrigue.en: secret plans to get power or harm others

ex.en: Jack is the most intelligent boy in the class.
ex.zh: 傑克是班上最聰明的男孩。

ex.en: The dolphin is a very intelligent animal.
ex.zh: 海豚是非常聰明的動物。

ex.en: He is not as intelligent as his older brother.
ex.zh: 他沒有他哥哥那麼聰明。

intelligent.en: good at learning and understanding things

ex.en: The car has an intelligent parking system.
ex.zh: 這輛車配備智慧停車系統。

ex.en: Intelligent software can sort your emails automatically.
ex.zh: 智慧型軟體可以自動整理你的電子郵件。

intelligent.en: able to act in a clever way by using computer technology

ex.en: Strictly speaking, this sentence is grammatically incorrect.
ex.zh: 嚴格來說，這個句子的文法不正確。

ex.en: Cross out the incorrect words.
ex.zh: 把錯誤的字劃掉。

ex.en: This is incorrect.
ex.zh: 這是錯的。

ex.en: Most animals have an instinct to protect their young.
ex.zh: 大多數動物都有保護幼獸的本能。

ex.en: Animals act on instinct.
ex.zh: 動物依本能行動。

instinct.en: a natural way of behaving that you are born with, without learning it

ex.en: My first instinct was to say no.
ex.zh: 我的第一個直覺是拒絕。

ex.en: She followed her instincts and took the job.
ex.zh: 她相信自己的直覺，接下了那份工作。

instinct.en: a strong feeling about what to do, without thinking carefully

ex.en: His story was inconsistent with the evidence.
ex.zh: 他的說詞與證據不符。

ex.en: Your statements today are inconsistent with what you said yesterday.
ex.zh: 你今天的說法和昨天說的前後矛盾。

inconsistent.en: not matching, or containing parts that disagree

inconsistent.zh: （表現、品質）不穩定的、時好時壞的

ex.en: The team's performance has been inconsistent this season.
ex.zh: 這支球隊本季表現時好時壞。

ex.en: The service at that restaurant is very inconsistent.
ex.zh: 那家餐廳的服務品質很不穩定。

ex.en: Police intercepted the truck at the border.
ex.zh: 警方在邊境攔截了那輛卡車。

ex.en: The goalkeeper intercepted the pass.
ex.zh: 守門員攔截了那記傳球。

ex.en: Hackers can intercept data sent over public Wi-Fi.
ex.zh: 駭客可以攔截透過公共 Wi-Fi 傳送的資料。

intercept.en: to stop someone or something before it reaches a place

ex.en: The storm is expected to intensify overnight.
ex.zh: 暴風雨預計在夜間增強。

ex.en: The company intensified its marketing efforts.
ex.zh: 公司加強了行銷力道。

intensify.en: to become stronger or to make something stronger

ex.en: Paris is the most beautiful city in the world.
ex.zh: 巴黎是世界上最美麗的城市。

ex.en: The files are in the top drawer.
ex.zh: 檔案在最上面的抽屜裡。

in.en: used to show that something is inside a place or area

in.zh: 在（年、月、季節、上午等時段）

ex.en: I was born in 1995.
ex.zh: 我是一九九五年出生的。

ex.en: We usually go skiing in winter.
ex.zh: 我們通常冬天去滑雪。

in.en: used to show when something happens within a period of time

ex.en: I'll be back in ten minutes.
ex.zh: 我十分鐘後回來。

ex.en: The package will arrive in three days.
ex.zh: 包裹三天後會到。

in.en: used to show how much time must pass before something happens

ex.en: Please fill out the form in English.
ex.zh: 請用英文填寫表格。

ex.en: Can I pay in cash?
ex.zh: 我可以用現金付款嗎？

in.en: used to show the language or way that something is done

ex.en: Is Mr. Chen in today?
ex.zh: 陳先生今天在嗎？

ex.en: Come in, please.
ex.zh: 請進。

in.en: at home or at work, or going into a place

ex.en: Are the water and electricity included in the rent?
ex.zh: 房租有包含水電費嗎？

ex.en: Possible side effects include blurred vision and shortness of breath.
ex.zh: 可能的副作用包括視力模糊和呼吸急促。

ex.en: At this language centre, about 15 international languages are taught, including English.
ex.zh: 這個語言中心教授約十五種國際語言，包括英文。

include.en: to have something as one part of a whole

ex.en: He is included among my friends.
ex.zh: 他也是我的朋友之一。

ex.en: Please include me in the email.
ex.zh: 請把我加進這封信的收件人。

include.en: to count someone or something as part of a group

ex.en: Tom doesn't care about protecting his personal information online.
ex.zh: 湯姆不在意在網路上保護自己的個資。

ex.en: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.
ex.zh: 網路是非常寶貴的資訊來源。

ex.en: We may combine your personal information with other information.
ex.zh: 我們可能會將你的個人資訊與其他資訊結合。

information.en: facts or details about someone or something

ex.en: Ask at the information desk.
ex.zh: 去服務台問問看。

ex.en: The information counter is near the entrance.
ex.zh: 詢問處在入口附近。

information.en: the place where people go to ask for help or facts

ex.en: Mastering a foreign language involves a lot of patience.
ex.zh: 學好外語需要很大的耐心。

ex.en: Whichever way we choose will involve danger.
ex.zh: 不管我們選哪條路，都會有危險。

ex.en: Astronomy involves the study of stars and planets.
ex.zh: 天文學包括對恆星和行星的研究。

involve.en: to need or have something as a necessary part

ex.en: I don't want to be involved in this affair.
ex.zh: 我不想捲入這件事。

ex.en: How many people are involved in the project?
ex.zh: 有多少人參與這個專案？

involve.en: to take part in something, or be connected with it

ex.en: The community is made up of individuals.
ex.zh: 社會是由個人組成的。

ex.en: We are currently looking for individuals who have experience in customer service.
ex.zh: 我們目前正在尋找有客服經驗的人才。

individual.en: one single person, seen apart from a group

ex.en: Don't generalize individual behavior to an entire group.
ex.zh: 不要把個人行為套用到整個群體。

ex.en: Individual freedom is the soul of democracy.
ex.zh: 個人自由是民主的靈魂。

ex.en: Each student gets individual attention.
ex.zh: 每位學生都能得到個別的關注。

individual.en: single and separate, or belonging to one person

ex.en: I may give up soon and just nap instead.
ex.zh: 我可能很快就會放棄，改去睡個午覺。

ex.en: There was no tea, so I had coffee instead.
ex.zh: 沒有茶了，所以我改喝咖啡。

instead.en: as a replacement for something just mentioned

ex.en: I usually use a credit card instead of cash.
ex.zh: 我通常用信用卡，而不是現金。

ex.en: She's vegetarian, so she ate tofu instead of turkey.
ex.zh: 她吃素，所以她沒吃火雞，而是吃豆腐。

ex.en: Will you go to the party instead of me?
ex.zh: 你可以代替我去派對嗎？

instead.en: used to say that one thing is used or done in place of another

ex.en: Inside the room there is a smell of smoke.
ex.zh: 房間裡有一股煙味。

ex.en: Please wait inside the building.
ex.zh: 請在大樓裡面等候。

inside.en: in or into the inner part of a place or thing

ex.en: I want to see what there is inside.
ex.zh: 我想看看裡面有什麼。

ex.en: It's raining, so let's stay inside.
ex.zh: 下雨了，我們待在室內吧。

inside.en: in or into a place, or in a building

ex.en: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
ex.zh: 先燙衣領的內側，再燙外側。

ex.en: The inside of the box was empty.
ex.zh: 箱子裡面是空的。

ex.en: He took out the wallet from his inside jacket pocket.
ex.zh: 他從外套內袋拿出皮夾。

ex.en: The police think it was an inside job.
ex.zh: 警方認為這是內賊所為。

inside.en: on the inner part of something

ex.en: He is an interpreter in an international bank.
ex.zh: 他在一家國際銀行當口譯員。

ex.en: International problems must be solved by diplomacy, not war.
ex.zh: 國際問題必須透過外交而非戰爭解決。

ex.en: Taoyuan International Airport is very busy.
ex.zh: 桃園國際機場非常繁忙。

ex.en: Many TV programs have a bad influence on children.
ex.zh: 許多電視節目對兒童有不良影響。

ex.en: He has a strong influence over the business world.
ex.zh: 他在商界很有影響力。

influence.en: the power to change what people think or do

ex.en: I think that our living together has influenced your habits.
ex.zh: 我覺得我們住在一起影響了你的習慣。

ex.en: Price strongly influences what customers buy.
ex.zh: 價格大大影響顧客買什麼。

influence.en: to change how someone thinks or acts

indeed.zh: 的確、確實；（加強語氣）真的

ex.en: It may, indeed, be a mistake.
ex.zh: 這可能確實是個錯誤。

ex.en: Indeed she is young and beautiful, but she is in delicate health.
ex.zh: 她確實年輕貌美，但身體很虛弱。

ex.en: I'm very well indeed, thank you.
ex.zh: 我真的很好，謝謝您。

indeed.en: used to say that something is really true or to make a word stronger

ex.en: The strong wind indicates that a storm is coming.
ex.zh: 強風表示暴風雨就要來了。

ex.en: Her smile indicates that she has forgiven me.
ex.zh: 她的微笑表示她已經原諒我了。

ex.en: The survey indicates that customers want lower prices.
ex.zh: 調查顯示顧客希望價格更低。

indicate.en: to show that something is true or likely

ex.en: The contents of the box are indicated on the label.
ex.zh: 箱子裡裝什麼都標示在標籤上。

ex.en: The different colored strings indicate different fillings.
ex.zh: 不同顏色的繩子代表不同的餡料。

ex.en: The red flag indicated the presence of danger.
ex.zh: 紅旗表示有危險。

indicate.en: to point to something or show where it is

ex.en: Some fruits, for instance oranges, are rich in vitamin C.
ex.zh: 有些水果，例如柳橙，富含維生素 C。

ex.en: We could, for instance, hold the meeting online.
ex.zh: 例如，我們可以在線上開會。

ex.en: This is just one instance of poor planning.
ex.zh: 這只是規劃不周的一個例子。

ex.en: Can you give me an instance of this problem?
ex.zh: 你能舉一個這個問題的例子嗎？

ex.en: In this instance, we will make an exception.
ex.zh: 這次的情況我們會破例。

ex.en: In most instances, refunds are processed within a week.
ex.zh: 在大多數情況下，退款會在一週內處理完畢。

ex.en: The majority of his income goes to pay his rent.
ex.zh: 他大部分的收入都拿去付房租。

ex.en: His income was diminished by half after retirement.
ex.zh: 他退休後收入減少了一半。

ex.en: His large income enables him to travel abroad every year.
ex.zh: 他的收入很高，所以每年都能出國旅行。

income.en: the money a person gets from work or other sources

ex.en: I advised him to be independent of his parents.
ex.zh: 我勸他不要依賴父母，要獨立。

ex.en: Those young men are independent of their parents.
ex.zh: 那些年輕人已經不依賴父母，自己獨立了。

ex.en: She is very independent and likes to travel alone.
ex.zh: 她很獨立，喜歡一個人旅行。

independent.en: not needing or depending on other people

independent.zh: 不受控制的、中立的（第三方）

ex.en: In a democracy, it's important for the press to be independent.
ex.zh: 在民主國家，新聞媒體保持獨立很重要。

ex.en: The report was checked by an independent expert.
ex.zh: 這份報告由一位獨立的專家審查過。

independent.en: not controlled by or connected to any group or side

ex.en: I intend to study abroad in America next year.
ex.zh: 我打算明年去美國留學。

ex.en: I intend to visit Australia during my spring break.
ex.zh: 我打算春假的時候去澳洲玩。

ex.en: Her husband intends to bring out a new monthly magazine.
ex.zh: 她先生打算創辦一本新的月刊。

ex.en: This book is intended for beginners.
ex.zh: 這本書是給初學者看的。

ex.en: The program is intended for new employees.
ex.zh: 這個課程是專為新進員工設計的。

intend.en: to be made or meant for a certain person or purpose

ex.en: She works at a financial institution in Taipei.
ex.zh: 她在台北的一家金融機構工作。

ex.en: This university is a well-known research institution.
ex.zh: 這所大學是知名的研究機構。

institution.en: a large organization such as a bank, school or hospital

ex.en: Marriage is an important social institution.
ex.zh: 婚姻是重要的社會制度。

ex.en: The afternoon tea break has become an institution in our office.
ex.zh: 下午茶時間已經成了我們辦公室的慣例。

institution.en: a long-standing custom or system in society

ex.en: Could you give us a brief introduction of yourself?
ex.zh: 可以請你簡單自我介紹一下嗎？

ex.en: Mr Gilmore is so well known as to need no introduction.
ex.zh: 吉爾摩先生名氣很大，不需要介紹。

ex.en: Thank you for the kind introduction.
ex.zh: 謝謝您親切的介紹。

introduction.en: the act of telling people a person's name when they first meet

ex.en: The introduction of the new system took six months.
ex.zh: 導入新系統花了六個月。

ex.en: The introduction of smartphones changed the industry.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機的問世改變了這個產業。

introduction.en: the act of bringing something new into use

ex.en: Please read the introduction before chapter one.
ex.zh: 請在第一章之前先讀序言。

ex.en: This book is a good introduction to economics.
ex.zh: 這本書是很好的經濟學入門。

introduction.en: the first part of a book or talk, or a simple first lesson in a subject

ex.en: Your initial order is subject to a special discount of 5%.
ex.zh: 首次訂購可享 95 折特別優惠。

ex.en: Our initial plan was to open the store in May.
ex.zh: 我們最初的計畫是五月開店。

ex.en: What do the initials NTT stand for?
ex.zh: NTT 這幾個字母代表什麼？

ex.en: Please write your initials at the bottom of each page.
ex.zh: 請在每頁底部簽上你的姓名縮寫。

initial.en: the first letter of a name

ex.en: The investigation is under way.
ex.zh: 相關調查正在進行中。

ex.en: Mary knew she was under investigation.
ex.zh: 瑪麗知道自己正在接受調查。

ex.en: The report proved true as a result of their investigation.
ex.zh: 他們的調查結果證實這篇報導屬實。

investigation.en: a careful search to find out facts about something

ex.en: He invested his money in stocks.
ex.zh: 他把錢投資在股票上。

ex.en: The company invested a lot of money in this project.
ex.zh: 這家公司在這個專案上投入了很多錢。

ex.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
ex.zh: 政府應該在農業上投入更多資金。

invest.en: to put money into something in order to make more money

ex.en: Don't be afraid to invest time and energy.
ex.zh: 不要害怕投入時間和精力。

ex.en: She invested a lot of time in learning English.
ex.zh: 她投入很多時間學英文。

invest.en: to spend time or effort on something in order to get a good result

ex.en: Industrial production rose sharply in July.
ex.zh: 七月份工業生產大幅成長。

ex.en: Many people work in industrial towns.
ex.zh: 許多人在工業城鎮工作。

ex.en: She is an industrial designer.
ex.zh: 她是工業設計師。

industrial.en: connected with factories and the making of goods

ex.en: The button battery in the PC's internal timer has gone flat.
ex.zh: 電腦內部計時器的鈕扣電池沒電了。

ex.en: This document is for internal use only.
ex.zh: 這份文件僅供內部使用。

ex.en: The company is conducting an internal investigation.
ex.zh: 公司正在進行內部調查。

internal.en: inside a place, body or organization

ex.en: Other countries should not interfere in its internal affairs.
ex.zh: 其他國家不應干涉它的內政。

ex.en: The country is dealing with serious internal problems.
ex.zh: 這個國家正在處理嚴重的內部問題。

internal.en: inside a country, not involving other countries

ex.en: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.
ex.zh: 警方正在調查事故原因。

ex.en: He has investigated the possibility of cooperation.
ex.zh: 他研究過雙方合作的可能性。

ex.en: A committee was constituted to investigate prices.
ex.zh: 成立了一個委員會來調查物價。

investigate.en: to try to find out the facts about something

insist.zh: 堅持要、堅決要求（insist on / that）

ex.en: Jimmy insisted on my taking him to the zoo.
ex.zh: 吉米堅持要我帶他去動物園。

ex.en: My father insisted on our waiting for the train.
ex.zh: 我父親堅持要我們等火車。

ex.en: Mother insists that we should be home by seven in the evening.
ex.zh: 媽媽堅持我們晚上七點前要回到家。

insist.en: to say firmly that something must be done

ex.en: He insisted that he was innocent.
ex.zh: 他堅稱自己是清白的。

ex.en: She insists that she sent the email yesterday.
ex.zh: 她堅稱昨天已經寄出那封電子郵件。

insist.en: to say firmly that something is true, even if others doubt it

ex.en: Do you play a musical instrument?
ex.zh: 你會演奏樂器嗎？

ex.en: My favourite musical instrument is the electric guitar.
ex.zh: 我最喜歡的樂器是電吉他。

ex.en: Do you play any other instruments besides the piano?
ex.zh: 除了鋼琴之外，你還會彈其他樂器嗎？

instrument.en: a tool such as a piano or guitar that is used to make music

ex.en: The doctor cleaned his instruments carefully.
ex.zh: 醫生仔細清潔他的醫療器具。

ex.en: This instrument measures air pressure.
ex.zh: 這個儀器用來測量氣壓。

instrument.en: a tool used for careful or scientific work

ex.en: Over the past ten years, people have become increasingly aware that they need to change their eating habits.
ex.zh: 過去十年來，人們越來越意識到需要改變飲食習慣。

ex.en: Online shopping is becoming increasingly popular.
ex.zh: 網購越來越普遍。

ex.en: It's increasingly difficult to find cheap housing in Taipei.
ex.zh: 在台北找便宜的房子越來越難。

increasingly.en: more and more as time goes on

instruction.zh: 指示；（使用）說明（常用複數）

ex.en: Follow my instructions and proceed carefully.
ex.zh: 照我的指示小心前進。

ex.en: I just followed your instructions.
ex.zh: 我只是照你的指示做。

ex.en: I'll keep the instructions you sent for assembling the furniture.
ex.zh: 我會保留你寄來的家具組裝說明。

instruction.en: words telling you what to do or how to use something

ex.en: The course offers instruction in English.
ex.zh: 這門課以英語授課。

ex.en: Students receive instruction from experienced teachers.
ex.zh: 學生接受資深老師的指導。

instruction.en: the act of teaching a subject or skill

ex.en: His intelligence and experience enabled him to deal with the trouble.
ex.zh: 他的聰明才智和經驗讓他能處理這個麻煩。

ex.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.
ex.zh: 懷疑自己是聰明的第一個表現。

intelligence.en: the ability to learn, understand and think well

ex.en: AI stands for artificial intelligence.
ex.zh: AI 代表人工智慧。

ex.en: AI means Artificial Intelligence.
ex.zh: AI 是人工智慧的縮寫。

intelligence.en: computer systems that can do things that usually need human thinking

ex.en: The company uses market intelligence to plan its strategy.
ex.zh: 公司利用市場情報來規劃策略。

ex.en: Intelligence agencies gather information about possible threats.
ex.zh: 情報機構會蒐集可能威脅的相關資訊。

intelligence.en: secret or useful information about an enemy, a rival or a situation

ex.en: The application allows you to quickly calculate the ratio of body mass index - BMI.
ex.zh: 這個應用程式可以讓你快速計算身體質量指數（BMI）。

ex.en: The stock index rose 2% today.
ex.zh: 股價指數今天上漲了 2%。

index.en: a number or measure that shows how something changes or compares

ex.en: Check the index at the back of the book.
ex.zh: 查一下書後面的索引。

ex.en: The index lists all the topics in alphabetical order.
ex.zh: 索引按字母順序列出所有主題。

index.en: an alphabetical list at the end of a book that shows where to find topics

ex.en: We have optimized the database indexing, and as a result, system efficiency has improved by 50%.
ex.zh: 我們優化了資料庫的索引，系統效率因此提升了 50%。

ex.en: All the documents are indexed by date.
ex.zh: 所有文件都按日期編入索引。

index.en: to make a list that shows where information can be found

ex.en: I have no intention of telling you the result.
ex.zh: 我沒打算告訴你結果。

ex.en: Tom has no intention of going to Mary's wedding.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒打算參加瑪麗的婚禮。

ex.en: The government clearly stated its intention to lower taxes.
ex.zh: 政府明確表示打算降稅。

intention.en: something that you plan to do

ex.en: How did you get this injury on your foot?
ex.zh: 你腳上的傷是怎麼來的？

ex.en: The patient's injuries aren't life-threatening.
ex.zh: 傷者的傷勢沒有生命危險。

ex.en: Not all of the passengers escaped injury.
ex.zh: 並非所有乘客都毫髮無傷。

injury.en: damage to a person's body, or the harm done to it

ex.en: This is the place where the incident happened.
ex.zh: 這裡就是事件發生的地點。

ex.en: I had nothing to do with that incident.
ex.zh: 我跟那起事件毫無關係。

ex.en: The incident was etched in his memory.
ex.zh: 那件事深深烙印在他的記憶中。

incident.en: something that happens, especially something unusual or bad

ex.en: Local businesses are teaming up for a charity initiative.
ex.zh: 當地企業正聯手推動一項慈善計畫。

ex.en: The initiative measurably improved quality of life for the villagers.
ex.zh: 這項計畫明顯改善了村民的生活品質。

ex.en: The company launched a new green initiative.
ex.zh: 公司推出了一項新的環保計畫。

initiative.en: a new plan or action meant to solve a problem

initiative.zh: 主動性、進取心（take the initiative 主動）

ex.en: He takes the initiative in helping his mother do the housework.
ex.zh: 他主動幫媽媽做家事。

ex.en: She showed great initiative at work.
ex.zh: 她在工作上展現了很強的主動性。

ex.en: Take the initiative to ask your manager for feedback.
ex.zh: 主動向你的主管尋求意見回饋。

initiative.en: the ability to decide and act without waiting to be told

ex.en: All social interactions, naturally, will involve some degree of insincerity, which I believe is necessary.
ex.zh: 所有社交互動自然都會帶有某種程度的虛偽，我認為這是必要的。

ex.en: The job involves a lot of interaction with customers.
ex.zh: 這份工作需要和客戶大量互動。

ex.en: Online classes offer less face-to-face interaction.
ex.zh: 線上課程的面對面互動比較少。

interaction.en: the act of talking or working together with other people

ex.en: Doctors check for interactions between different medicines.
ex.zh: 醫生會檢查不同藥物之間的交互作用。

ex.en: Scientists study the interaction between genes and the environment.
ex.zh: 科學家研究基因與環境之間的交互作用。

interaction.en: the way two things affect each other

ex.en: We plan to integrate the two systems next year.
ex.zh: 我們計劃明年整合這兩套系統。

ex.en: The app integrates easily with your calendar.
ex.zh: 這個 App 能輕鬆與你的行事曆整合。

integrate.en: to combine two or more things so they work together

ex.en: They refuse to integrate.
ex.zh: 她們拒絕融入。

ex.en: It takes time for new employees to integrate into the team.
ex.zh: 新進員工需要時間融入團隊。

integrate.en: to become a full member of a group or community

intellectual.zh: 智力的、知識的、需要動腦的

ex.en: In terms of intellectual hobbies, I really like learning Chinese characters.
ex.zh: 說到需要動腦的嗜好，我真的很喜歡學漢字。

ex.en: Reading helps children's intellectual development.
ex.zh: 閱讀有助於孩子的智力發展。

intellectual.en: connected with thinking and understanding, not feelings or physical work

ex.en: The company takes intellectual property very seriously.
ex.zh: 這家公司非常重視智慧財產權。

ex.en: Software is protected as intellectual property.
ex.zh: 軟體受到智慧財產權保護。

intellectual.en: ideas, designs or creations that belong to someone by law

ex.en: Wise men talk about ideas, intellectuals about facts, and the ordinary man talks about what he eats.
ex.zh: 智者談論思想，知識分子談論事實，一般人則談論吃什麼。

ex.en: He was a leading intellectual of his time.
ex.zh: 他是當代頂尖的知識分子。

intellectual.en: a well-educated person who spends time thinking about complicated ideas

ex.en: Your interpretation is a bit too literal.
ex.zh: 你的解讀有點太字面了。

ex.en: It is subject to interpretation.
ex.zh: 這件事見仁見智，可以有不同的解讀。

interpretation.en: the way someone understands the meaning of something

ex.en: The conference offers simultaneous interpretation in English and Chinese.
ex.zh: 這場研討會提供中英同步口譯。

ex.en: We need interpretation services for the meeting.
ex.zh: 我們這場會議需要口譯服務。

interpretation.en: the act of saying in another language what a speaker says

ex.en: He is two inches taller than I am.
ex.zh: 他比我高兩英寸。

ex.en: The weather report says we'll get three inches of snow.
ex.zh: 氣象預報說會下三英寸的雪。

inch.en: a unit of length equal to about two and a half centimetres

inch.zh: 緩慢移動、一點一點地前進

ex.en: The car inched forward in the heavy traffic.
ex.zh: 車子在壅塞的車陣中緩緩前進。

ex.en: Prices have inched up this year.
ex.zh: 今年物價一點一點地上漲。

inch.en: to move very slowly and a little at a time

ex.en: We waded into the cold water inch by inch.
ex.zh: 我們一點一點地走進冰冷的水中。

ex.en: We moved the heavy desk inch by inch.
ex.zh: 我們一點一點地把那張重桌子挪過去。

ex.en: Thank you for your input on the proposal.
ex.zh: 謝謝你對這份提案的意見。

ex.en: We'd like your input before we make a decision.
ex.zh: 做決定之前，我們想聽聽你的意見。

input.en: ideas or advice that you give to help with something

ex.en: The input method also works with this version.
ex.zh: 這個輸入法也適用於這個版本。

ex.en: The program checks user input for errors.
ex.zh: 這個程式會檢查使用者輸入的內容是否有誤。

ex.en: Please input your password.
ex.zh: 請輸入您的密碼。

ex.en: I input the data into the spreadsheet.
ex.zh: 我把資料輸入到試算表裡。

input.en: to put information into a computer

ex.en: I inspired my students to work harder.
ex.zh: 我激勵學生們更努力學習。

ex.en: His speech inspired all the boys.
ex.zh: 他的演講激勵了所有男孩。

inspire.en: to make someone want to do something good

ex.en: The design was inspired by traditional Japanese houses.
ex.zh: 這個設計的靈感來自傳統日式房屋。

ex.en: Her travels inspired her first novel.
ex.zh: 她的旅行經歷啟發了她的第一本小說。

inspire.en: to give someone an idea for making something

ex.en: We will incorporate your suggestions into the final design.
ex.zh: 我們會把你的建議納入最終設計。

ex.en: The new model incorporates the latest technology.
ex.zh: 新機型採用了最新技術。

incorporate.en: to include something as part of a whole

ex.en: The company was incorporated in 2010.
ex.zh: 這家公司於 2010 年註冊成立。

ex.en: They decided to incorporate the business next year.
ex.zh: 他們決定明年把這個事業正式登記成公司。

incorporate.en: to form a company in a legal way

ex.en: It was much worse than we initially thought.
ex.zh: 事情比我們起初想的還要糟。

ex.en: Initially we had some problems with our computer system, but they've been sorted out now.
ex.zh: 起初我們的電腦系統出了點問題，不過現在已經解決了。

ex.en: Initially, I didn't like my job, but now I love it.
ex.zh: 我一開始不喜歡我的工作，但現在很喜歡。

ex.en: Innovation is the key to the company's success.
ex.zh: 創新是公司成功的關鍵。

ex.en: The company invests heavily in technological innovation.
ex.zh: 公司大量投資於技術創新。

innovation.en: a new idea or method, or the use of new ideas

ex.en: If I were free, I would accept your invitation.
ex.zh: 如果我有空，就會接受你的邀請。

ex.en: How many people did you send invitations to?
ex.zh: 你寄了邀請函給多少人？

ex.en: Many people rejected the invitation to the welcome party.
ex.zh: 許多人婉拒了歡迎會的邀請。

invitation.en: a request to come to an event, or the card or message that asks you

ex.en: I interpreted her silence as a refusal.
ex.zh: 我把她的沉默解讀為拒絕。

ex.en: How do you interpret these words?
ex.zh: 你怎麼解讀這些話？

ex.en: The same sign may be interpreted differently by different people or different cultures.
ex.zh: 同一個符號，不同的人或文化可能有不同的解讀。

interpret.en: to explain or decide what something means

ex.en: She interpreted for the Japanese clients at the meeting.
ex.zh: 她在會議上為日本客戶口譯。

ex.en: Could you interpret for me? I don't speak French.
ex.zh: 你可以幫我翻譯嗎？我不會說法文。

interpret.en: to say in another language what a speaker is saying

ex.en: India gained independence from Britain in 1947.
ex.zh: 印度在 1947 年脫離英國獨立。

ex.en: The US declared independence from Great Britain in 1776.
ex.zh: 美國在 1776 年宣布脫離英國獨立。

independence.en: the freedom of a country to rule itself

ex.en: Living alone gave her a sense of independence.
ex.zh: 獨自生活讓她有了自立的感覺。

ex.en: Many young people want financial independence.
ex.zh: 許多年輕人希望經濟獨立。

independence.en: the ability to look after yourself and make your own choices

ex.en: This inner conflict tends to diminish as the years go by.
ex.zh: 這種內心的衝突往往會隨著歲月而淡去。

ex.en: His encounter with her is enriching his inner life.
ex.zh: 與她的相遇讓他的內心世界更加豐富。

inner.en: relating to a person's private thoughts and feelings

ex.en: The inner pocket of my jacket has a zipper.
ex.zh: 我外套的內袋有拉鍊。

ex.en: The inner walls of the building were painted white.
ex.zh: 這棟建築的內牆漆成白色。

inner.en: closer to the centre or on the inside

ex.en: The government's intervention helped stabilize the market.
ex.zh: 政府的介入有助於穩定市場。

ex.en: Early medical intervention can save lives.
ex.zh: 及早進行醫療介入能挽救生命。

intervention.en: the act of getting involved in a situation to change it

ex.en: He had an infection in his belly button.
ex.zh: 他的肚臍發炎了。

ex.en: Wash your hands often to prevent infection.
ex.zh: 要常洗手以預防感染。

ex.en: She has an ear infection.
ex.zh: 她耳朵發炎了。

infection.en: an illness caused by germs entering the body

ex.en: Thank you for your involvement in this project.
ex.zh: 感謝你參與這個專案。

ex.en: He denied any involvement in the scandal.
ex.zh: 他否認與這起醜聞有任何牽連。

involvement.en: the fact of taking part in something or being connected with it

ex.en: The young woman was carrying an infant in her arms.
ex.zh: 那個年輕女子懷裡抱著一個嬰兒。

ex.en: You should really take an infant CPR class.
ex.zh: 你真的應該去上嬰兒心肺復甦術課程。

ex.en: It can make some people, especially the elderly and infants, very ill.
ex.zh: 它可能讓某些人病得很重，尤其是老人和嬰兒。

infant.zh: 嬰兒的；初期的、剛起步的

ex.en: This store sells infant clothing and toys.
ex.zh: 這家店賣嬰兒服裝和玩具。

ex.en: The industry is still in its infant stage.
ex.zh: 這個產業仍處於起步階段。

infant.en: for very young children, or at an early stage of growth

ex.en: The company offers incentives to staff who meet their targets.
ex.zh: 公司提供獎勵給達成目標的員工。

ex.en: Tax incentives encourage people to buy electric cars.
ex.zh: 稅務優惠鼓勵民眾購買電動車。

ex.en: Lower prices are a strong incentive for customers.
ex.zh: 較低的價格對顧客是很強的誘因。

incentive.en: something that makes people want to do something

ex.en: Tom was badly injured in a traffic accident.
ex.zh: 湯姆在車禍中受了重傷。

ex.en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
ex.zh: 如果不遵守安全規定，你可能會受傷。

ex.en: He was slightly injured in a traffic accident.
ex.zh: 他在車禍中受了輕傷。

injure.en: to hurt a person or animal

ex.en: The myth offers insights into the ancient civilization.
ex.zh: 這則神話讓我們得以深入了解古代文明。

ex.en: The survey gave us useful insights into customer needs.
ex.zh: 這份調查讓我們更了解顧客的需求。

ex.en: She has great insight into human nature.
ex.zh: 她對人性有很深的洞察力。

insight.en: a clear and deep understanding of something

ex.en: How are you keeping off this intense heat?
ex.zh: 你是怎麼熬過這酷熱的天氣的？

ex.en: She felt intense pain in her back.
ex.zh: 她背部感到劇烈疼痛。

ex.en: Competition in the market is intense.
ex.zh: 市場競爭非常激烈。

ex.en: I took an intense English course this summer.
ex.zh: 我今年夏天上了密集的英文課。

intense.en: involving great effort, pressure or strong competition

ex.en: His victory at this age in an international competition is a good indication of a bright future.
ex.zh: 他這個年紀就在國際比賽中獲勝，顯示他前途無量。

ex.en: There is no indication that prices will fall soon.
ex.zh: 沒有跡象顯示價格很快會下跌。

ex.en: Early sales are a good indication of the product's success.
ex.zh: 初期銷量是產品成功的好指標。

indication.en: a sign that shows something is true or will happen

ex.en: The telephone was invented in 1876 by Bell.
ex.zh: 電話是貝爾在 1876 年發明的。

ex.en: If someone in the future invents a time machine, why don't they come back to visit us?
ex.zh: 如果未來有人發明了時光機，為什麼他們不回來看我們？

ex.en: Who invented the light bulb?
ex.zh: 電燈泡是誰發明的？

invent.en: to make or think of something that did not exist before

ex.en: He invented an excuse for being late.
ex.zh: 他捏造了一個遲到的藉口。

ex.en: The story was invented by a reporter.
ex.zh: 這個故事是一名記者編出來的。

invent.en: to make up a false story or reason

ex.en: He made over the interior of his house.
ex.zh: 他把房子內部重新裝修了。

ex.en: The interior of the car is very comfortable.
ex.zh: 這輛車的車內空間很舒適。

interior.en: the inside part of a building or thing

ex.en: She works as an interior designer.
ex.zh: 她是室內設計師。

ex.en: We painted the interior walls white.
ex.zh: 我們把室內的牆漆成白色。

interior.en: on the inside of a building or thing

ex.en: As far as I know, he is innocent.
ex.zh: 就我所知，他是清白的。

ex.en: I am convinced that he is innocent.
ex.zh: 我相信他是無辜的。

ex.en: If he is innocent, then his wife is guilty.
ex.zh: 如果他是清白的，那有罪的就是他太太。

innocent.en: not guilty of a crime or of doing something wrong

ex.en: It was just an innocent mistake.
ex.zh: 那只是個無心之過。

ex.en: She asked an innocent question.
ex.zh: 她問了個單純的問題。

innocent.en: simple and having no bad purpose

ex.en: Institutional investors own most of the company's shares.
ex.zh: 法人投資者持有這家公司大部分的股份。

ex.en: The school needs institutional reform.
ex.zh: 這所學校需要制度改革。

institutional.en: relating to large organizations or to an established system

ex.en: My house is fully insured.
ex.zh: 我的房子保了全險。

ex.en: It's a crying shame that they weren't insured against fire.
ex.zh: 他們沒保火險，實在太可惜了。

ex.en: Is your car insured?
ex.zh: 你的車有保險嗎？

insure.en: to pay a company so it will cover the cost if something bad happens

ex.en: There is a high incidence of flu in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天流感的發生率很高。

ex.en: The incidence of crime has dropped in this area.
ex.zh: 這一區的犯罪率已經下降了。

ex.en: It's incredible that your mother speaks six languages!
ex.zh: 你媽媽會說六種語言，真是令人難以置信！

ex.en: It's incredible that nobody noticed the error.
ex.zh: 竟然沒有人發現這個錯誤，真令人難以置信。

incredible.en: so strange that it is hard to believe

ex.en: Friday evening was incredible.
ex.zh: 星期五晚上真是太棒了。

ex.en: The view from the top is incredible.
ex.zh: 從山頂看出去的景色美極了。

ex.en: I'm incredibly busy.
ex.zh: 我超級忙。

ex.en: I felt incredibly nervous.
ex.zh: 我覺得非常緊張。

ex.en: Dinner was incredibly boring.
ex.zh: 晚餐無聊透頂。

ex.en: Industrialization often goes hand in hand with pollution.
ex.zh: 工業化往往伴隨著汙染。

ex.en: Rapid industrialization changed the country in just 30 years.
ex.zh: 快速的工業化在短短 30 年內改變了這個國家。

industrialization.en: the process of building many factories in a country or area

ex.en: The country began to industrialize rapidly in the 1980s.
ex.zh: 這個國家在 1980 年代開始快速工業化。

ex.en: Many countries industrialized during the 19th century.
ex.zh: 許多國家在 19 世紀實現了工業化。

industrialize.en: to build many factories in a country or area

ex.en: The flu is highly infectious.
ex.zh: 流感的傳染力很強。

ex.en: Patients with infectious diseases are kept in a separate ward.
ex.zh: 傳染病患者被安置在獨立病房。

infectious.en: able to pass from one person to another

ex.en: Tom's laughter is infectious.
ex.zh: 湯姆的笑聲很有感染力。

ex.en: Her enthusiasm is infectious.
ex.zh: 她的熱情很有感染力。

infectious.en: quickly spreading a feeling to other people

ex.en: He is inferior to you in all respects.
ex.zh: 他在各方面都比不上你。

ex.en: There is no reason for you to feel inferior to anyone.
ex.zh: 你沒有理由覺得自己不如任何人。

ex.en: The cheaper product is of inferior quality.
ex.zh: 比較便宜的產品品質較差。

inferior.en: lower in quality or rank than something else

ex.en: There's no doubt that the universe is infinite.
ex.zh: 毫無疑問，宇宙是無限的。

ex.en: Teaching young children requires infinite patience.
ex.zh: 教小朋友需要無比的耐心。

ex.en: The internet offers an almost infinite amount of information.
ex.zh: 網路提供幾乎無窮無盡的資訊。

ex.en: The road seemed to stretch to infinity.
ex.zh: 那條路彷彿無限延伸。

ex.en: In math, infinity is not a real number.
ex.zh: 在數學裡，無限大不是一個實數。

infinity.en: a space or distance that has no end

ex.en: High taxes may inhibit economic growth.
ex.zh: 高稅率可能會抑制經濟成長。

ex.en: Fear of failure can inhibit creativity.
ex.zh: 害怕失敗會阻礙創造力。

ex.en: This drug inhibits the growth of bacteria.
ex.zh: 這種藥能抑制細菌生長。

inhibit.en: to slow down or stop something from happening

ex.en: She lost her inhibitions and started dancing.
ex.zh: 她放開拘束，開始跳舞。

ex.en: Children usually have fewer inhibitions than adults.
ex.zh: 小孩通常比大人少了些顧忌。

inhibition.en: a shy or nervous feeling that stops you from acting naturally

ex.en: The study looked at the inhibition of cancer cell growth.
ex.zh: 這項研究探討癌細胞生長的抑制。

ex.en: Low temperatures lead to the inhibition of plant growth.
ex.zh: 低溫會抑制植物生長。

inhibition.en: the act of slowing down or stopping a process

ex.en: The initiation of the project was delayed by a month.
ex.zh: 專案的啟動延後了一個月。

ex.en: We celebrated the initiation of the new program.
ex.zh: 我們慶祝新計畫的開辦。

ex.en: New members must go through an initiation ceremony.
ex.zh: 新成員必須參加入會儀式。

ex.en: The club's initiation includes a short speech.
ex.zh: 這個社團的入社儀式包含一段簡短演說。

initiation.en: the act of formally accepting someone into a group

ex.en: The nurse injected the vaccine into my arm.
ex.zh: 護理師把疫苗注射到我的手臂。

ex.en: Diabetics may need to inject insulin daily.
ex.zh: 糖尿病患可能需要每天注射胰島素。

inject.en: to put medicine into the body with a needle

ex.en: The government injected billions into the economy.
ex.zh: 政府向經濟注入數十億資金。

ex.en: She injected some humor into her speech.
ex.zh: 她在演講中加入了一點幽默。

inject.en: to add money or new energy to something

ex.en: He has an innate love of adventure.
ex.zh: 他天生熱愛冒險。

ex.en: Children have an innate ability to learn languages.
ex.zh: 孩子天生就有學習語言的能力。

ex.en: What do you call this insect in English?
ex.zh: 這種昆蟲的英文叫什麼？

ex.en: Most insects have six legs and four wings.
ex.zh: 大多數昆蟲有六隻腳和四片翅膀。

ex.en: Have you been bitten by an insect?
ex.zh: 你被蟲咬了嗎？

insect.en: a small animal with six legs and often wings

ex.en: Interestingly, sales increased during the rainy season.
ex.zh: 有趣的是，銷售量在雨季反而增加了。

ex.en: Interestingly, most of our customers are under 30.
ex.zh: 有趣的是，我們大部分顧客都不到 30 歲。

interestingly.en: used to introduce a fact that is surprising or worth noticing

ex.en: The interviewer asked about my previous job.
ex.zh: 面試官問了我以前的工作。

ex.en: Make eye contact with the interviewer.
ex.zh: 要跟面試官有眼神接觸。

interviewer.en: a person who asks questions to someone applying for a job

ex.en: The interviewer introduces the topic of the interview.
ex.zh: 採訪者介紹了這次訪談的主題。

ex.en: The TV interviewer asked the mayor some tough questions.
ex.zh: 電視台的採訪記者問了市長幾個尖銳的問題。

interviewer.en: a person who asks questions to get information or opinions

ex.en: The sentence uses inversion for emphasis.
ex.zh: 這個句子使用倒裝來強調。

ex.en: Inversion is common after words like never and rarely.
ex.zh: 在 never、rarely 等字之後常使用倒裝。

inversion.en: a change in the usual order of words in a sentence

ex.en: The movie is an inversion of the classic fairy tale.
ex.zh: 這部電影顛覆了經典童話故事。

ex.en: A temperature inversion traps pollution over the city.
ex.zh: 逆溫現象讓汙染滯留在城市上空。

inversion.en: the act of turning something upside down or into its opposite

ex.en: Through the lens the image was inverted.
ex.zh: 透過鏡片，影像上下顛倒了。

ex.en: Invert the cake onto a plate.
ex.zh: 把蛋糕倒扣在盤子上。

ex.en: You can invert the colors of the image with this tool.
ex.zh: 你可以用這個工具反轉圖片的顏色。

invert.en: to turn something upside down or change its order

ex.en: A fire broke out at the inn where they were staying.
ex.zh: 他們住的旅館發生了火災。

ex.en: We stayed at a small inn by the lake.
ex.zh: 我們住在湖邊的一家小旅館。

ex.en: The inn serves breakfast from seven to ten.
ex.zh: 這家旅館的早餐供應時間是七點到十點。

inn.en: a small hotel or pub, usually in the countryside

ex.en: Now I want to introduce my parents to you.
ex.zh: 現在我要向你介紹我的父母。

ex.en: She introduced me to him at the party.
ex.zh: 她在派對上將我介紹給他。

ex.en: You should have introduced yourself to the girl.
ex.zh: 你應該向那個女孩自我介紹的。

introduce.en: to tell people each other's names when they first meet

ex.en: The company introduced a new four-day work week.
ex.zh: 公司開始實施每週上班四天的新制度。

ex.en: Tomatoes were introduced to Europe from America.
ex.zh: 番茄是從美洲傳入歐洲的。

introduce.en: to bring something new into use or sale

ex.en: I invited him to the party and he accepted.
ex.zh: 我邀請他參加派對，他答應了。

ex.en: My friend invited me to go out to dinner.
ex.zh: 我的朋友邀請我去吃晚餐。

ex.en: Did you invite her to spend Christmas here?
ex.zh: 你邀請她來這裡過聖誕節了嗎？

invite.en: to ask someone to come to an event or place

ex.en: We apologize for the delay and regret any inconvenience it may have caused.
ex.zh: 我們為這次的延誤致歉，造成不便，敬請見諒。

ex.en: Sorry for the inconvenience.
ex.zh: 造成不便，敬請見諒。

inconvenience.en: trouble or difficulty that makes things less easy for you

ex.en: All of my wife's relatives are my in-laws.
ex.zh: 我太太的所有親戚都是我的姻親。

ex.en: Because our kids got married, we are now in-laws.
ex.zh: 因為我們的孩子結婚了，現在我們成了親家。

in-laws.en: the family members of your husband or wife

ex.en: Last year I suffered from an inflammation of my middle ear.
ex.zh: 去年我得了中耳炎。

ex.en: Ice can help reduce inflammation.
ex.zh: 冰敷可以幫助消炎。

inflammation.en: a red, swollen and painful condition of a part of the body

ex.en: Everyone's tricks are different; each differs in ingenious ways.
ex.zh: 戲法人人會變，各有巧妙不同。

ex.en: She came up with an ingenious solution to the problem.
ex.zh: 她想出了一個解決問題的巧妙辦法。

ingenious.en: very clever and full of new ideas

instrumental.zh: 有幫助的、起重要作用的

ex.en: She was instrumental in getting the project approved.
ex.zh: 她對這項計畫能獲得批准起了重要作用。

ex.en: His advice was instrumental to our success.
ex.zh: 他的建議對我們的成功很有幫助。

instrumental.en: playing an important part in making something happen

ex.en: I like instrumental music.
ex.zh: 我喜歡器樂。

ex.en: The album has both vocal and instrumental songs.
ex.zh: 這張專輯同時有人聲演唱和純樂器演奏的歌曲。

instrumental.en: played on musical instruments and without singing

ex.en: Magnetic fields are invisible.
ex.zh: 磁場是看不見的。

ex.en: Air is invisible.
ex.zh: 空氣是無形的。

ex.en: The moon is invisible behind the clouds.
ex.zh: 在雲的遮蔽下無法見到月亮。

ex.en: We're intimate friends.
ex.zh: 我們是親密的朋友。

ex.en: They have been intimate friends since childhood.
ex.zh: 他們從小就是親密的朋友。

ex.en: The restaurant has a warm and intimate atmosphere.
ex.zh: 那家餐廳的氣氛溫馨又親切。

ex.en: She insulted him.
ex.zh: 她侮辱了他。

ex.en: Tom didn't mean to insult anybody.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒想侮辱誰。

ex.en: I didn't mean to insult anyone.
ex.zh: 我沒有想要冒犯誰。

insult.en: to say or do something that is rude and hurts someone's feelings

ex.en: I do not know whether to take it as a compliment or an insult.
ex.zh: 我真是哭笑不得。

ex.en: Being called lazy was an insult to him.
ex.zh: 被說懶惰對他來說是一種侮辱。

insult.en: a rude remark or action that hurts someone's feelings

ex.en: By intuition he knew she was lying.
ex.zh: 他憑直覺發現她在撒謊。

ex.en: Women's intuition is said to be strong, but it is often just careful observation.
ex.zh: 人們常說女性的直覺很強，但那往往只是細心觀察的結果。

intuition.en: the ability to know something without thinking it through

ex.en: I have a firm belief in his innocence.
ex.zh: 我堅信他是無辜的。

ex.en: There is no doubt as to her innocence.
ex.zh: 她毫無疑問是清白的。

ex.en: I am fully convinced of your innocence.
ex.zh: 我完全相信你是清白的。

innocence.en: the fact of not being guilty of a crime

ex.en: Innocence is a beautiful thing.
ex.zh: 純真是一件美好的事。

ex.en: The children's innocence made everyone smile.
ex.zh: 孩子們的天真讓大家都露出微笑。

innocence.en: the quality of knowing little about the bad side of life

ex.en: That pool really looks inviting.
ex.zh: 那座泳池看來的確很吸引人。

ex.en: The smell of fresh coffee was warm and inviting.
ex.zh: 現煮咖啡的香味溫暖又誘人。

ex.en: The cozy living room looked very inviting.
ex.zh: 那間舒適的客廳看起來很讓人想進去坐坐。

inviting.en: pleasant and making you want to come closer or try it

ex.en: Lots of people in Japan are indifferent to politics.
ex.zh: 很多日本人對政治冷淡。

ex.en: I am indifferent to others' opinions.
ex.zh: 我對其他人的意見並不關心。

ex.en: You are too indifferent to those around you.
ex.zh: 你對待身邊的人太冷漠了。

indifferent.en: not interested in or caring about something

ex.en: She felt insecure about her future.
ex.zh: 她對她的未來感到沒有安全感。

ex.en: Why are you so insecure?
ex.zh: 為什麼你這麼沒有安全感？

ex.en: He felt insecure about his looks.
ex.zh: 他對自己的外表沒有自信。

insecure.en: not confident and worried about yourself

ex.en: His indecision cost the team a lot of time.
ex.zh: 他的優柔寡斷使團隊浪費了很多時間。

ex.en: After a moment of indecision, she chose the blue dress.
ex.zh: 猶豫了一會兒之後，她選了那件藍色洋裝。

indecision.en: the inability to make a choice quickly

ex.en: She was indignant at being accused of lying.
ex.zh: 她對被指控說謊感到憤慨。

ex.en: The customers grew indignant when the shop refused to refund their money.
ex.zh: 商店拒絕退款，讓顧客們非常憤慨。

ex.en: I heard indistinct voices in the next room.
ex.zh: 我聽到隔壁房間傳來模糊不清的說話聲。

ex.en: In the fog, the outline of the ship was indistinct.
ex.zh: 在霧中，船的輪廓很模糊。

indistinct.en: not clear to see or hear

ex.en: Great thoughts are created through intricate details.
ex.zh: 細節成就偉大的想法。

ex.en: The carpet has an intricate pattern of flowers.
ex.zh: 這塊地毯有複雜精細的花朵圖案。

intricate.en: having many small parts that are carefully arranged

ex.en: Don't try to intimidate me.
ex.zh: 別想嚇唬我。

ex.en: I'm not that easily intimidated.
ex.zh: 我不是輕易嚇得住的。

ex.en: She wasn't intimidated by him.
ex.zh: 她並不畏懼他。

intimidate.en: to frighten someone so that they do what you want

ex.en: The unfair decision caused public indignation.
ex.zh: 這個不公平的決定引起了眾怒。

ex.en: She spoke with indignation about the way workers were treated.
ex.zh: 她憤慨地談起工人受到的對待。

ex.en: The surgeon made a small incision in the patient's abdomen.
ex.zh: 外科醫生在病人的腹部切了一個小切口。

ex.en: Keep the incision clean and dry for a week after surgery.
ex.zh: 手術後一週內要保持切口乾淨乾燥。

incision.en: a cut made in the body during an operation

ex.en: After the operation, he spent three days in the intensive care unit.
ex.zh: 手術後，他在加護病房待了三天。

ex.en: Visitors to the intensive care unit must wash their hands first.
ex.zh: 到加護病房探病的人必須先洗手。

intensive care unit.en: the part of a hospital for people who are very seriously ill

ex.en: He behaves as if he were insane.
ex.zh: 他的舉止就像瘋了一樣。

ex.en: Has Tom gone insane?
ex.zh: 湯姆瘋了嗎？

ex.en: Tom is insane.
ex.zh: 湯姆瘋了。

insane.en: having a serious mental illness (offensive when used for people)

ex.en: Chih-ming’s insane — he always wins the last round in mahjong.
ex.zh: 志明真的很扯，每次打麻將都胡最後一把。

ex.en: That is insane.
ex.zh: 那太扯了。

ex.en: The price of medicine in that country is insane.
ex.zh: 那個國家的藥價貴得離譜。

ex.en: Eating too fast often gives me indigestion.
ex.zh: 吃太快常常讓我消化不良。

ex.en: He took some medicine for his indigestion after the big dinner.
ex.zh: 豐盛的晚餐後，他吃了點治消化不良的藥。

indigestion.en: a painful feeling in the stomach after eating

ex.en: Getting a flu shot can protect you from influenza.
ex.zh: 打流感疫苗可以保護你不得流感。

ex.en: Influenza spreads quickly in crowded places in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天時流感在人多的地方傳播得很快。

influenza.en: a common illness with fever, cough and body aches

ex.en: I didn't mean to intrude.
ex.zh: 我無意打擾。

ex.en: He intruded on her privacy.
ex.zh: 他侵犯了她的隱私。

ex.en: Don't intrude on her privacy.
ex.zh: 不要侵犯她的隱私。

intrude.en: to enter or join something where you are not wanted

ex.en: Many people protested against the injustice of the new tax.
ex.zh: 很多人抗議新稅制的不公平。

ex.en: He has spent his whole life fighting injustice.
ex.zh: 他一輩子都在對抗不公不義。

injustice.en: a situation in which people are treated in an unfair way

ex.en: His insulting comments made everyone at the table uncomfortable.
ex.zh: 他那些侮辱人的話讓整桌人都很不自在。

ex.en: It is insulting to ignore someone who is talking to you.
ex.zh: 別人跟你說話時不理他，是很失禮的。

insulting.en: rude in a way that hurts someone's feelings

inflict.zh: 使遭受（痛苦、傷害等）、施加

ex.en: Cruel words can inflict deep pain on a friend.
ex.zh: 刻薄的話可能會深深傷害朋友。

ex.en: The storm inflicted serious damage on the coastal towns.
ex.zh: 暴風雨對沿海城鎮造成嚴重的損害。

inflict.en: to make someone suffer something painful

ex.en: With a little ingenuity, she turned old boxes into a bookshelf.
ex.zh: 她發揮一點巧思，把舊箱子改成了書架。

ex.en: The engineers solved the problem through skill and ingenuity.
ex.zh: 工程師們憑著技術和巧思解決了問題。

ingenuity.en: the ability to think of clever new ways to solve problems

intriguing.zh: 引人入勝的、耐人尋味的

ex.en: That is intriguing.
ex.zh: 那真有趣。

ex.en: She made an intriguing suggestion at the meeting.
ex.zh: 她在會議上提出了一個很有意思的建議。

ex.en: The new neighbor is an intriguing person with many travel stories.
ex.zh: 新鄰居是個很有意思的人，有好多旅行故事。

intriguing.en: very interesting because it is strange or mysterious

ex.en: In small villages, social intercourse between neighbors is part of daily life.
ex.zh: 在小村莊裡，鄰居之間的交往是日常生活的一部分。

ex.en: The festival encourages cultural intercourse between the two countries.
ex.zh: 這個節慶促進了兩國之間的文化交流。

ex.en: He is an industrious student to the best of my knowledge.
ex.zh: 就我所知，他是個很用功的學生。

ex.en: An industrious person will succeed in life.
ex.zh: 勤勞的人將在生活中獲得成功。

ex.en: My grandparents were industrious farmers who worked from dawn to dusk.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母是勤勞的農夫，從早做到晚。

industrious.en: working hard and with a lot of effort

ex.en: Inquisitive children often ask "why" about everything.
ex.zh: 好奇心強的孩子常常凡事都問「為什麼」。

ex.en: Our inquisitive neighbor always wants to know who visits us.
ex.zh: 我們那愛打聽的鄰居總想知道誰來我們家。

inquisitive.en: always asking questions and wanting to learn more

ex.en: The incumbent won the election easily.
ex.zh: 現任者輕鬆贏得選舉。

ex.en: It's hard to beat an incumbent.
ex.zh: 要打敗現任者很難。

incumbent.en: a person who holds an official job or position now

ex.en: The incumbent mayor is running for a second term.
ex.zh: 現任市長正在爭取連任。

ex.en: The incumbent government lost support.
ex.zh: 現任政府失去了支持。

incumbent.en: holding an official position at the present time

ex.en: The value of the dollar declines as the rate of inflation rises.
ex.zh: 隨著通貨膨脹率上升，美元的價值下跌。

ex.en: Interest rates and inflation were high.
ex.zh: 當時利率和通膨都很高。

inflation.en: a general rise in prices over time

ex.en: Interest rates are still low.
ex.zh: 利率還是很低。

ex.en: Interest rates and inflation were high.
ex.zh: 當時利率和通膨都很高。

interest rate.en: the percentage charged for borrowing money or paid for saving it

ex.en: In our opinion, solar panels are a good investment.
ex.zh: 我們認為太陽能板是很好的投資。

ex.en: She can assess investments very accurately.
ex.zh: 她評估投資非常準確。

ex.en: Tom doubled his investment in a year.
ex.zh: 湯姆一年內讓他的投資翻了一倍。

investment.en: money put into something to make a profit, or the act of doing this

ex.en: Foreign investors withdrew their money from America.
ex.zh: 外國投資人把資金從美國撤出。

ex.en: She is not the founder, she's the investor.
ex.zh: 她不是創辦人，她是投資人。

ex.en: The investor stole the capital of his client.
ex.zh: 那個投資人侵吞了客戶的資金。

investor.en: a person who puts money into something to make a profit

ex.en: There are many jobs available in the computer industry.
ex.zh: 電腦產業有很多工作機會。

ex.en: Japan is highly competitive in high technology industries.
ex.zh: 日本在高科技產業很有競爭力。

ex.en: The city should subsidize small businesses in industries with large overhead costs.
ex.zh: 市政府應該補貼固定成本高的產業中的小企業。

industry.en: the making of goods in factories, or a branch of business

ex.en: Indigenous Australians have eaten kangaroos for millennia.
ex.zh: 澳洲原住民吃袋鼠已經有幾千年的歷史了。

ex.en: Pachamama is a goddess of earth and fertility revered by the indigenous peoples of the Andes.
ex.zh: 帕查媽媽是安地斯山原住民崇敬的大地與生育女神。

indigenous.en: belonging to the first people who lived in a place

ex.en: This plant is indigenous to Canada.
ex.zh: 這種植物原產於加拿大。

ex.en: The panda is indigenous to Sichuan Province and does not live in the wild in any other places.
ex.zh: 熊貓原產於四川，其他地方沒有野生熊貓。

indigenous.en: naturally found in a certain place

ex.en: Algeria is a big country of forty million inhabitants.
ex.zh: 阿爾及利亞是一個有四千萬居民的大國。

ex.en: Brazil has almost 200 million inhabitants.
ex.zh: 巴西有將近兩億居民。

inhabitant.en: a person or animal that lives in a place

ex.en: We conduct safety inspections here on a regular basis.
ex.zh: 我們定期在這裡進行安全檢查。

ex.en: Korea allowed an inspection by the IAEA.
ex.zh: 韓國接受了國際原子能總署的檢查。

inspection.en: an official visit or careful look to check that something is correct

ex.en: The induction program lasts two weeks.
ex.zh: 新進員工訓練為期兩週。

ex.en: All new staff attend an induction on their first day.
ex.zh: 所有新員工第一天都要參加到職訓練。

induction.en: the introduction and training given to a new employee

ex.en: They installed a vending machine at work.
ex.zh: 他們在辦公室安裝了一臺自動販賣機。

ex.en: Since I installed solar panels on my house, my energy bill has been cut in half.
ex.zh: 自從我在房子上裝了太陽能板，電費就少了一半。

ex.en: I want to have a telephone installed.
ex.zh: 我想裝一支電話。

install.en: to put equipment or software in place so it is ready to use

ex.en: She has a strong interest in history.
ex.zh: 她對歷史很有興趣。

ex.en: I lost interest in the game after an hour.
ex.zh: 玩了一個小時我就對那個遊戲沒興趣了。

interest.en: the feeling of wanting to know or learn about something

ex.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
ex.zh: 銀行對高風險客戶的貸款收取較高的利息。

ex.en: This savings account pays 2% interest.
ex.zh: 這個儲蓄帳戶的利息是 2%。
