interest.en: extra money paid for borrowing money or earned by saving it

ex.en: Trump is acting in Russia's interests.
ex.zh: 川普的所作所為符合俄羅斯的利益。

ex.en: It's in your best interest to accept the offer.
ex.zh: 接受這個提議對你最有利。

interest.en: something that helps or benefits a person or group

ex.en: You can pay for the laptop in 12 monthly installments.
ex.zh: 這台筆電可以分 12 期每月付款。

ex.en: I paid the last installment yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天付了最後一期。

installment.en: one of several payments made over a period of time

ex.en: The final installment of the series comes out next year.
ex.zh: 這個系列的最後一集明年推出。

ex.en: The story will be published in three installments.
ex.zh: 這個故事會分三期刊出。

installment.en: one part of a story or show that is published in parts

ex.en: We take inventory at the end of every month.
ex.zh: 我們每個月底盤點庫存。

ex.en: Our inventory of winter coats is running low.
ex.zh: 我們的冬季外套庫存快不夠了。

inventory.en: all the goods a business has, or a list of them

ex.en: The finance director interjected to correct the cost estimate.
ex.zh: 財務主管插話更正成本估算。

ex.en: Please do not interject while the interpreter is speaking.
ex.zh: 口譯員發言時請不要插話。

interject.en: to say something suddenly while another person is speaking

ex.en: The retailer buys cleaning supplies in bulk.
ex.zh: 這家零售商大量採購清潔用品。

ex.en: Customers can order these parts in bulk.
ex.zh: 顧客可以批量訂購這些零件。

in bulk.en: in large amounts, often at a lower price

ex.en: The income statement reports revenue and expenses.
ex.zh: 損益表列出營收與支出。

ex.en: Please send me the income statement for last quarter.
ex.zh: 請把上一季的損益表寄給我。

income statement.en: a report that shows how much money a company earned and spent

ex.en: Following the company’s insolvency, the court appointed an administrator.
ex.zh: 公司無力償債後，法院指派了一名管理人。

ex.en: The report warned that falling sales could lead to insolvency.
ex.zh: 報告警告，銷售下滑可能導致公司無力償債。

insolvency.en: the state of not having enough money to pay what you owe

intuitive.zh: 直覺易用的；容易理解的

ex.en: The dashboard has an intuitive design.
ex.zh: 這個儀表板的設計很直覺。

ex.en: Most users find the controls intuitive.
ex.zh: 大多數使用者都覺得這些控制項容易理解。

intuitive.en: easy to understand or use without being taught

interoperability.zh: 互通性；系統間的相容能力

ex.en: Interoperability allows the two systems to share data.
ex.zh: 互通性讓兩套系統可以交換資料。

ex.en: The standard improves interoperability between devices.
ex.zh: 這項標準提升了裝置之間的互通性。

interoperability.en: the ability of different systems to work together

ex.en: The new insulation keeps the upper floor cooler in summer.
ex.zh: 新的隔熱材料讓頂樓夏天更涼爽。

ex.en: An electrician checked the insulation around the exposed wires.
ex.zh: 電工檢查了裸露電線周圍的絕緣層。

insulation.en: material that stops heat, cold or electricity from passing through

ex.en: He developed insomnia while adjusting to the night shift.
ex.zh: 他適應夜班期間開始失眠。

ex.en: The specialist suggested keeping a sleep diary to manage insomnia.
ex.zh: 專科醫師建議記錄睡眠日誌來改善失眠。

insomnia.en: a long-term problem of being unable to sleep

ex.en: The insured must report the damage within thirty days.
ex.zh: 被保險人必須在三十天內通報損害。

ex.en: Each insured receives a copy of the updated policy.
ex.zh: 每位被保險人都會收到更新後的保單副本。

insured.en: the person whose loss or damage is covered by an agreement with an insurance company

ex.en: The contract provides indemnity for losses caused by the supplier.
ex.zh: 合約規定供應商造成損失時須予以賠償。

ex.en: The policy includes indemnity for eligible legal expenses.
ex.zh: 這份保單包含符合條件的法律費用補償。

indemnity.en: money paid to cover a loss or damage

ex.en: She used part of her inheritance to pay off the mortgage.
ex.zh: 她用部分遺產清償房貸。

ex.en: The lawyer explained how the inheritance would be divided.
ex.zh: 律師說明了遺產的分配方式。

inheritance.en: money or things that you receive from someone who has died

ex.en: Visitors should use the intercom to contact the front desk.
ex.zh: 訪客請使用對講機聯絡櫃檯。

ex.en: The intercom lets staff communicate between floors.
ex.zh: 員工可以透過內線通話系統跨樓層聯絡。

intercom.en: a device used to talk to people in another room or at a door

ex.en: The audience returned to their seats before intermission ended.
ex.zh: 中場休息結束前，觀眾都回到座位。

ex.en: Refreshments are available in the lobby during intermission.
ex.zh: 幕間休息時，大廳有提供茶點。

intermission.en: a short break in the middle of a show

ex.en: Turn right at the next intersection.
ex.zh: 請在下一個十字路口右轉。

ex.en: This intersection is dangerous.
ex.zh: 這個十字路口很危險。

ex.en: You can get there by crossing the street at the second intersection.
ex.zh: 你在第二個路口過馬路就到了。

intersection.en: a place where two or more roads cross

ex.en: Sir, can we quickly inspect your luggage please?
ex.zh: 先生，我們可以檢查一下您的行李嗎？

ex.en: "I need to inspect the wound," said the doctor.
ex.zh: 醫生說：「我需要檢查一下傷口。」

ex.en: The cadres inspected our school.
ex.zh: 幹部們來視察我們學校。

inspect.en: to look at something carefully to check it

ex.en: Tom was badly injured in a traffic accident.
ex.zh: 湯姆在交通意外中受了重傷。

ex.en: My brother was injured in the car accident.
ex.zh: 我哥在車禍中受傷了。

ex.en: He was slightly injured in a traffic accident.
ex.zh: 他在車禍中受了輕傷。

injured.en: hurt in an accident or attack

ex.en: The ambulances carried the injured to the nearest hospital.
ex.zh: 救護車把傷者送往了最近的醫院。

ex.en: The injured were taken to three different hospitals.
ex.zh: 傷者被送往三家不同的醫院。

injured.en: people who are hurt in an accident or attack

ex.en: Why did you buy travel insurance?
ex.zh: 你為什麼買了旅遊保險？

ex.en: Can I use my medical insurance?
ex.zh: 我可以使用我的醫療保險嗎？

ex.en: Please mail this form to your insurance company.
ex.zh: 請把這份表格寄給您的保險公司。

insurance.en: an agreement in which you pay money so that a company covers future losses

ex.en: The number of tourists has increased greatly in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來觀光客人數大幅增加。

ex.en: The number of people who go abroad has been increasing.
ex.zh: 出國的人數一直在增加。

ex.en: The number of cars driven in the city has increased.
ex.zh: 在城市裡行駛的車輛數量增加了。

increase.en: to become bigger in amount or number, or to make something so

ex.en: There has been a 10% increase in sales.
ex.zh: 銷售額成長了 10%。

ex.en: The price increase surprised many customers.
ex.zh: 漲價讓很多顧客感到意外。

increase.en: a rise in amount, number or size

ex.en: Please send the invoice to our accounting department.
ex.zh: 請把請款單寄給我們的會計部。

ex.en: The invoice must be paid within 30 days.
ex.zh: 這張請款單須在 30 天內付清。

invoice.en: a document that lists goods or services and the money owed for them

ex.en: We will invoice you at the end of the month.
ex.zh: 我們會在月底開請款單給您。

ex.en: The supplier invoiced us twice by mistake.
ex.zh: 供應商不小心向我們請了兩次款。

invoice.en: to send a document asking a customer to pay for goods or services

ex.en: Have you got that in stock?
ex.zh: 你們有現貨嗎？

ex.en: Sorry, that size is not in stock right now.
ex.zh: 抱歉，那個尺寸目前沒有庫存。

in stock.en: available in a shop and ready to be sold

ex.en: Tomorrow we will welcome the first intern.
ex.zh: 明天我們會迎來第一位實習生。

ex.en: Tom is just an intern.
ex.zh: 湯姆只不過是實習生。

intern.en: a student or beginner who works for a short time to gain experience

ex.en: For media inquiries, please contact your local communications or marketing representative.
ex.zh: 媒體詢問請洽當地的公關或行銷代表。

ex.en: Thank you for your inquiry about our products.
ex.zh: 感謝您詢問我們的產品。

ex.en: We made inquiries into his past.
ex.zh: 我們對他的過去進行了調查。

ex.en: The government has opened an inquiry into the accident.
ex.zh: 政府已經對這起事故展開調查。

inquiry.en: an official investigation to find out the facts

ex.en: Please inform me of any changes in the situation.
ex.zh: 如果情況有任何變化，請務必通知我。

ex.en: Please inform me of the plan ahead of time.
ex.zh: 請你事先把計劃告訴我。

ex.en: Please keep me informed.
ex.zh: 請隨時通知我最新狀況。

ex.en: Your voice is almost inaudible. Can you move closer to the mic?
ex.zh: 你的聲音幾乎聽不到，可以靠近麥克風一點嗎？

ex.en: He said something inaudible and left the room.
ex.zh: 他小聲說了句聽不清楚的話就離開了房間。

ex.en: I've got my college interview tomorrow. Hopefully I'll pass.
ex.zh: 我明天有大學入學面試，希望能通過。

ex.en: You'll have to play it by ear at the interview.
ex.zh: 面試時你得隨機應變。

interview.en: a meeting where someone asks you questions to decide if you are right for a job or school

ex.en: The interviewer introduces the topic of the interview.
ex.zh: 採訪者先介紹了這次訪問的主題。

ex.en: The singer gave an interview to a local newspaper.
ex.zh: 那位歌手接受了當地報紙的採訪。

interview.en: a conversation in which someone is asked questions about their life or opinions

ex.en: I interviewed him.
ex.zh: 我採訪了他。

ex.en: Tom is being interviewed by Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆正在接受瑪麗的訪問。

interview.en: to ask someone questions to judge them for a job or to get their opinions

ex.en: The price is NT$500, including tax.
ex.zh: 價格是五百元，含稅。

ex.en: Everyone came to the party, including my teacher.
ex.zh: 大家都來參加派對，包括我的老師。

ex.en: Many countries, including Japan, have earthquakes.
ex.zh: 包括日本在內的許多國家都有地震。

ex.en: Many students were involved in the school project.
ex.zh: 許多學生參與了這個學校專案。

ex.en: I don't want to get involved in their argument.
ex.zh: 我不想牽扯進他們的爭吵。

ex.en: The story is too involved for children to follow.
ex.zh: 這個故事太複雜了，孩子們看不懂。

ex.en: It was a long and involved process.
ex.zh: 那是一個漫長又複雜的過程。

ex.en: That was an interesting book about the ocean.
ex.zh: 那是一本關於海洋的有趣的書。

ex.en: It would be interesting to visit Tainan next year.
ex.zh: 明年去台南玩應該會很有趣。

ex.en: She told us an interesting story.
ex.zh: 她跟我們說了一個有趣的故事。

ex.en: I am interested in learning to cook.
ex.zh: 我對學做菜很感興趣。

ex.en: Are you interested in joining our club?
ex.zh: 你有興趣加入我們的社團嗎？

ex.en: There is an increasing number of cars on the road.
ex.zh: 路上的車輛越來越多。

ex.en: The increasing cost of food worries many families.
ex.zh: 食物成本日益上漲讓許多家庭擔憂。

ex.en: The app has an integrated calendar and to-do list.
ex.zh: 這個應用程式內建行事曆和待辦清單。

ex.en: The school uses an integrated approach to teaching.
ex.zh: 這所學校採用整合式的教學方法。

ex.en: The inmates attend classes in the prison library.
ex.zh: 受刑人在監獄圖書館上課。

ex.en: Each inmate of the nursing home has a private room.
ex.zh: 療養院的每位住戶都有單人房。

ex.en: He invariably arrives ten minutes early.
ex.zh: 他總是提早十分鐘到。

ex.en: Cheap shoes invariably wear out quickly.
ex.zh: 便宜的鞋子總是很快就磨壞。

ex.en: The medicine worked instantly.
ex.zh: 這種藥立刻見效。

ex.en: I instantly recognized her voice on the phone.
ex.zh: 我一聽就認出了電話裡她的聲音。

ex.en: The file was deleted instantly.
ex.zh: 檔案立刻被刪除了。

ex.en: The teacher showed an instructional video about safety.
ex.zh: 老師播放了一部有關安全的教學影片。

ex.en: This website offers instructional materials for new learners.
ex.zh: 這個網站為新手提供教學資料。

ex.en: The old bridge remained intact after the storm.
ex.zh: 那座老橋在暴風雨後依然完好。

ex.en: The package arrived with all items intact.
ex.zh: 包裹送到時所有物品都完好無缺。

intact.zh: 未受影響的、原封不動的

ex.en: Her confidence stayed intact despite the failure.
ex.zh: 儘管失敗了，她的自信依然未受影響。

ex.en: The seal on the bottle was still intact.
ex.zh: 瓶子上的封條還是完好的。

ex.en: I am inclined to agree with you.
ex.zh: 我傾向同意你的看法。

ex.en: She felt inclined to help the stranger.
ex.zh: 她覺得想要幫助那位陌生人。

ex.en: He is musically inclined and plays three instruments.
ex.zh: 他有音樂天分，會演奏三種樂器。

ex.en: Children are inclined to copy adults.
ex.zh: 孩子容易模仿大人。

ex.en: Doctors suggest lowering your daily salt intake.
ex.zh: 醫生建議降低每天的鹽分攝取量。

ex.en: A healthy water intake keeps your body hydrated.
ex.zh: 適量的飲水能讓身體保持水分。

ex.en: This year's student intake is larger than last year's.
ex.zh: 今年的招生人數比去年多。

ex.en: The air intake of the engine was blocked by leaves.
ex.zh: 引擎的進氣口被樹葉堵住了。

ex.en: He put the letter into the envelope.
ex.zh: 他把信放進信封裡。

ex.en: The children ran into the house.
ex.zh: 孩子們跑進了屋子裡。

ex.en: The caterpillar turned into a butterfly.
ex.zh: 毛毛蟲變成了蝴蝶。

ex.en: The car ran into a tree by the road.
ex.zh: 那輛車撞上了路邊的一棵樹。

ex.en: My sister is really into jazz music these days.
ex.zh: 我姊姊最近很迷爵士樂。

ex.en: Are you into cooking or baking?
ex.zh: 你喜歡煮菜還是烘焙？

ex.en: My neighbor is an Indian who moved here ten years ago.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居是十年前搬來這裡的印度人。

ex.en: Many Indians celebrate the festival of lights every autumn.
ex.zh: 許多印度人每年秋天都會慶祝光明節。

ex.en: We had Indian food for dinner last night.
ex.zh: 我們昨晚晚餐吃了印度菜。

ex.en: She wore a beautiful Indian dress to the wedding.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件漂亮的印度服飾去參加婚禮。

ex.en: Increased prices made many families cut back on spending.
ex.zh: 物價上漲讓許多家庭減少開銷。

ex.en: The store hired extra workers to handle the increased demand.
ex.zh: 這間店多請了人手來應付增加的需求。

ex.en: Regular exercise leads to increased energy during the day.
ex.zh: 規律運動能讓白天的精力變得更充沛。

ex.en: India has one of the largest populations in the world.
ex.zh: 印度是世界上人口最多的國家之一。

ex.en: She traveled to India to learn about its food and culture.
ex.zh: 她到印度去認識當地的飲食與文化。

ex.en: The inland areas are usually colder than the coast.
ex.zh: 內陸地區通常比海岸地區冷。

ex.en: We visited a small inland village far from the sea.
ex.zh: 我們造訪了一個遠離海邊的內陸小村莊。

ex.en: We drove inland to avoid the crowded beaches.
ex.zh: 我們開車往內陸去，躲開擁擠的海灘。

ex.en: The storm moved inland and lost much of its strength.
ex.zh: 暴風雨移往內陸後減弱了許多。

ex.en: Most of the country's farms are in the inland.
ex.zh: 這個國家的大部分農場都位於內陸地區。

ex.en: They traveled deep into the inland by horse.
ex.zh: 他們騎馬深入內陸地區旅行。

ex.en: Incidentally, did you remember to call your mother?
ex.zh: 順帶一提，你有記得打電話給你媽媽嗎？

ex.en: The meeting went well. Incidentally, Tom will join us next week.
ex.zh: 會議很順利。順帶一提，湯姆下週會加入我們。

ex.en: She discovered the old letters incidentally while cleaning the attic.
ex.zh: 她在打掃閣樓時偶然發現了那些舊信件。

ex.en: The tool was invented incidentally during another experiment.
ex.zh: 這項工具是在進行另一個實驗時偶然被發明的。

ex.en: The lawyer invoked an old law to defend his client.
ex.zh: 律師援引一條舊法律替當事人辯護。

ex.en: She invoked her right to remain silent.
ex.zh: 她行使了保持緘默的權利。

ex.en: The smell of rain invoked memories of my childhood.
ex.zh: 雨的氣味喚起了我童年的回憶。

ex.en: His speech invoked strong feelings in the audience.
ex.zh: 他的演講激起了聽眾強烈的情緒。

ex.en: Grandparents often indulge their grandchildren with sweets.
ex.zh: 祖父母常常拿糖果寵孩子。

ex.en: Parents who indulge a child's every wish may spoil him.
ex.zh: 對孩子有求必應的父母可能會把他寵壞。

ex.en: I like to indulge in a long hot bath on weekends.
ex.zh: 我週末喜歡好好泡一個長長的熱水澡犒賞自己。

ex.en: He indulged in a big slice of cake after the race.
ex.zh: 賽後他放縱自己吃了一大塊蛋糕。

ex.en: The grand jury issued an indictment against the company's former manager.
ex.zh: 大陪審團對該公司前經理提出了起訴。

ex.en: The judge read the indictment aloud in court.
ex.zh: 法官在法庭上大聲宣讀起訴書。

ex.en: Years of living together gave them a deep intimacy.
ex.zh: 多年的共同生活讓他們之間有著深厚的親密感。

ex.en: The small cafe has an atmosphere of warmth and intimacy.
ex.zh: 那間小咖啡館有一種溫暖又親近的氣氛。

ex.en: The court issued an injunction to stop the factory from dumping waste.
ex.zh: 法院發出禁制令，阻止工廠傾倒廢棄物。

ex.en: Residents asked for an injunction against the late-night construction work.
ex.zh: 居民請求法院對深夜施工發出禁制令。

ex.en: Many rare birds inhabit the wetlands near our town.
ex.zh: 許多稀有的鳥類棲息在我們鎮上附近的濕地。

ex.en: Few people inhabit this cold northern region.
ex.zh: 很少人居住在這個寒冷的北方地區。

ex.en: The old house has been inhabited by the same family for generations.
ex.zh: 這棟老房子已經由同一個家族居住了好幾代。

ex.en: An inquest was held to find out how the man had died.
ex.zh: 法院召開了驗屍審訊，以查明那名男子的死因。

ex.en: The family waited months for the inquest to begin.
ex.zh: 家屬等了好幾個月，驗屍審訊才開始。

ex.en: Indonesia is made up of thousands of islands.
ex.zh: 印尼由數千座島嶼組成。

ex.en: We spent two weeks traveling around Indonesia.
ex.zh: 我們花了兩週在印尼各地旅行。

ex.en: He seems incapable of telling a lie.
ex.zh: 他似乎不會說謊。

ex.en: The old machine is incapable of handling such a heavy load.
ex.zh: 這台舊機器無法承受這麼重的負荷。

ex.en: Her insistence on arriving early annoyed everyone.
ex.zh: 她堅持要提早到，惹得大家很煩。

ex.en: At his insistence, we took a taxi home.
ex.zh: 在他的堅持下，我們搭計程車回家。

ex.en: The grand jury decided to indict the company's former manager.
ex.zh: 大陪審團決定起訴該公司的前經理。

ex.en: He was indicted on fraud charges last month.
ex.zh: 他上個月被以詐欺罪名起訴。

ex.en: Sorry for the interruption, but you have a phone call.
ex.zh: 抱歉打擾一下，你有一通電話。

ex.en: The storm caused a brief interruption in the power supply.
ex.zh: 暴風雨造成電力供應短暫中斷。

ex.en: The suspect was held for hours of interrogation.
ex.zh: 嫌犯被審訊了好幾個小時。

ex.en: I felt like I was under interrogation when my parents asked about my trip.
ex.zh: 爸媽問起我的旅行時，我覺得自己像在被審問。

ex.en: Inhale slowly through your nose and then breathe out.
ex.zh: 用鼻子慢慢吸氣，然後再吐氣。

ex.en: Try not to inhale the dust while you clean.
ex.zh: 打掃時盡量不要吸入灰塵。

ex.en: She had an intestinal infection after the trip.
ex.zh: 她旅行回來後得了腸道感染。

ex.en: Fiber helps keep the intestinal system healthy.
ex.zh: 纖維有助於維持腸道健康。

ex.en: In 'to eat', the word 'eat' is an infinitive.
ex.zh: 在 'to eat' 中，eat 是不定詞。

ex.en: The teacher explained how to use an infinitive in a sentence.
ex.zh: 老師解釋了如何在句子裡使用不定詞。

ex.en: She is an investigative reporter who uncovers hidden stories.
ex.zh: 她是一位挖掘內幕的調查記者。

ex.en: The investigative team spent months collecting evidence.
ex.zh: 調查小組花了好幾個月蒐集證據。

ex.en: She has a natural inclination to help others.
ex.zh: 她天生就傾向於幫助別人。

ex.en: I had no inclination to go out in the rain.
ex.zh: 我完全不想在雨中出門。

ex.en: She stared intensely at the chess board before making her move.
ex.zh: 她專注地盯著棋盤，然後才走下一步。

ex.en: The sun burned intensely during the afternoon.
ex.zh: 午後的太陽烈日炎炎。

intended.zh: 打算、想要（intend 的過去式）

ex.en: I intended to call you, but I forgot.
ex.zh: 我本來打算打電話給你，卻忘了。

ex.en: She never intended to hurt anyone's feelings.
ex.zh: 她從沒打算傷害任何人的感情。

ex.en: This book is intended for beginners.
ex.zh: 這本書是為初學者而寫的。

ex.en: The room was intended for guests, but we use it as an office.
ex.zh: 這個房間原本是給客人用的，但我們把它當辦公室。

ex.en: The medicine had the intended effect within an hour.
ex.zh: 這種藥在一小時內產生了預期的效果。

ex.en: Her intended meaning was lost in the translation.
ex.zh: 她原本想表達的意思在翻譯中走了樣。

ex.en: Good interpersonal skills are important in any job.
ex.zh: 良好的人際溝通能力在任何工作中都很重要。

ex.en: They had some interpersonal problems at work.
ex.zh: 他們在工作上出現了一些人際問題。

ex.en: The remote control sends an infrared signal to the TV.
ex.zh: 遙控器向電視發送紅外線訊號。

ex.en: Doctors used an infrared camera to measure body temperature.
ex.zh: 醫護人員用紅外線攝影機測量體溫。

ex.en: Snakes can sense infrared from warm animals.
ex.zh: 蛇能感應到溫血動物發出的紅外線。

ex.en: Heat lamps give off a lot of infrared.
ex.zh: 暖燈會發出大量紅外線。

ex.en: The police got the tip from an anonymous informant.
ex.zh: 警方從一位匿名線民那裡得到消息。

ex.en: The researcher thanked each informant who shared local stories.
ex.zh: 研究者感謝每一位分享在地故事的受訪者。

ex.en: The home team scored three runs in the ninth innings.
ex.zh: 主場球隊在第九局攻下三分。

ex.en: The pitcher was tired after seven innings.
ex.zh: 投手投完七局後已經很累了。

ex.en: The school inspectorate visits every school each year.
ex.zh: 學校督導機構每年都會拜訪每所學校。

ex.en: A report from the inspectorate said the factory was safe.
ex.zh: 督察單位的報告指出這家工廠很安全。

ex.en: His inflammatory remarks made the crowd angry.
ex.zh: 他煽動性的言論激怒了群眾。

ex.en: Please avoid inflammatory language in your comments.
ex.zh: 請避免在留言中使用煽動性的措辭。

ex.en: Arthritis is an inflammatory disease of the joints.
ex.zh: 關節炎是一種關節發炎的疾病。

ex.en: The doctor gave me an inflammatory bowel disease test.
ex.zh: 醫生替我做了發炎性腸道疾病的檢查。

ex.en: The pancreas produces insulin to control blood sugar.
ex.zh: 胰臟會分泌胰島素來控制血糖。

ex.en: Some people with diabetes need insulin every day.
ex.zh: 有些糖尿病患者每天都需要注射胰島素。

ex.en: We drove along the interstate highway all day.
ex.zh: 我們整天都沿著州際公路開車。

ex.en: Interstate trade is controlled by federal law.
ex.zh: 州際貿易受聯邦法律管轄。

ex.en: The report pointed out the inadequacy of the current system.
ex.zh: 報告指出現行制度的不足。

ex.en: She felt a sense of inadequacy at her new job.
ex.zh: 她在新工作上感到能力不足。

ex.en: The road is infamous for its terrible traffic.
ex.zh: 這條路以塞車嚴重而惡名昭彰。

ex.en: He became infamous for breaking his promises.
ex.zh: 他因為常常違背承諾而惡名在外。

ex.en: Some sports are inherently dangerous.
ex.zh: 有些運動本質上就很危險。

ex.en: She is inherently curious about how things work.
ex.zh: 她天生就對事物如何運作充滿好奇。

ex.en: The intrusion of reporters upset the family.
ex.zh: 記者的打擾讓那家人很不高興。

ex.en: Police are investigating the intrusion into the building.
ex.zh: 警方正在調查有人闖入大樓的事件。

ex.en: The team scored three runs in the ninth inning.
ex.zh: 那支球隊在第九局拿下三分。

ex.en: He pitched five innings before leaving the game.
ex.zh: 他投了五局之後退場。

ex.en: The universe may keep expanding infinitely.
ex.zh: 宇宙可能會無限擴張下去。

ex.en: You cannot divide the cake infinitely.
ex.zh: 蛋糕不可能無限分下去。

ex.en: This phone is infinitely better than my old one.
ex.zh: 這支手機比我的舊手機好太多了。

ex.en: She felt infinitely grateful for their help.
ex.zh: 她對他們的幫助萬分感激。

informed.zh: 通知；告知（inform 的過去式、過去分詞）

ex.en: The school informed parents about the schedule change.
ex.zh: 學校通知家長課程表有變動。

ex.en: I was informed that the flight was delayed.
ex.zh: 我接到通知說班機延誤了。

informed.zh: 消息靈通的；見多識廣的

ex.en: She is a well-informed reader of the news.
ex.zh: 她是個對新聞很了解的讀者。

ex.en: Keep yourself informed about local events.
ex.zh: 隨時掌握地方上的消息。

ex.en: Voters should make an informed decision.
ex.zh: 選民應該做出有根據的決定。

ex.en: You need informed consent before the surgery.

ex.zh: 這個應用程式與舊款手機不相容。

ex.zh: 那塊舊石碑上的銘文很難辨認。

ex.zh: 戒指內側刻著一小行字。

ex.zh: 她內心感到一陣平靜。

ex.zh: 這扇門是往內開的，所以請輕輕推。

ex.zh: 日本是個高度工業化的國家。

ex.zh: 工業化國家消耗大量能源。

ex.zh: 她本能地從邊緣往後退了一步。

ex.zh: 嬰兒會本能地轉向聲音傳來的方向。

ex.zh: 你的密碼無效，請再試一次。

ex.zh: 這張票因為過期而無效。

ex.zh: 她照顧長年臥病在床的父親。

ex.zh: 這棟老房子為行動不便的病患蓋了一條坡道。

ex.zh: 新總統在一個晴朗的早晨發表就職演說。

ex.zh: 這家航空公司的首航昨天起飛。

ex.zh: 新當選的市長發表了簡短的就職演說。

ex.en: Many people watched his inaugural on television.
ex.zh: 許多人在電視上收看了他的就職演說。

ex.en: I pay for the laptop in monthly instalments.
ex.zh: 我分期付款買這台筆電，每月付一期。

ex.en: The first instalment is due next Friday.
ex.zh: 第一期款項下週五到期。

ex.en: Read the next instalment of the story in tomorrow's paper.
ex.zh: 這個故事的下一集請見明天的報紙。

ex.en: The latest instalment of the series came out this week.
ex.zh: 這部系列作的最新一集本週推出。

ex.en: The infected wound needed medical care.
ex.zh: 被感染的傷口需要就醫處理。

ex.en: Stay home if you think you are infected.
ex.zh: 如果你覺得自己被感染了，就留在家裡。

ex.en: The infantry marched across the open field.
ex.zh: 步兵部隊行軍穿過空曠的原野。

ex.en: He served in the infantry for two years.
ex.zh: 他在步兵部隊服役兩年。

ex.en: The inventor showed us the machine he built in his garage.
ex.zh: 那位發明家向我們展示他在車庫裡做出的機器。

ex.en: Who was the inventor of the telephone?
ex.zh: 電話的發明人是誰？

ex.en: The interception of the ball led to the winning goal.
ex.zh: 那次攔截球的動作促成了致勝的進球。

ex.en: The police warned about the interception of private messages.
ex.zh: 警方警告私人訊息可能被攔截竊聽。

ex.en: Her insecurity made her afraid to speak in meetings.
ex.zh: 她的不安全感讓她不敢在會議上發言。

ex.en: Job insecurity worries many young workers.
ex.zh: 工作沒有保障讓許多年輕人憂心。

ex.en: The match was postponed indefinitely because of the storm.
ex.zh: 比賽因暴風雨而無限期延後。

ex.en: You can't stay here indefinitely.
ex.zh: 你不能無限期待在這裡。

insignificant.zh: 無關緊要的；微不足道的

ex.en: The difference in price is insignificant.
ex.zh: 價格上的差異微不足道。

ex.en: Don't worry about such an insignificant detail.
ex.zh: 別擔心這種無關緊要的細節。

ex.en: The heat in the room was intolerable.
ex.zh: 房間裡熱得令人無法忍受。

ex.en: His rude behavior became intolerable.
ex.zh: 他的無禮行為變得讓人無法忍受。

ex.en: A smartphone has become indispensable in daily life.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機已成為日常生活中不可或缺的東西。

ex.en: She made herself indispensable to the team.
ex.zh: 她讓自己成為團隊中不可或缺的人。

ex.en: Good sleep is indispensable for your health.
ex.zh: 充足的睡眠對健康不可或缺。

ex.en: The inexperienced driver stalled the car twice.
ex.zh: 那位沒經驗的駕駛讓車子熄火了兩次。

ex.en: We hired an inexperienced but eager young designer.
ex.zh: 我們雇用了一位沒經驗但很有熱忱的年輕設計師。

ex.en: Inexperienced hikers should not climb this trail alone.
ex.zh: 沒有經驗的登山客不該獨自走這條步道。

ex.en: The city saw an influx of tourists during the festival.
ex.zh: 節慶期間，這座城市湧入大批遊客。

ex.en: An influx of new students filled the classrooms.
ex.zh: 大量新生湧入，把教室都擠滿了。

ex.en: The shop was unprepared for the sudden influx of customers.
ex.zh: 這間店對突然湧入的客人毫無準備。

ex.en: The dog barked loudly at the intruder.
ex.zh: 狗對著闖入者大聲吠叫。

ex.en: The alarm warned them of an intruder in the building.
ex.zh: 警報器通知他們大樓裡有人闖入。

ex.en: She felt like an intruder at the family dinner.
ex.zh: 在家人的晚餐上，她覺得自己像個外人。

ex.en: The old map was inaccurate and confusing.
ex.zh: 那張舊地圖不準確，還很容易讓人搞混。

ex.en: Several news reports were inaccurate.
ex.zh: 有幾則新聞報導不正確。

ex.en: An inaccurate scale can ruin your recipe.
ex.zh: 不準的秤可能會毀了你的食譜。

ex.en: The picture was hung in an inverted position.
ex.zh: 這幅畫被上下顛倒地掛著。

ex.en: An inverted pyramid has its widest part on top.
ex.zh: 倒金字塔最寬的部分在上面。

ex.en: Place the cup in an inverted position to dry.
ex.zh: 把杯子倒扣放著晾乾。

ex.en: Her instinctive reaction was to step back from the edge.
ex.zh: 她的本能反應是從邊緣退後一步。

ex.en: Babies have an instinctive ability to suck milk.
ex.zh: 嬰兒天生就有吸奶的本能。

ex.en: He has an instinctive feel for what customers want.
ex.zh: 他對顧客想要什麼有種直覺。

ex.en: The lawyer pointed out an inconsistency in his story.
ex.zh: 律師指出他的說詞有前後矛盾之處。

ex.en: There is some inconsistency between the two reports.
ex.zh: 這兩份報告之間有些不一致。

ex.en: The team was criticized for its inconsistency this season.
ex.zh: 這支球隊因本季表現起伏不定而受到批評。

ex.en: She is known for her sharp intellect and quick wit.
ex.zh: 她以敏銳的才智和機智聞名。

ex.en: The puzzle challenged even the best intellect in the room.
ex.zh: 這道謎題連房間裡最聰明的人也被考倒了。

ex.en: The mistake was not intentional, and he apologized.
ex.zh: 那個錯誤不是故意的，他也道歉了。

ex.en: The company denied any intentional damage to the environment.
ex.zh: 該公司否認有任何蓄意破壞環境的行為。

ex.en: Her use of bright colors was intentional.
ex.zh: 她使用鮮豔的顏色是有意為之。

inspired.zh: 激勵；啟發（inspire 的過去式）

ex.en: Her speech inspired many young people to volunteer.
ex.zh: 她的演說激勵了許多年輕人去當志工。

ex.en: The old story inspired him to write a song.
ex.zh: 那個老故事啟發他寫了一首歌。

ex.en: I felt inspired after visiting the art museum.
ex.zh: 參觀美術館後，我覺得充滿靈感。

ex.en: The inspired students worked hard on their project.
ex.zh: 受到鼓舞的學生們認真做他們的專題。

ex.en: Using old tires as flower pots was an inspired idea.
ex.zh: 用舊輪胎當花盆是個絕妙的點子。

ex.en: The coach made an inspired decision to change the lineup.
ex.zh: 教練調整陣容的決定十分高明。

ex.en: The coach infused the team with new energy.
ex.zh: 教練為球隊注入了新的活力。

ex.en: She infused her paintings with bright colors and joy.
ex.zh: 她讓畫作充滿鮮豔的色彩與喜悅。

ex.en: Infuse the tea leaves in hot water for three minutes.
ex.zh: 把茶葉用熱水泡三分鐘。

ex.en: The herbs were infused in oil for a week.
ex.zh: 這些香草在油裡浸泡了一個星期。

ex.en: The puzzle was intellectually challenging, but fun.
ex.zh: 這個謎題在智力上很有挑戰性，但很有趣。

ex.en: She is intellectually curious and reads about all kinds of topics.
ex.zh: 她求知欲很強，什麼主題都愛讀。

ex.en: A high fever is indicative of an infection.
ex.zh: 高燒顯示身體可能有感染。

ex.en: The results are indicative of a larger problem.
ex.zh: 這些結果顯示背後有更大的問題。

ex.en: The company was sued for copyright infringement.
ex.zh: 那家公司因侵犯著作權而被控告。

ex.en: Parking here is an infringement of the rules.
ex.zh: 在這裡停車是違反規定的。

ex.en: The student with a fever went to the school infirmary.
ex.zh: 發燒的學生去了學校的醫務室。

ex.en: The nurse in the infirmary gave him some medicine.
ex.zh: 醫務室的護理師給了他一些藥。

ex.en: The village infirmary treats minor injuries.
ex.zh: 這座村子的小醫院負責處理輕微的傷。

ex.en: An old infirmary stands next to the church.
ex.zh: 一間老舊的小醫院就在教堂旁邊。

ex.en: I inadvertently deleted the file while cleaning my desktop.
ex.zh: 我清理桌面時不小心把那個檔案刪掉了。

ex.en: She inadvertently revealed the surprise to her brother.
ex.zh: 她無意間向弟弟透露了那個驚喜。

ex.en: The insertion of the key into the lock was easy.
ex.zh: 把鑰匙插進鎖孔很容易。

ex.en: The editor suggested the insertion of a new paragraph here.
ex.zh: 編輯建議在這裡插入一個新段落。

ex.en: Food moves from the stomach into the small intestine.
ex.zh: 食物從胃進入小腸。

ex.en: The surgeon removed a small part of his intestine.
ex.zh: 外科醫生切除了他一小段腸子。

ex.en: She is learning to cook traditional Indonesian dishes.
ex.zh: 她正在學做傳統的印尼菜。

ex.en: The Indonesian islands attract millions of visitors each year.
ex.zh: 印尼的島嶼每年吸引數百萬名遊客。

ex.en: My neighbor is an Indonesian who moved here for work.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居是為了工作搬來這裡的印尼人。

ex.en: He speaks Indonesian at home with his parents.
ex.zh: 他在家裡跟父母說印尼語。

ex.en: The jeweler will inscribe your name inside the ring.
ex.zh: 珠寶師傅會把你的名字刻在戒指內側。

ex.en: Names of the soldiers were inscribed on the stone wall.
ex.zh: 士兵們的名字被刻在石牆上。

ex.en: The map has an inset showing the city center.
ex.zh: 這張地圖有一張顯示市中心的小插圖。

ex.zh: 照片角落有一小張嵌入的插圖。

ex.zh: 珠寶師傅會在戒指上鑲一顆小鑽石。

ex.en: They inset a window into the wall for more light.
ex.zh: 他們在牆上嵌了一扇窗以增加採光。

ex.zh: 這筆新資金是急需的資金挹注。

ex.en: She drank an infusion of mint leaves and hot water.
ex.zh: 她喝了一杯用薄荷葉和熱水泡的茶飲。

ex.en: The invasive plant spread quickly and harmed local species.
ex.zh: 那種入侵植物迅速蔓延，危害了本地物種。

ex.zh: 農民正在對抗一種吃掉作物的入侵昆蟲。

ex.en: The doctor said the test is not invasive and takes ten minutes.
ex.zh: 醫生說這項檢查不具侵入性，只要十分鐘。

ex.en: Patients often prefer less invasive surgery because they recover faster.
ex.zh: 病人通常偏好侵入性較小的手術，因為恢復得比較快。

ex.zh: 他一直威嚇學弟妹，直到老師出面制止。

ex.zh: 那家公司被指控恐嚇敢發聲的員工。

ex.zh: 那位經理因為不稱職而被解雇了。

ex.zh: 我在新工作的第一天覺得自己很無能。

ex.zh: 他罵他的老闆是個笨蛋，是個無能的人。

ex.zh: 他們不想再僱用一個無能的人。

ex.zh: 她在那裡住了多年，對這座城市瞭若指掌。

ex.zh: 這兩個問題息息相關。

ex.en: Many people see her as the incarnation of kindness.
ex.zh: 許多人視她為善良的化身。

ex.zh: 這部電影是那個經典故事的最新版本。

ex.zh: 經理的無能讓公司損失了不少錢。

ex.en: He was fired for gross incompetence.
ex.zh: 他因為嚴重不稱職而被解雇。

ex.en: Thousands of people attended the president's inauguration.
ex.zh: 數千人參加了總統的就職典禮。

ex.en: The mayor's inauguration will be held next Monday.
ex.zh: 市長的就職典禮將在下週一舉行。

ex.zh: 新圖書館的開幕典禮吸引了大批民眾。

ex.en: They invited us to the inauguration of the bridge.
ex.zh: 他們邀請我們參加大橋的啟用典禮。

ex.en: We were close friends despite the intervening years.
ex.zh: 儘管中間隔了這些年，我們仍是好朋友。

ex.en: The train stops at all the intervening stations.
ex.zh: 這班火車停靠中間所有的站。

intervening.zh: 介入、干預（intervene 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The teacher is intervening to stop the argument.
ex.zh: 老師正出面阻止這場爭吵。

ex.en: The government is intervening in the housing market.
ex.zh: 政府正在介入房市。

ex.en: He was insistent that we stay for dinner.
ex.zh: 他堅持要我們留下來吃晚餐。

ex.en: The insistent ring of the phone woke me up.
ex.zh: 電話那急促不停的鈴聲把我吵醒了。

ex.en: The instructions were incomprehensible to most users.
ex.zh: 這份說明書對大多數使用者來說都難以理解。

ex.en: His handwriting is almost incomprehensible.
ex.zh: 他的字跡幾乎看不懂。

ex.en: It's incomprehensible to me why she left so suddenly.
ex.zh: 我完全不懂她為什麼這麼突然就離開。

ex.en: The witnesses were afraid of intimidation by the gang.
ex.zh: 證人害怕遭到幫派的恐嚇。

ex.en: Bullying and intimidation are not allowed at our school.
ex.zh: 我們學校不容許霸凌與恐嚇。

ex.en: The museum offers an interpretive tour of the old village.
ex.zh: 博物館提供這座古村落的導覽解說行程。

ex.en: Her interpretive dance told the story of the sea.
ex.zh: 她的詮釋舞蹈述說了大海的故事。

ex.en: The castle walls were built to stop invaders.
ex.zh: 城堡的牆是為了阻擋入侵者而建的。

ex.en: The small town fought bravely against the invaders.
ex.zh: 這座小鎮英勇抵抗入侵者。

ex.en: Some invader plants harm local forests.
ex.zh: 有些外來入侵植物會危害本地森林。

insanity.zh: 瘋狂；精神錯亂；荒唐的行為

ex.en: The man was found not guilty by reason of insanity.
ex.zh: 那名男子因精神錯亂被判無罪。

ex.en: Driving in this heavy traffic is pure insanity.
ex.zh: 在這種大塞車中開車簡直是瘋了。

ex.en: Sneezing is an involuntary action of the body.
ex.zh: 打噴嚏是身體不由自主的反應。

ex.en: He let out an involuntary cry when the spider appeared.
ex.zh: 蜘蛛出現時，他不由自主地叫了一聲。

ex.en: Involuntary movements can be a sign of illness.
ex.zh: 不自主的動作可能是疾病的徵兆。

ex.en: She shows her individuality through the clothes she wears.
ex.zh: 她透過穿著展現自己的個性。

ex.en: The school encourages students to express their individuality.
ex.zh: 學校鼓勵學生展現自己的獨特個性。

ex.en: The small shop has a strong sense of individuality.
ex.zh: 這家小店有很鮮明的獨特風格。

ex.zh: 她的兒子在嬰幼兒時期常常生病。

ex.en: The technology is still in its infancy.
ex.zh: 這項技術仍處於起步階段。

ex.en: The plan is fine insofar as it saves money.
ex.zh: 就省錢這一點而言，這個計畫還不錯。

ex.en: I agree with you insofar as safety is concerned.
ex.zh: 就安全方面而言，我同意你。

ex.en: Insofar as I know, the store is still open.
ex.zh: 就我所知，那家店還有營業。

ex.en: The hotel charges no incidental fees.
ex.zh: 這間旅館不收額外的雜費。

ex.en: That is an incidental detail, not the main point.
ex.zh: 那只是個次要的細節，不是重點。

ex.en: Take the next interchange and head toward the airport.
ex.zh: 下個交流道下去，往機場的方向走。

ex.en: The new interchange should reduce traffic jams in the area.
ex.zh: 新的交流道應該能減少這一帶的塞車。

ex.en: The two friends interchanged phone numbers before leaving.
ex.zh: 兩位朋友臨走前互相交換了電話號碼。

ex.en: You can interchange these two words in this sentence without changing the meaning.
ex.zh: 在這個句子裡，你可以把這兩個字互換，意思不變。

ex.en: The speech was a call to end intolerance in our communities.
ex.zh: 這場演說呼籲終結社區裡的不寬容。

ex.en: His intolerance of other opinions made meetings difficult.
ex.zh: 他容不下其他意見，讓開會變得很困難。

ex.en: She has a lactose intolerance and avoids milk.
ex.zh: 她有乳糖不耐症，所以不喝牛奶。

ex.en: Food intolerance can cause stomach pain and headaches.
ex.zh: 食物不耐受可能造成胃痛和頭痛。

ex.en: Copying the songs without permission would infringe the artist's rights.
ex.zh: 未經許可複製這些歌曲會侵犯藝術家的權利。

ex.en: The new rule infringes on our freedom to choose.
ex.zh: 這項新規定侵犯了我們選擇的自由。

ex.en: The company was sued for infringing a patent.
ex.zh: 這家公司因侵犯專利而被告。

ex.en: Her inspiring speech made everyone want to work harder.
ex.zh: 她鼓舞人心的演說讓大家都想更努力。

ex.en: He is an inspiring teacher who helps students believe in themselves.
ex.zh: 他是一位能啟發學生的老師，讓學生相信自己。

ex.en: We watched an inspiring story about a girl who built a school.
ex.zh: 我們看了一個女孩建造學校的激勵人心的故事。

ex.en: We insulated the roof to keep the house warm in winter.
ex.zh: 我們替屋頂做了隔熱，讓房子冬天保暖。

ex.en: Rubber is used to insulate electrical wires.
ex.zh: 橡膠被用來使電線絕緣。

ex.en: Thick walls insulate the room from street noise.
ex.zh: 厚牆使房間隔絕了街上的噪音。

ex.en: The show was removed from television for indecent language.
ex.zh: 這個節目因為下流的用語而被電視台下架。

ex.en: It is indecent to laugh at someone's misfortune.
ex.zh: 嘲笑別人的不幸是不得體的。

ex.en: He was fined for indecent behavior in public.
ex.zh: 他因為在公共場所舉止不檢而被罰款。

ex.en: The club has grown a great deal since its inception in 1995.
ex.zh: 這個社團自1995年成立以來成長了許多。

ex.en: From its inception, the project faced serious problems.
ex.zh: 這個專案從一開始就面臨嚴重的問題。

ex.en: Reporters tried to infiltrate the secret meeting.
ex.zh: 記者試圖潛入那場秘密會議。

ex.en: Water can infiltrate the soil very slowly.
ex.zh: 水會非常緩慢地滲入土壤。

ex.en: Spies had infiltrated the organization for years.
ex.zh: 間諜多年來一直滲透在這個組織中。

ex.en: The police interrogated the suspect for three hours.
ex.zh: 警方審問了嫌犯三個小時。

ex.en: Don't interrogate me every time I come home late.
ex.zh: 別每次我晚回家就像審犯人一樣盤問我。

ex.en: Individualism is highly valued in many Western countries.
ex.zh: 許多西方國家十分重視個人主義。

ex.en: Some people think individualism weakens community spirit.
ex.zh: 有些人認為個人主義會削弱社區精神。

ex.en: She is investing her savings in a small business.
ex.zh: 她正把積蓄投資在一家小生意上。

ex.en: Investing early gives your money more time to grow.
ex.zh: 及早投資能讓你的錢有更多時間成長。

ex.en: Investing requires patience and a clear plan.
ex.zh: 投資需要耐心和清楚的計畫。

ex.en: He read several books about investing last year.
ex.zh: 他去年讀了幾本關於投資的書。

internalize.zh: 內化；使成為內在的想法

ex.en: Children often internalize the values they see at home.
ex.zh: 孩子常會把在家裡看到的價值觀內化。

ex.en: It took him years to internalize the rules of the language.
ex.zh: 他花了好幾年才把這個語言的規則內化。

ex.en: The patient received intravenous fluids at the hospital.
ex.zh: 病人在醫院接受了靜脈輸液。

ex.en: The nurse set up an intravenous drip for him.
ex.zh: 護理師幫他裝上了靜脈點滴。

ex.en: The hen sat on the eggs to incubate them.
ex.zh: 母雞坐在蛋上孵蛋。

ex.en: The lab will incubate the samples overnight at a warm temperature.
ex.zh: 實驗室會把樣本在溫暖的環境中培養一整晚。

ex.en: The university helps young companies incubate new ideas.
ex.zh: 這所大學協助新創公司孕育新點子。

ex.en: The plan had time to incubate in her mind before she shared it.
ex.zh: 這個計畫在她心裡醞釀了一段時間才說出來。

ex.en: This drug is an inhibitor that slows the growth of the virus.
ex.zh: 這種藥是一種抑制劑，能減緩病毒的生長。

ex.en: Fear can be a strong inhibitor of creativity.
ex.zh: 恐懼可能是扼殺創意的強大因素。

ex.en: The number 7 is an integer, but 7.5 is not.
ex.zh: 7 是整數，但 7.5 不是。

ex.en: Enter a positive integer between one and ten.
ex.zh: 請輸入一到十之間的正整數。

ex.en: The two roads intersect near the old train station.
ex.zh: 這兩條路在舊火車站附近交會。

ex.en: Draw two lines that intersect at a right angle.
ex.zh: 畫兩條互相垂直相交的線。

ex.en: The constant phone calls felt very intrusive.
ex.zh: 不斷打來的電話讓人覺得非常打擾。

ex.en: Many people find intrusive questions about their salary rude.
ex.zh: 許多人覺得被追問薪水這類打探隱私的問題很失禮。

ex.en: Innumerable stars shine in the night sky.
ex.zh: 夜空中閃爍著無數顆星星。

ex.en: She has told me that story innumerable times.
ex.zh: 那個故事她已經對我說過無數次了。

ex.en: Our new office is inconvenient for people without a car.
ex.zh: 我們的新辦公室對沒有車的人來說很不方便。

ex.en: Is it inconvenient for you to meet at noon?
ex.zh: 中午見面對你來說不方便嗎？

inaccessible.zh: 難以到達的；無法取得的

ex.en: The village is inaccessible by car in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天時，這個村莊無法開車抵達。

ex.en: Many old buildings are inaccessible to people in wheelchairs.
ex.zh: 許多老建築是坐輪椅的人進不去的。

ex.en: I incorrectly spelled her name on the card.
ex.zh: 我把她的名字拼錯寫在卡片上。

ex.en: The form was filled out incorrectly, so we had to start again.
ex.zh: 表格填寫錯誤，所以我們得重來一次。

ex.en: The company wants to institutionalize regular safety training.
ex.zh: 公司想把定期的安全訓練制度化。

ex.en: The new rules institutionalized the practice of public hearings.
ex.zh: 新規定把舉行公聽會的做法制度化。

insensitive.zh: 不體貼的、不顧別人感受的

ex.en: It was insensitive of him to joke about her illness.
ex.zh: 他拿她的病開玩笑真是太不體貼了。

ex.en: Her insensitive comments hurt his feelings.
ex.zh: 她不顧他人感受的話傷了他的心。

insensitive.zh: 感覺遲鈍的、對…沒感覺的

ex.en: His fingers became insensitive to the cold.
ex.zh: 他的手指對寒冷變得麻木。

ex.en: The tooth is insensitive to hot drinks after the treatment.
ex.zh: 治療後這顆牙對熱飲不再有感覺。

ex.en: His visits to the city are infrequent these days.
ex.zh: 他近來很少來這座城市。

ex.en: Snow is infrequent in this part of the country.
ex.zh: 這個地區很少下雪。

ex.en: Chocolate is my one small indulgence.
ex.zh: 巧克力是我唯一小小的享受。

ex.en: His indulgence in sweets caused many dental problems.
ex.zh: 他沉迷甜食，造成不少牙齒問題。

ex.en: I'd like to ask for your indulgence while I explain.
ex.zh: 我解釋時想請你多包涵。

ex.en: The teacher's indulgence made the children careless.
ex.zh: 老師的縱容讓孩子們變得散漫。

ex.en: The twins are almost indistinguishable from each other.
ex.zh: 這對雙胞胎幾乎無法分辨。

ex.en: From far away, the two paths were indistinguishable.
ex.zh: 從遠處看，這兩條小路根本分不出來。

ex.en: The door opens inwards, so push gently.
ex.zh: 這扇門是向內開的，所以要輕輕推。

ex.en: The petals curled inwards as night came.
ex.zh: 夜晚來臨時，花瓣向內捲起。

ex.en: We had intermittent rain all afternoon.
ex.zh: 我們整個下午斷斷續續地下雨。

ex.en: The signal is intermittent in the mountains.
ex.zh: 山區的訊號時有時無。

ex.en: The two friends have been inseparable since childhood.
ex.zh: 這兩個朋友從小就形影不離。

ex.en: Culture and language are inseparable.
ex.zh: 文化與語言密不可分。

ex.en: Inertia keeps a moving object moving unless a force stops it.
ex.zh: 除非有力量阻止，慣性會讓運動中的物體持續運動。

ex.en: Passengers lean forward because of inertia when the bus stops.
ex.zh: 公車停下時，乘客因為慣性而向前傾。

ex.en: Inertia kept him from changing jobs.
ex.zh: 惰性讓他一直沒換工作。

ex.en: Many people stay in the same habits out of inertia.
ex.zh: 許多人出於惰性而維持相同的習慣。

ex.en: The speaker was arrested for inciting a riot.
ex.zh: 那名演說者因煽動暴動而被捕。

ex.en: Some posts online incite hatred against others.
ex.zh: 網路上有些貼文會煽動對他人的仇恨。

ex.en: It was inconceivable that he would forget her birthday.
ex.zh: 他居然會忘記她的生日，實在難以想像。

ex.en: Such a sudden change seemed inconceivable a year ago.
ex.zh: 一年前，這樣突然的改變是難以想像的。

ex.en: Good teachers instil confidence in their students.
ex.zh: 好老師會逐漸為學生建立自信。

ex.en: Parents try to instil good manners in their children.
ex.zh: 父母努力在孩子心中培養良好的禮貌。

ex.en: I was intrigued by the strange old map.
ex.zh: 那張奇特的舊地圖讓我很好奇。

ex.en: She looked intrigued when he mentioned the secret.
ex.zh: 他提到那個祕密時，她顯得很感興趣。

intrigued.zh: 引起興趣（intrigue 的過去式）

ex.en: The mystery intrigued the whole class.
ex.zh: 這個謎團引起了全班的好奇。

ex.en: His strange story intrigued me.
ex.zh: 他那個奇怪的故事勾起了我的興趣。

ex.en: The vines intertwined around the old fence.
ex.zh: 藤蔓纏繞在舊圍籬上。

ex.en: Their lives became intertwined after they moved in together.
ex.zh: 他們住在一起之後，生活變得密不可分。

ex.en: Her inspirational speech moved the whole audience.
ex.zh: 她鼓舞人心的演說打動了全場觀眾。

ex.en: I read an inspirational story about a runner who never gave up.
ex.zh: 我讀了一個關於跑者永不放棄的勵志故事。

ex.en: Who instigated the argument at the meeting?
ex.zh: 是誰在會議上挑起這場爭論的？

ex.en: The mayor plans to instigate a review of traffic rules.
ex.zh: 市長打算發起對交通規則的檢討。

ex.en: We met informally over coffee to talk about the project.
ex.zh: 我們喝咖啡時不拘形式地討論了這個專案。

ex.en: Everyone dressed informally for the company picnic.
ex.zh: 大家為公司野餐穿著輕便。

instructive.zh: 有教育意義的；有啟發的

ex.en: The museum visit was fun and instructive.
ex.zh: 這次參觀博物館既好玩又有啟發。

ex.en: It is instructive to compare the two reports.
ex.zh: 比較這兩份報告很有啟發性。

ex.en: The inexplicable noise kept us awake all night.
ex.zh: 那個無法解釋的聲音讓我們整晚睡不著。

ex.en: Her sudden decision to leave seemed inexplicable to us.
ex.zh: 她突然決定離開，我們覺得無法理解。

ex.en: The company offered a bonus as an inducement to stay.
ex.zh: 公司提供獎金作為留任的誘因。

ex.en: Free gifts are an inducement to buy more.
ex.zh: 贈品是刺激人們多買的誘因。

ex.en: They are an interracial couple who met at university.
ex.zh: 他們是在大學認識的跨種族情侶。

ex.en: The school promotes interracial friendship among students.
ex.zh: 學校鼓勵學生之間跨種族的友誼。

ex.en: The movie is about interstellar travel in the far future.
ex.zh: 這部電影談的是遙遠未來的星際旅行。

ex.en: Interstellar space is almost completely empty.
ex.zh: 星際空間幾乎是完全空無一物的。

ex.en: The interplay of light and shadow makes the painting special.
ex.zh: 光與影的交互作用讓這幅畫與眾不同。

ex.en: Scientists study the interplay between diet and health.
ex.zh: 科學家研究飲食與健康之間的交互影響。

ex.en: Helium is an inert gas and does not burn.
ex.zh: 氦是一種惰性氣體，不會燃燒。

ex.en: The inert metal did not react with the acid.
ex.zh: 這種惰性金屬不與酸起反應。

ex.en: He lay inert on the couch all afternoon.
ex.zh: 他整個下午一動也不動地躺在沙發上。

ex.en: The market stayed inert despite the good news.
ex.zh: 儘管有好消息，市場仍然死氣沉沉。

ex.en: She inherited a small house from her aunt.
ex.zh: 她從阿姨那裡繼承了一間小房子。

ex.en: He inherited the family business at thirty.
ex.zh: 他三十歲時繼承了家族事業。

ex.en: Blue eyes are an inherited trait in her family.
ex.zh: 藍眼睛是她家族遺傳來的特徵。

ex.en: The new manager faced inherited problems from the last team.
ex.zh: 新經理要面對前一個團隊留下來的問題。

ex.en: The new president will be inaugurated in January.
ex.zh: 新總統將在一月宣誓就職。

ex.en: They inaugurated the mayor in a short ceremony.
ex.zh: 他們在簡短的儀式中讓市長就職。

ex.en: The city will inaugurate the new library next week.
ex.zh: 市政府下週將為新圖書館舉行啟用儀式。

ex.en: They inaugurated the bridge with a big celebration.
ex.zh: 他們以盛大的慶祝活動為這座橋啟用。

ex.en: Many couples face infertility and seek medical help.
ex.zh: 許多夫妻面臨不孕問題而尋求醫療協助。

ex.en: The doctor explained the possible causes of infertility.
ex.zh: 醫生說明了不孕的可能原因。

ex.en: The infertility of the soil made farming difficult.
ex.zh: 土壤貧瘠讓耕作變得很困難。

ex.en: Poor rainfall led to the infertility of the land.
ex.zh: 雨量不足導致土地貧瘠。

ex.en: Infidelity was the main reason for their divorce.
ex.zh: 外遇是他們離婚的主要原因。

ex.en: She forgave him for his infidelity.
ex.zh: 她原諒了他的不忠。

ex.en: The trip was delayed for an indefinite period.
ex.zh: 這趟旅程被無限期延後。

ex.en: I have indefinite plans for the weekend.
ex.zh: 我週末的計畫還不確定。

ex.en: The temple smelled of burning incense.
ex.zh: 這間廟裡瀰漫著燃香的味道。

ex.en: She lit a stick of incense before meditating.
ex.zh: 她在冥想前點了一根香。

ex.en: The unfair decision incensed the fans.
ex.zh: 這個不公平的判決激怒了球迷。

ex.en: His rude comment incensed everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 他無禮的話激怒了房間裡的每個人。

ex.en: Parents try to instill good manners in their children.
ex.zh: 父母努力在孩子身上培養好禮貌。

ex.en: The coach instilled confidence in the young players.
ex.zh: 教練讓年輕球員逐漸建立起自信。

ex.en: The plane's instrumentation shows speed, height and direction.
ex.zh: 飛機的儀表顯示速度、高度和方向。

ex.en: The lab spent a lot of money on new instrumentation.
ex.zh: 實驗室花了很多錢購買新的儀器設備。

ex.en: The composer is known for the rich instrumentation of his symphonies.
ex.zh: 這位作曲家以交響曲豐富的樂器編配而聞名。

ex.en: The song's simple instrumentation puts the focus on her voice.
ex.zh: 這首歌簡單的樂器編配讓焦點集中在她的歌聲上。

ex.en: The report points out the inequity in how schools are funded.
ex.zh: 報告指出學校經費分配上的不公平。

ex.en: Workers protested against the inequity in pay between men and women.
ex.zh: 員工抗議男女薪資的不公平。

ex.en: The little girl asked innocently why the sky was blue.
ex.zh: 小女孩天真地問天空為什麼是藍色的。

ex.en: He smiled innocently while hiding the broken cup behind him.
ex.zh: 他一邊天真無邪地微笑，一邊把破杯子藏在身後。

ex.en: The judge ordered a long period of incarceration.
ex.zh: 法官判處了長期監禁。

ex.en: Many people argue about the cost of mass incarceration.
ex.zh: 許多人爭論大規模監禁的成本。

ex.en: The officer wore the insignia of his rank on his shoulder.
ex.zh: 軍官肩上戴著他階級的徽章。

ex.en: The school insignia is sewn onto every uniform.
ex.zh: 每件制服上都縫著校徽。

ex.en: The interdependence of countries makes global trade possible.
ex.zh: 各國之間的相互依賴使全球貿易成為可能。

ex.en: The film shows the interdependence between humans and nature.
ex.zh: 這部電影展現了人類與自然之間的相互依存。

ex.en: She is an inventive cook who never follows a recipe exactly.
ex.zh: 她是個很有創意的廚師，從不完全照食譜做。

ex.en: The children came up with an inventive way to reuse old boxes.
ex.zh: 孩子們想出了一個重複利用舊紙箱的巧妙辦法。

ex.en: The company hired inventive engineers to design the new phone.
ex.zh: 公司聘請了富有創造力的工程師來設計新手機。

ex.en: My account has been inactive for over a year.
ex.zh: 我的帳號已經超過一年沒有使用了。

ex.en: He became inactive after he hurt his knee.
ex.zh: 他傷了膝蓋後就變得不愛活動了。

ex.en: The volcano has been inactive for hundreds of years.
ex.zh: 那座火山已經沉寂了數百年。

ex.en: Cancer can be an insidious disease because it shows no early signs.
ex.zh: 癌症可能是種潛伏的疾病，因為早期沒有徵兆。

ex.en: The insidious effects of stress build up slowly over the years.
ex.zh: 壓力的隱性影響會在多年間慢慢累積。

ex.en: He used insidious rumors to ruin her reputation.
ex.zh: 他用陰險的謠言毀了她的名聲。

ex.en: The boat anchored in a quiet inlet along the coast.
ex.zh: 船在沿岸一個平靜的小海灣下錨。

ex.en: Leaves blocked the water inlet of the pool.
ex.zh: 落葉堵住了泳池的進水口。

ex.en: The judge decided to incarcerate him for two years.
ex.zh: 法官決定判他入獄兩年。

ex.en: Some people argue we incarcerate too many people for minor crimes.
ex.zh: 有些人認為我們為了輕微罪行關了太多人。

insightful.zh: 有洞察力的；見解深刻的

ex.en: She gave an insightful answer that surprised the teacher.
ex.zh: 她給了一個見解深刻的回答，讓老師很驚訝。

ex.en: This is an insightful article about how people learn.
ex.zh: 這是一篇討論人如何學習、見解深刻的文章。

ex.en: Industrialised countries use a lot of energy.
ex.zh: 工業化國家使用大量能源。

ex.en: The region became heavily industrialised in the last century.
ex.zh: 這個地區在上個世紀高度工業化。

inflated.zh: 膨脹的；誇大的；（價格）過高的

ex.en: The children played with a big inflated ball.
ex.zh: 孩子們玩著一顆充飽氣的大球。

ex.en: The shop charges inflated prices near the tourist spots.
ex.zh: 這家店在景點附近的價格被哄抬得很高。

ex.en: He has an inflated opinion of his own skills.
ex.zh: 他對自己的能力評價過高。

ex.en: The report gave inflated numbers to impress investors.
ex.zh: 這份報告為了打動投資人而浮報了數字。

ex.en: He smiled, but inwardly he was very nervous.
ex.zh: 他面帶微笑，但心裡其實非常緊張。

ex.en: She inwardly cheered when her name was called.
ex.zh: 聽到自己的名字被叫到，她在心裡歡呼。

ex.en: Each student receives an individualized learning plan.
ex.zh: 每位學生都會拿到量身訂做的學習計畫。

ex.en: The clinic offers individualized care for every patient.
ex.zh: 這間診所為每位病人提供個別化的照護。

ex.en: The interviewee looked nervous but answered every question clearly.
ex.zh: 受訪者看起來很緊張，但每個問題都回答得很清楚。

ex.en: Each interviewee had thirty minutes to explain their experience.
ex.zh: 每位面試者都有三十分鐘說明自己的經歷。

inescapable.zh: 無法逃避的、不可避免的

ex.en: After the long meeting, the conclusion seemed inescapable.
ex.zh: 開了那場長會後，這個結論似乎無可避免。

ex.en: Change is an inescapable part of life.
ex.zh: 改變是生活中不可避免的一部分。

inundate.zh: 使被大量湧入的東西淹沒；使應接不暇

ex.en: The office was inundated with phone calls after the ad aired.
ex.zh: 廣告播出後，辦公室被來電淹沒了。

ex.en: Customers inundate the shop on the first day of the sale.
ex.zh: 特賣第一天，顧客湧入店裡，擠得水洩不通。

ex.en: Heavy rain may inundate the low-lying fields.
ex.zh: 大雨可能會淹沒低窪的農田。

ex.en: The river burst its banks and inundated the village.
ex.zh: 河水潰堤，淹沒了村莊。

ex.en: Rapid industrialisation changed the way people lived and worked.
ex.zh: 快速的工業化改變了人們的生活與工作方式。

ex.en: The country's industrialisation began in the late nineteenth century.
ex.zh: 這個國家的工業化始於十九世紀末。

ex.en: The intelligentsia debated the new policy in newspapers.
ex.zh: 知識分子階層在報紙上討論這項新政策。

ex.en: Writers and professors belong to the intelligentsia.
ex.zh: 作家和教授屬於知識階層。

ex.en: The temperature rose in small increments throughout the day.
ex.zh: 氣溫在一整天裡一點一點地上升。

ex.en: Employees get a pay increment every year.
ex.zh: 員工每年都會加薪。

ex.en: His rude comments always infuriate me.
ex.zh: 他無禮的言論總是讓我很火大。

ex.en: The long delay began to infuriate the passengers.
ex.zh: 漫長的延誤開始激怒乘客。

ex.en: Incontinence is common among older adults.
ex.zh: 失禁在年長者之間很常見。

ex.en: Exercise can help improve bladder incontinence.
ex.zh: 運動有助於改善膀胱失禁。

ex.en: The incubation of chicken eggs takes about twenty-one days.
ex.zh: 雞蛋的孵化大約需要二十一天。

ex.en: The eggs need steady heat during incubation.
ex.zh: 蛋在孵化期間需要穩定的溫度。

ex.en: The flu has an incubation period of a few days.
ex.zh: 流感的潛伏期大約是幾天。

ex.en: The idea went through a long incubation before it became a product.
ex.zh: 這個點子經過長時間的醞釀才成為產品。

ex.en: Indexing the whole book took the editor two weeks.
ex.zh: 替整本書編索引花了編輯兩週。

ex.en: Good indexing helps readers find topics quickly.
ex.zh: 好的索引能幫助讀者快速找到主題。

ex.en: She is a famous innovator in the field of medicine.
ex.zh: 她是醫療領域著名的創新者。

ex.en: The company wants to hire young innovators with fresh ideas.
ex.zh: 公司想找有新想法的年輕創新人才。

ex.en: The museum gives out informational brochures at the door.
ex.zh: 博物館在門口發放介紹資訊的小冊子。

ex.en: This is an informational meeting, so no decisions will be made.
ex.zh: 這是資訊說明會，所以不會做出任何決定。

ex.en: She interspersed her speech with funny stories.
ex.zh: 她在演講中穿插了一些有趣的故事。

ex.en: The garden is interspersed with small ponds and stone paths.
ex.zh: 這座花園裡點綴著小池塘和石頭小徑。

intractable.zh: 棘手的；難以處理的；倔強的

ex.en: Traffic in the city has become an intractable problem.
ex.zh: 這座城市的交通已成為棘手的難題。

ex.en: The old horse was so intractable that no one could ride it.
ex.zh: 那匹老馬非常倔強，沒有人騎得動。

ex.en: It rained intermittently throughout the afternoon.
ex.zh: 整個下午雨斷斷續續地下著。

ex.en: He has worked on the book intermittently for ten years.
ex.zh: 他斷斷續續寫這本書已經十年了。

ex.en: The hospital has beds for two hundred inpatients.
ex.zh: 這家醫院有兩百張住院病人的床位。

ex.en: As an inpatient, she stayed in the ward for a week.
ex.zh: 她以住院病人的身分在病房待了一週。

ex.en: My boss is inflexible about work hours.
ex.zh: 我的老闆在上班時間上毫不通融。

ex.en: An inflexible plan can fail when things change.
ex.zh: 死板的計畫在情況改變時可能會失敗。

ex.en: The plastic was stiff and inflexible in the cold.
ex.zh: 那塊塑膠在低溫下又硬又不能彎曲。

ex.en: An inflexible rod can't bend around the corner.
ex.zh: 一根不能彎的桿子無法繞過轉角。

ex.en: She accepted the inevitability of change.
ex.zh: 她接受了改變是無可避免的事實。

ex.en: The inevitability of the result made the game boring.
ex.zh: 結果早已注定，讓比賽變得很無趣。

ex.en: I am deeply indebted to my teacher for her help.
ex.zh: 我非常感激老師的幫助。

ex.en: We are indebted to our neighbors for looking after the house.
ex.zh: 我們欠鄰居一份人情，他們幫忙照看了房子。

ex.en: The company became heavily indebted after the failed project.
ex.zh: 那個專案失敗後，公司負債累累。

ex.en: They are indebted to the bank for the new house.
ex.zh: 他們為了新房子欠銀行錢。

ex.en: I admired the intricacy of the lace pattern.
ex.zh: 我很欣賞這蕾絲花紋的精細。

ex.en: The intricacy of the tax rules confuses many people.
ex.zh: 稅法的錯綜複雜讓許多人搞不懂。

ex.en: The new store has made inroads into the local market.
ex.zh: 這家新店已開始打進當地市場。

ex.en: Online shopping has made big inroads on traditional retail.
ex.zh: 網路購物已大幅侵蝕傳統零售業。

ex.en: The glacier moved inexorably down the valley.
ex.zh: 冰河無可阻擋地沿著山谷往下移動。

ex.en: Time passes inexorably, whether we are ready or not.
ex.zh: 時間無情地流逝，不管我們準備好了沒有。

ex.en: He was inept at cooking and burned the rice again.
ex.zh: 他不擅長做菜，又把飯燒焦了。

ex.en: The inept handling of the crisis made things worse.
ex.zh: 對危機的處理失當讓情況更糟。

ex.en: His harsh words only inflamed the argument.
ex.zh: 他嚴厲的話只是讓爭吵更激烈。

ex.en: Spicy food can inflame a sore stomach.
ex.zh: 辛辣食物會使不舒服的胃發炎。

ex.en: The army made a brief incursion across the border.
ex.zh: 軍隊短暫地越過邊界突襲。

ex.en: Wild boars made an incursion into the village garden.
ex.zh: 野豬闖進了村裡的菜園。

inextricably.zh: 密不可分地；糾纏不清地

ex.en: Language is inextricably linked to culture.
ex.zh: 語言與文化密不可分。

ex.en: Their lives became inextricably tied together.
ex.zh: 他們的人生變得緊緊相連。

ex.en: The old building was inadequately protected from fire.
ex.zh: 那棟老建築的防火措施不足。

ex.en: Many students feel inadequately prepared for the exam.
ex.zh: 許多學生覺得自己對考試準備得不夠。

ex.en: Indiscriminate use of antibiotics can be harmful.
ex.zh: 濫用抗生素可能有害。

ex.en: The storm caused indiscriminate damage across the town.
ex.zh: 暴風雨在全鎮造成不分對象的破壞。

ex.en: It was an innocuous joke, so nobody minded.
ex.zh: 那只是個無傷大雅的玩笑，所以沒人在意。

ex.en: The insect looks scary but is actually innocuous.
ex.zh: 這種昆蟲看起來嚇人，其實是無害的。

ex.en: Their ineffectual efforts did not stop the flooding.
ex.zh: 他們徒勞的努力沒能阻止淹水。

ex.en: He was a kind but ineffectual leader.
ex.zh: 他是個善良卻無能的領導者。

ex.en: She gave me an incredulous look when I told her the price.
ex.zh: 我告訴她價錢時，她投以難以置信的眼神。

ex.en: He sounded incredulous when he heard the news.
ex.zh: 他聽到消息時語氣充滿不敢置信。

ex.en: The report contained several inaccuracies about the event.
ex.zh: 這份報告對該事件有幾處不準確的地方。

ex.en: The inaccuracy of the old map caused us to get lost.
ex.zh: 那張舊地圖不準確，害我們迷路了。

ex.en: He visits his hometown only infrequently.
ex.zh: 他很少回老家。

ex.en: Buses run infrequently on Sundays.
ex.zh: 星期日公車班次很少。

ex.en: The prisoners were kept in inhuman conditions.
ex.zh: 囚犯被關在不人道的環境中。

ex.en: It would be inhuman to leave them out in the cold.
ex.zh: 把他們丟在寒冷中不管是很不人道的。

ex.en: The quiet walk was a pleasant interlude in a busy week.
ex.zh: 安靜的散步是忙碌一週中愉快的插曲。

ex.en: The band played a short interlude between the two acts.
ex.zh: 樂團在兩幕之間演奏了一段短短的間奏。

ex.en: The effect of the medicine was almost instantaneous.
ex.zh: 這種藥的效果幾乎是立即的。

ex.en: Online messages allow instantaneous communication across the world.
ex.zh: 網路訊息讓全世界能即時溝通。

ex.en: The interminable meeting lasted for four hours.
ex.zh: 那場冗長的會議開了四小時。

ex.en: We waited in an interminable line at the bank.
ex.zh: 我們在銀行排了一條看不到盡頭的隊伍。

ex.en: She suffered the indignity of being searched in public.
ex.zh: 她遭受在公開場合被搜身的羞辱。

ex.en: Losing his job was bad enough, but the way it happened was an indignity.
ex.zh: 丟了工作已夠糟，而事情發生的方式更是一種侮辱。

ex.en: A modern sofa looked incongruous in the old farmhouse.
ex.zh: 現代沙發在老農舍裡顯得格格不入。

ex.en: His cheerful tone was incongruous with the sad news.
ex.zh: 他愉快的語氣和這則悲傷的消息不搭調。

ex.en: Children should not ingest cleaning products.
ex.zh: 孩子不該吞下清潔用品。

ex.en: The body can ingest and use many kinds of vitamins.
ex.zh: 身體可以攝取並利用多種維生素。

ex.en: Using a wrong date can invalidate your ticket.
ex.zh: 寫錯日期可能使你的票失效。

ex.en: The new evidence may invalidate the earlier results.
ex.zh: 新的證據可能使先前的結果無效。

ex.en: The company is making inroads into the Asian market.
ex.zh: 這家公司正逐步打進亞洲市場。

ex.en: Spending on rent has made inroads into our savings.
ex.zh: 房租的開銷已經侵蝕了我們的存款。

ex.en: Health and diet are closely interrelated.
ex.zh: 健康與飲食息息相關。

ex.en: The two problems are interrelated and must be solved together.
ex.zh: 這兩個問題互相關聯，必須一起解決。

ex.en: Long periods of inactivity are bad for your health.
ex.zh: 長時間不活動對健康不好。

ex.en: Months of inactivity left the machine rusty.
ex.zh: 幾個月的閒置讓機器生鏽了。

ex.en: The government was criticized for its inaction.
ex.zh: 政府因無所作為而受到批評。

ex.en: His inaction made the problem worse.
ex.zh: 他的不作為讓問題更嚴重。

ex.en: The inexorable rise of prices worried every family.
ex.zh: 物價不可阻擋地上漲，讓每個家庭都很擔心。

ex.en: They watched the inexorable advance of the storm.
ex.zh: 他們看著暴風雨無情地逼近。

ex.en: The puzzle has interlocking pieces.
ex.zh: 這個拼圖的每一片都互相嵌合。

ex.en: The floor is made of interlocking tiles.
ex.zh: 這個地板是用可相互扣合的磁磚鋪成的。

ex.en: Farmers spray insecticide on the crops.
ex.zh: 農夫在作物上噴灑殺蟲劑。

ex.en: Keep the insecticide away from children.
ex.zh: 殺蟲劑要放在孩子拿不到的地方。

ex.en: The school takes an integrative approach to learning.
ex.zh: 這所學校採用整合式的學習方式。

ex.en: She works in integrative medicine.
ex.zh: 她從事整合醫學的工作。

ex.en: I had no inkling that she was leaving.
ex.zh: 我完全沒料到她要離開。

ex.en: He gave us an inkling of what the plan was.
ex.zh: 他讓我們隱約知道了計畫的內容。

ex.en: Rocks and tables are inanimate objects.
ex.zh: 岩石和桌子是無生命的物體。

ex.en: The child talked to his inanimate toys as if they were alive.
ex.zh: 這孩子對著沒有生命的玩具說話，好像它們是活的。

ex.en: The shortstop threw the ball across the infield.
ex.zh: 游擊手把球傳過內野。

ex.en: The infield was wet after the rain.
ex.zh: 下過雨後，內野場地是濕的。

ex.en: The kids played in an inflatable pool in the garden.
ex.zh: 孩子們在花園裡的充氣泳池玩耍。

ex.en: We packed an inflatable mattress for the camping trip.
ex.zh: 我們為露營帶了一張充氣床墊。

ex.en: He was so tired that his speech became incoherent.
ex.zh: 他累到說話變得語無倫次。

ex.en: The essay was incoherent and hard to follow.
ex.zh: 這篇文章前後不連貫，很難看懂。

ex.en: The incessant noise from the street kept me awake.
ex.zh: 街上不停的噪音讓我睡不著。

ex.en: She was tired of his incessant complaints.
ex.zh: 她受夠了他沒完沒了的抱怨。

ex.en: The report was full of innuendo but offered no real facts.
ex.zh: 這篇報導充滿暗諷，卻沒有提供真正的事實。

ex.en: She ignored the innuendo and kept talking about work.
ex.zh: 她不理會那些影射，繼續談工作。

ex.en: The priest intoned the prayer in a low voice.
ex.zh: 神父以低沉的聲音吟誦禱詞。

ex.en: He intoned the names of the winners one by one.
ex.zh: 他一個接一個地以拖長的語調唱出得獎者的名字。

inexplicably.zh: 無法解釋地；莫名其妙地

ex.en: The lights inexplicably went out in the middle of dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐吃到一半，燈莫名其妙地熄了。

ex.en: He was inexplicably angry at me all morning.
ex.zh: 他整個早上都莫名其妙地對我生氣。

ex.en: The club will induct three new members tonight.
ex.zh: 俱樂部今晚將正式接納三位新成員。

ex.en: He was inducted into the hall of fame last year.
ex.zh: 他去年入選了名人堂。

ex.en: Sand is insoluble in water.
ex.zh: 沙子不溶於水。

ex.en: The oil is insoluble, so it floats on top.
ex.zh: 這種油不會溶解，所以浮在上面。

ex.en: They faced an insoluble problem with no clear answer.
ex.zh: 他們面對一個沒有明確答案、無法解決的難題。

ex.en: The conflict seemed insoluble after years of talks.
ex.zh: 談了多年之後，這場衝突似乎無解。

ex.en: The two countries have interdependent economies.
ex.zh: 這兩個國家的經濟是相互依賴的。

ex.en: Plants and insects are interdependent in a garden.
ex.zh: 在花園裡，植物與昆蟲彼此相互依存。

ex.en: He got a ticket for a minor traffic infraction.
ex.zh: 他因為一項輕微的交通違規收到罰單。

ex.en: Any infraction of the rules will be reported.
ex.zh: 任何違反規定的行為都會被通報。

ex.en: It is infuriating to wait an hour for a late bus.
ex.zh: 等一小時的誤點公車真讓人氣憤。

ex.en: His infuriating habit of interrupting drives me crazy.
ex.zh: 他愛打斷別人說話的習慣讓人氣得發瘋。

ex.en: The delay is infuriating the passengers.
ex.zh: 延誤正在激怒乘客。

ex.en: Stop infuriating your sister by hiding her shoes.
ex.zh: 別再藏你姊姊的鞋子惹她生氣了。

insatiable.zh: 無法滿足的；貪得無厭的

ex.en: The boy has an insatiable appetite for books.
ex.zh: 那個男孩對書本有著無法滿足的渴望。

ex.en: Her insatiable curiosity led her to ask many questions.
ex.zh: 她無窮的好奇心讓她問了很多問題。

ex.en: The two words are not always interchangeable.
ex.zh: 這兩個字並不總是可以互換。

ex.en: The parts are interchangeable, so any battery will fit.
ex.zh: 這些零件可以互換，所以任何電池都裝得上。

ex.en: The soup was insufficiently salted.
ex.zh: 這碗湯鹽放得不夠。

ex.en: Many students are insufficiently prepared for the exam.
ex.zh: 許多學生對考試準備得不夠充分。

ex.en: The instructions were clear and intelligible.
ex.zh: 這些說明清楚易懂。

ex.en: His speech was hardly intelligible over the noise.
ex.zh: 在噪音中，他的話幾乎聽不清楚。

ex.en: The doctor noticed incipient signs of the disease.
ex.zh: 醫生發現了疾病初期的徵兆。

ex.en: There was an incipient smile on her face.
ex.zh: 她臉上露出了一絲剛浮現的微笑。

ex.en: The city burns its waste in a large incinerator.
ex.zh: 這座城市在大型焚化爐中燒毀垃圾。

ex.en: Smoke from the incinerator is filtered before it leaves the chimney.
ex.zh: 焚化爐的煙在排出煙囪前會先經過過濾。

ex.en: He has a very individualistic style of dressing.
ex.zh: 他的穿衣風格非常獨特。

ex.en: Some people see the culture as too individualistic and not community-minded.
ex.zh: 有些人認為這種文化太個人主義，缺乏群體意識。

ex.en: The team felt invincible after ten wins in a row.
ex.zh: 連贏十場後，球隊覺得自己所向無敵。

ex.en: Young people sometimes think they are invincible.
ex.zh: 年輕人有時以為自己天下無敵。

ex.en: She studied intensively for two weeks before the exam.
ex.zh: 考前兩週她密集地念書。

ex.en: The farm is used intensively to grow vegetables.
ex.zh: 這座農場被高強度地用來種蔬菜。

ex.en: The meeting will last for an indeterminate period of time.
ex.zh: 這場會議會持續多久還不確定。

ex.en: The test results were indeterminate, so the doctor ordered another one.
ex.zh: 檢查結果不明確，所以醫生又安排了一次檢查。

ex.en: He struggled with a sense of inferiority at his new school.
ex.zh: 他在新學校裡一直為自卑感所苦。

ex.en: The test showed the inferiority of the cheaper material.
ex.zh: 測試顯示這種較便宜的材料品質較差。

ex.en: The ceremony began with an invocation to the gods.
ex.zh: 儀式以向神明的祈禱開始。

ex.en: The poem opens with an invocation of the muse.
ex.zh: 這首詩以對繆思女神的呼求作為開頭。

ex.en: The baby was kept in an incubator for two weeks.
ex.zh: 那名嬰兒在保溫箱裡待了兩週。

ex.en: Farmers put the eggs in an incubator to keep them warm.
ex.zh: 農夫把蛋放進孵化器保持溫暖。

ex.en: The startup joined an incubator that offers free office space.
ex.zh: 這家新創公司加入了一個提供免費辦公空間的孵化器。

ex.en: The university runs an incubator for young entrepreneurs.
ex.zh: 這所大學為年輕創業者設有孵化器。

ex.en: The interrogator asked the suspect the same question again.
ex.zh: 審訊人員又對嫌犯問了同一個問題。

ex.en: An experienced interrogator knows how to stay calm.
ex.zh: 有經驗的審訊人員懂得保持冷靜。

ex.en: We use an insulated bottle to keep drinks cold.
ex.zh: 我們用保冷瓶讓飲料保持冰涼。

ex.en: The wires are insulated with plastic to prevent shocks.
ex.zh: 電線外面包了塑膠絕緣層以防觸電。

intolerant.zh: 不寬容的；容不下異己的

ex.en: He is intolerant of people who disagree with him.
ex.zh: 他容不下跟他意見不同的人。

ex.en: An intolerant attitude makes teamwork difficult.
ex.zh: 不寬容的態度讓團隊合作變得困難。

ex.en: I am lactose intolerant, so I avoid milk.
ex.zh: 我有乳糖不耐症，所以不喝牛奶。

ex.en: She is intolerant to gluten and cannot eat regular bread.
ex.zh: 她對麩質不耐，不能吃一般的麵包。

ex.en: The intrepid explorer crossed the desert alone.
ex.zh: 那位無畏的探險家獨自橫越沙漠。

ex.en: A few intrepid travelers climbed the mountain in winter.
ex.zh: 幾位勇敢的旅人在冬天攀上了那座山。

ex.en: His incapacity to work was caused by a back injury.
ex.zh: 他因為背部受傷而無法工作。

ex.en: The report pointed to the manager's incapacity to make decisions.
