ex.en: His insular views make it hard for him to accept change.
ex.zh: 他眼界狹隘，很難接受改變。

ex.en: In old texts, the word infidel was used for people of another faith.
ex.zh: 在古老文獻裡，infidel 一詞用來指信仰不同的人。

ex.en: The historian explained why the term infidel is now considered offensive.
ex.zh: 歷史學家說明為什麼 infidel 這個詞現在被認為帶有冒犯性。

ex.en: The couple learned that she was infertile.
ex.zh: 這對夫妻得知她無法生育。

ex.en: Doctors can often help infertile couples have children.
ex.zh: 醫生常能協助不孕的夫妻生育孩子。

ex.en: The infertile land could not grow any crops.
ex.zh: 這片貧瘠的土地什麼作物都種不出來。

ex.en: Farmers added compost to the infertile soil.
ex.zh: 農夫在貧瘠的土壤中加入堆肥。

ex.en: Intoxication can make driving extremely dangerous.
ex.zh: 醉酒會讓開車變得極其危險。

ex.en: He was taken to the hospital with alcohol intoxication.
ex.zh: 他因酒精中毒被送往醫院。

ex.en: Ingres was a French painter known for his portraits.
ex.zh: 安格爾是以肖像畫聞名的法國畫家。

ex.en: The museum displays a famous drawing by Ingres.
ex.zh: 博物館展出一幅安格爾的名畫素描。

ex.en: Writing in a diary encourages introspection.
ex.zh: 寫日記能促進自我反省。

ex.en: After a quiet walk, he was in a mood for introspection.
ex.zh: 安靜散步之後，他想要好好內省一下。

ex.en: Her introspection helped her understand why she felt angry.
ex.zh: 她的自我反省幫她了解自己為什麼生氣。

ex.en: The intoxicating smell of fresh flowers filled the room.
ex.zh: 新鮮花朵醉人的香氣瀰漫整個房間。

ex.en: Success can be an intoxicating feeling.
ex.zh: 成功可能是一種令人陶醉的感覺。

ex.en: The music was so intoxicating that everyone started to dance.
ex.zh: 音樂令人如此陶醉，大家都開始跳舞了。

ex.en: Wine is an intoxicating drink and should be enjoyed carefully.
ex.zh: 葡萄酒是會使人喝醉的飲料，應該適量享用。

ex.en: The law bans selling intoxicating liquor to minors.
ex.zh: 法律禁止把會使人醉的酒類賣給未成年人。

ex.en: The evening sky turned a deep shade of indigo.
ex.zh: 傍晚的天空變成深深的靛藍色。

ex.en: Indigo is one of the seven colors of the rainbow.
ex.zh: 靛藍色是彩虹七種顏色之一。

ex.en: The cloth was dyed with natural indigo.
ex.zh: 這塊布是用天然靛藍染的。

ex.en: She wore an indigo dress to the dinner.
ex.zh: 她穿著靛藍色的洋裝去參加晚宴。

ex.en: The indigo ink left a stain on my shirt.
ex.zh: 靛藍色的墨水在我的襯衫上留下汙漬。

ex.en: The video gave indisputable proof of what happened.
ex.zh: 那段影片提供了事發經過的確鑿證據。

ex.en: It is an indisputable fact that the Earth goes around the sun.
ex.zh: 地球繞著太陽轉是無可爭辯的事實。

ex.en: Her talent was indisputable, even to her rivals.
ex.zh: 連她的對手都不得不承認她的才華無可置疑。

ex.en: Constant infighting weakened the political party.
ex.zh: 不斷的內鬨削弱了這個政黨。

ex.en: The team lost the match because of infighting among the players.
ex.zh: 球隊因為球員之間的內鬨而輸掉比賽。

ex.en: Managers tried to stop the infighting in the office.
ex.zh: 主管們試圖停止辦公室裡的內部鬥爭。

ex.en: The innkeeper gave us a warm room and a hot meal.
ex.zh: 旅店老闆給了我們一間溫暖的房間和一頓熱食。

ex.en: Our innkeeper recommended a good restaurant near the lake.
ex.zh: 我們的旅店老闆推薦了湖邊一家不錯的餐廳。

ex.en: The drug has an inhibitory effect on pain signals.
ex.zh: 這種藥物對疼痛訊號有抑制作用。

ex.en: Some rules can have an inhibitory influence on creativity.
ex.zh: 有些規定可能會抑制創意。

ex.en: Nurses will inoculate the children against the flu this week.
ex.zh: 護理師本週會為孩子們接種流感疫苗。

ex.en: Farmers inoculate their cattle to prevent disease.
ex.zh: 農民為牛隻接種疫苗以預防疾病。

ex.en: The school runs a program to improve intergroup relations.
ex.zh: 學校推行一項改善團體之間關係的計畫。

ex.en: The study looked at intergroup differences in test scores.
ex.zh: 這項研究探討了不同群體之間成績的差異。

ex.en: The light came on instantaneously when I touched the switch.
ex.zh: 我一碰開關，燈就立刻亮了。

ex.en: News now travels instantaneously around the world.
ex.zh: 如今消息能瞬間傳遍全世界。

ex.en: Intracellular fluid is found inside the cells of the body.
ex.zh: 細胞內液存在於身體的細胞內部。

ex.en: The virus multiplies in an intracellular environment.
ex.zh: 這種病毒在細胞內的環境中繁殖。

ex.en: Many parents worried about political indoctrination in schools.
ex.zh: 許多家長擔心學校裡的思想灌輸。

ex.en: Good education should encourage thinking, not indoctrination.
ex.zh: 好的教育應該鼓勵思考，而不是灌輸。

indiscriminately.zh: 不分青紅皂白地；隨意地

ex.en: The hunters shot indiscriminately at anything that moved.
ex.zh: 獵人對任何會動的東西亂開槍。

ex.en: Don't click on links indiscriminately, or you might get a virus.
ex.zh: 不要隨意亂點連結，否則可能中毒。

ex.en: Rubber is an insulating material that blocks electricity.
ex.zh: 橡膠是一種能阻隔電流的絕緣材料。

ex.en: We added an insulating layer to keep the house warm.
ex.zh: 我們加了一層隔熱層讓屋子保暖。

ex.en: The inductance of a coil depends on how many turns it has.
ex.zh: 線圈的電感取決於它有幾圈。

ex.en: Engineers measure inductance in henries.
ex.zh: 工程師以亨利為單位測量電感。

ex.en: A cold shower can be invigorating in the morning.
ex.zh: 早晨沖個冷水澡能讓人精神一振。

ex.en: We enjoyed an invigorating walk by the sea.
ex.zh: 我們在海邊享受了一趟令人振奮的散步。

inscrutable.zh: 難以捉摸的、深不可測的

ex.en: Her face was calm and inscrutable.
ex.zh: 她的神情平靜而讓人看不透。

ex.en: The reason for his decision remains inscrutable.
ex.zh: 他做這個決定的原因依然讓人摸不透。

ex.en: Standing under the huge sky, he felt his own insignificance.
ex.zh: 站在遼闊的天空下，他感到自己的渺小。

ex.en: The insignificance of the error meant we didn't need to fix it.
ex.zh: 這個錯誤微不足道，所以我們不必修正。

ex.en: She laughed at the insignificance of their quarrel.
ex.zh: 她笑著說他們吵的事情實在微不足道。

ex.en: The error was inadvertent, and he apologized at once.
ex.zh: 這個錯誤不是故意的，他立刻道了歉。

ex.en: An inadvertent click deleted the whole file.
ex.zh: 一次不小心的點擊刪掉了整個檔案。

ex.en: Parents try to inculcate good habits in their children.
ex.zh: 父母努力在孩子身上灌輸好習慣。

ex.en: The school aims to inculcate respect for others.
ex.zh: 學校的目標是灌輸尊重他人的觀念。

ex.en: The accident was caused by a moment of inattention.
ex.zh: 這起意外是一時的疏忽造成的。

ex.en: His inattention in class worried his teacher.
ex.zh: 他上課不專心讓老師很擔心。

ex.en: The reporter asked an incisive question.
ex.zh: 記者提出了一個一針見血的問題。

ex.en: Her incisive comments helped us fix the plan.
ex.zh: 她犀利的意見幫助我們修正了計畫。

inhospitable.zh: 不適宜居住的；不友善的

ex.en: The desert is an inhospitable place to live.
ex.zh: 沙漠是個不適合居住的地方。

ex.en: The cold, inhospitable staff made us feel unwelcome.
ex.zh: 冷淡不友善的員工讓我們覺得不受歡迎。

ex.en: The view from the mountain is incomparable.
ex.zh: 從山上看出去的景色無與倫比。

ex.en: She has an incomparable talent for music.
ex.zh: 她有無與倫比的音樂天賦。

ex.en: She gave no intimation that she was leaving the company.
ex.zh: 她沒有透露任何要離開公司的跡象。

ex.en: There was an intimation of trouble in his voice.
ex.zh: 他的語氣裡透出一絲麻煩的暗示。

ex.en: He is too indecisive to choose a restaurant.
ex.zh: 他優柔寡斷，連餐廳都選不出來。

ex.en: An indecisive leader can confuse the whole team.
ex.zh: 優柔寡斷的領導者會讓整個團隊無所適從。

ex.en: The election result was indecisive.
ex.zh: 選舉結果沒有明確勝負。

ex.en: After two hours of debate, the meeting was still indecisive.
ex.zh: 辯論了兩小時，會議仍沒有結論。

ex.en: A moment of indiscretion cost him his job.
ex.zh: 一時的輕率言行讓他丟了工作。

ex.en: She forgave her friend's small indiscretion and moved on.
ex.zh: 她原諒了朋友一個小小的失言，不再計較。

ex.en: He gave her a watch inscribed with her initials.
ex.zh: 他送給她一只刻有她姓名縮寫的手錶。

ex.en: The stone was inscribed with a short poem.
ex.zh: 那塊石頭上刻著一首短詩。

ex.en: The interviewer was a patient interlocutor who let her guest finish speaking.
ex.zh: 訪問者是個有耐心的對談者，讓來賓把話說完。

ex.en: In class, we practice with an interlocutor to improve our speaking.
ex.zh: 在課堂上，我們和對話夥伴一起練習以提升口說能力。

inferno.zh: 大火；烈火地獄般的地方

ex.en: Within minutes the old warehouse became a raging inferno.
ex.zh: 短短幾分鐘內，那座舊倉庫就變成一片熊熊烈火。

ex.en: The kitchen was an inferno on the busiest night of the year.
ex.zh: 在一年中最忙的那個晚上，廚房熱得像地獄。

ex.en: The fight started at the instigation of a few older boys.
ex.zh: 這場打鬥是在幾個大男孩的煽動下開始的。

ex.en: She did it at her brother's instigation.
ex.zh: 她是在哥哥的唆使下做這件事的。

ex.en: Companies must innovate to stay ahead of their competitors.
ex.zh: 公司必須創新才能領先競爭對手。

ex.en: Young engineers love to innovate and try new ideas.
ex.zh: 年輕的工程師喜歡創新、嘗試新點子。

ex.en: She agreed to intercede with the boss on his behalf.
ex.zh: 她答應代他向老闆說情。

ex.en: The teacher had to intercede when the argument got heated.
ex.zh: 爭吵變得激烈時，老師必須出面調解。

ex.en: This phone has an inbuilt speaker and microphone.
ex.zh: 這支手機有內建的喇叭和麥克風。

ex.en: Children seem to have an inbuilt sense of fairness.
ex.zh: 孩子似乎天生就有公平的觀念。

ex.en: The evidence against him was insubstantial.
ex.zh: 對他不利的證據缺乏實質內容。

ex.en: The insubstantial walls shook in the wind.
ex.zh: 那些不牢固的牆在風中搖晃。

ex.en: My infirm grandfather needs help to climb the stairs.
ex.zh: 我體弱的爺爺爬樓梯需要人幫忙。

ex.en: The nurse cares for elderly and infirm patients.
ex.zh: 這位護理師照顧年長體弱的病人。

ex.en: The storm intensified overnight.
ex.zh: 暴風雨在夜裡變得更強了。

ex.en: The company intensified its efforts to fix the problem.
ex.zh: 公司加強了解決問題的努力。

ex.en: The company claims the phone case is indestructible.
ex.zh: 公司宣稱這款手機殼堅不可摧。

ex.en: Children often feel indestructible.
ex.zh: 孩子常覺得自己無堅不摧。

ex.en: The preacher spoke against iniquity in society.
ex.zh: 傳教士抨擊社會中的不公與邪惡。

ex.en: They fought the iniquity of the old law.
ex.zh: 他們對抗那條舊法律的不公義。

ex.en: Fans were incensed by the referee's decision.
ex.zh: 球迷對裁判的判決感到憤怒。

ex.en: She was incensed that no one had told her.
ex.zh: 沒人告訴她這件事，讓她火冒三丈。

ex.en: The flood caused incalculable damage to the town.
ex.zh: 洪水對小鎮造成了難以估算的損失。

ex.en: Her kindness was of incalculable value to us.
ex.zh: 她的善意對我們來說價值無法估量。

ex.en: A bad back can incapacitate a worker for weeks.
ex.zh: 嚴重的背痛可能讓工人好幾週無法工作。

ex.en: The illness incapacitated him for most of the winter.
ex.zh: 那場病讓他大半個冬天都無法行動。

ex.en: The talks failed because of the leader's intransigence.
ex.zh: 談判因為領導人不肯讓步而失敗。

ex.en: Their intransigence made a deal impossible.
ex.zh: 他們的強硬態度讓達成協議變得不可能。

ex.en: His behavior was simply indefensible.
ex.zh: 他的行為簡直無法辯解。

ex.en: The team's indefensible mistake cost them the game.
ex.zh: 球隊那個無可辯解的失誤讓他們輸了比賽。

ex.en: Indiana is a state in the Midwest of the United States.
ex.zh: 印第安納州是美國中西部的一個州。

ex.en: The city of Indianapolis is the capital of Indiana.
ex.zh: 印第安納波利斯市是印第安納州的首府。

ex.en: The infantryman carried a heavy pack across the field.
ex.zh: 那位步兵背著沉重的背包穿越田野。

ex.en: Every infantryman must learn to march long distances.
ex.zh: 每位步兵都必須學會長途行軍。

ex.en: The factory has to incinerate its waste.
ex.zh: 這間工廠必須焚化廢棄物。

ex.en: They incinerated the old documents.
ex.zh: 他們把舊文件燒成灰。

ex.en: The two stories are interwoven throughout the novel.
ex.zh: 這兩個故事在整本小說中交織在一起。

ex.en: Gold threads were interwoven with the silk.
ex.zh: 金線與絲綢交織在一起。

ex.en: Cables interconnect the computers in the office.
ex.zh: 纜線把辦公室裡的電腦互相連接起來。

ex.en: The new roads interconnect the small towns.
ex.zh: 新道路把這些小鎮彼此連結起來。

ex.en: She invited all her classmates to her birthday party.
ex.zh: 她邀請了所有同學來參加她的生日派對。

ex.en: We were invited to dinner at our neighbor's house.
ex.zh: 我們受邀到鄰居家吃晚餐。

ex.en: Breakfast is included in the price of the room.
ex.zh: 房價已包含早餐。

ex.en: Tax is not included, so you will pay a bit more.
ex.zh: 價格不含稅，所以你要多付一點。

ex.en: Keeping animals in tiny cages is inhumane.
ex.zh: 把動物關在狹小的籠子裡是不人道的。

ex.en: The prisoners complained about the inhumane conditions.
ex.zh: 囚犯抱怨牢房的待遇不人道。

ex.en: The butcher removed the innards of the fish.
ex.zh: 魚販把魚的內臟取出。

ex.en: He opened the clock to look at its innards.
ex.zh: 他打開時鐘，看看裡面的構造。

ex.en: I like the informality of our weekly team meetings.
ex.zh: 我喜歡我們每週團隊會議的隨性氣氛。

ex.en: The informality of the party made everyone feel relaxed.
ex.zh: 派對的隨興氣氛讓每個人都很放鬆。

ex.en: The school offers a course in intercultural communication.
ex.zh: 學校開了一門跨文化溝通的課。

ex.en: Living abroad gave her a lot of intercultural experience.
ex.zh: 旅居國外讓她累積了許多跨文化的經驗。

ex.en: The government announced the interdiction of illegal fishing in the bay.
ex.zh: 政府宣布禁止在海灣非法捕魚。

ex.en: The navy focused on the interdiction of drug shipments.
ex.zh: 海軍把重點放在攔截毒品運輸。

ex.en: The cost of the repair was not inconsiderable.
ex.zh: 修理的費用可不是小數目。

ex.en: He left behind an inconsiderable sum of money.
ex.zh: 他留下的是微不足道的一點錢。

ex.en: The world's economies are deeply interconnected.
ex.zh: 世界各國的經濟緊密相連。

ex.en: These interconnected rooms make the house feel open.
ex.zh: 這些相通的房間讓整間屋子感覺很開闊。

ex.en: Loud noise is inimical to good sleep.
ex.zh: 大噪音對好眠是有害的。

ex.en: The new rules are inimical to small businesses.
ex.zh: 新規定對小型企業不利。

ex.en: She is kindness incarnate.
ex.zh: 她根本是善良的化身。

ex.en: He was greed incarnate in that business deal.
ex.zh: 在那筆交易中，他是貪婪的化身。

ex.en: She interposed herself between the two angry men.
ex.zh: 她擋在兩個憤怒的男人中間。

ex.en: "That's not true," he interposed.
ex.zh: 「那不是真的，」他插嘴說。

ex.en: The phone rang insistently all morning.
ex.zh: 電話整個早上響個不停。

ex.en: She asked insistently to see the manager.
ex.zh: 她堅持要求見經理。

individualize.zh: 使個別化；賦予個人特色

ex.en: Teachers try to individualize lessons for each student.
ex.zh: 老師們試著為每位學生量身調整課程。

ex.en: She added a scarf to individualize her uniform.
ex.zh: 她加了一條圍巾，讓制服有點個人特色。

ex.en: There was an odd incongruity between his words and his smile.
ex.zh: 他的話語和笑容之間有種奇怪的不協調。

ex.en: The incongruity of a pink car in the old village made us laugh.
ex.zh: 古老村莊裡出現一輛粉紅色汽車，這種格格不入讓我們笑了。

inalienable.zh: 不可剝奪的；不可轉讓的

ex.en: Freedom of speech is an inalienable right.
ex.zh: 言論自由是不可剝奪的權利。

ex.en: The document lists the inalienable rights of every citizen.
ex.zh: 這份文件列出每位公民不可剝奪的權利。

ex.en: Scientists are planning an interplanetary mission to Mars.
ex.zh: 科學家正在規劃前往火星的行星際任務。

ex.en: Interplanetary travel would take many months.
ex.zh: 行星際旅行得花上好幾個月。

ex.en: The speed of the trip is inversely related to the time it takes.
ex.zh: 旅程的速度與所需時間成反比。

ex.en: Prices rose, and inversely, demand fell.
ex.zh: 價格上漲，相反地，需求下降了。

ex.en: The children showed great inventiveness in building their fort.
ex.zh: 孩子們在搭建他們的小堡壘時展現出很強的創造力。

ex.en: Her inventiveness helped the team solve the problem quickly.
ex.zh: 她的創意幫助團隊很快解決了問題。

inimitable.zh: 無法模仿的；獨一無二的

ex.en: The singer has an inimitable voice that everyone recognizes.
ex.zh: 這位歌手有獨特到無法模仿的嗓音，大家一聽就認得。

ex.en: He told the story in his own inimitable style.
ex.zh: 他用自己獨一無二的風格說了這個故事。

ex.en: Small boats fish in the inshore waters near the harbor.
ex.zh: 小船在靠近港口的近岸海域捕魚。

ex.en: An inshore wind pushed the waves toward the beach.
ex.zh: 吹向陸地的風把浪推向海灘。

ex.en: The fishing boats sailed inshore before the storm.
ex.zh: 漁船在暴風雨前駛向岸邊。

ex.en: Dolphins sometimes swim inshore in the morning.
ex.zh: 海豚有時早上會游到靠近海岸的地方。

ex.en: The children seemed to have an inexhaustible supply of energy.
ex.zh: 孩子們的精力似乎用不完。

ex.en: Don't treat the ocean as an inexhaustible source of fish.
ex.zh: 不要把海洋當成取之不盡的魚源。

ex.en: The insolent boy laughed at his teacher.
ex.zh: 那個無禮的男孩嘲笑他的老師。

ex.en: She gave him an insolent stare and walked away.
ex.zh: 她傲慢地瞪了他一眼就走開了。

ex.en: Throwing a tantrum over a game is infantile.
ex.zh: 為了一場遊戲鬧脾氣真是幼稚。

ex.en: I'm tired of his infantile jokes.
ex.zh: 我受夠了他那些幼稚的笑話。

ex.en: The clinic treats infantile illnesses such as ear infections.
ex.zh: 這家診所治療耳朵感染等嬰幼兒疾病。

ex.en: Researchers study infantile development in the first year of life.
ex.zh: 研究人員研究嬰兒出生第一年的發展。

intertwined.zh: 交織；纏繞在一起（intertwine 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The two vines intertwined as they climbed the fence.
ex.zh: 兩條藤蔓爬上圍籬時纏繞在一起。

ex.en: Their lives have been intertwined since childhood.
ex.zh: 他們的人生從小時候起就緊緊交織在一起。

ex.en: The view from the mountain was indescribable.
ex.zh: 山上的景色美得難以形容。

ex.en: She felt an indescribable joy when she held her baby.
ex.zh: 她抱著寶寶時感到一股難以形容的喜悅。

ex.en: He stared at the map in complete incomprehension.
ex.zh: 他完全看不懂地盯著那張地圖。

ex.en: Her face showed incomprehension when he spoke fast.
ex.zh: 他說得很快時，她臉上露出聽不懂的神情。

ex.en: The dog barked at the interloper in the yard.
ex.zh: 狗對著院子裡的闖入者吠叫。

ex.en: She felt like an interloper at the family dinner.
ex.zh: 她在家庭聚餐上覺得自己像個外人。

ex.en: Her morning routine is almost invariable.
ex.zh: 她早上的作息幾乎一成不變。

ex.en: The recipe calls for an invariable amount of salt.
ex.zh: 這個食譜要求的鹽量是固定不變的。

ex.en: The wizard whispered an incantation over the potion.
ex.zh: 巫師對著藥水低聲念了咒語。

ex.en: The children learned a funny incantation for the game.
ex.zh: 孩子們為遊戲學了一句好玩的咒語。

ex.en: Inductive reasoning moves from examples to general rules.
ex.zh: 歸納推理是從例子推出一般規則。

ex.en: The teacher used an inductive approach to explain grammar.
ex.zh: 老師用歸納法來解釋文法。

ex.en: He sat in an inconspicuous corner of the room.
ex.zh: 他坐在房間裡不顯眼的角落。

ex.en: The camera is small and inconspicuous.
ex.zh: 這台相機小巧而不引人注意。

ex.en: She won first place at the invitational tournament last spring.
ex.zh: 她在去年春天的邀請賽中拿下第一名。

ex.en: It's an invitational event, so only selected artists can join.
ex.zh: 這是邀請制的活動，只有受邀的藝術家能參加。

ex.en: The sky was inky black, and we could not see any stars.
ex.zh: 天空漆黑一片，我們看不到任何星星。

ex.en: He walked home through the inky darkness with only a small flashlight.
ex.zh: 他只靠一支小手電筒，在漆黑中走路回家。

ex.en: The student's fingers were inky after writing with a leaky pen.
ex.zh: 那名學生用漏水的鋼筆寫字後，手指沾滿了墨水。

ex.en: She wiped her inky hands on a paper towel.
ex.zh: 她用紙巾擦掉手上的墨漬。

ex.en: A cold shower can invigorate you on a sleepy morning.
ex.zh: 在昏昏欲睡的早晨沖個冷水澡能讓你精神一振。

ex.en: The fresh mountain air will invigorate the whole family.
ex.zh: 清新的山間空氣會讓全家人精神煥發。

ex.en: The new coach hopes to invigorate the team before the final.
ex.zh: 新教練希望在決賽前替球隊注入活力。

interacting.zh: 互動；相互作用（interact 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The children are interacting well with the new teacher.
ex.zh: 孩子們和新老師互動得很好。

ex.en: Scientists study how the two chemicals are interacting inside the cell.
ex.zh: 科學家研究這兩種化學物質在細胞內如何相互作用。

ex.en: I enjoy interacting with people from different countries.
ex.zh: 我喜歡和來自不同國家的人交流。

ex.en: Politeness is deeply ingrained in their culture.
ex.zh: 禮貌在他們的文化中根深蒂固。

ex.en: It is hard to change habits that are so ingrained.
ex.zh: 要改掉這麼根深蒂固的習慣很難。

ex.en: There was ingrained dirt on the old kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 舊廚房的地板上有滲進去洗不掉的汙垢。

indefatigable.zh: 不知疲倦的；不屈不撓的

ex.en: The indefatigable nurse worked through the whole night.
ex.zh: 那位不知疲倦的護理師整夜工作。

ex.en: He was an indefatigable traveler who visited every continent.
ex.zh: 他是個精力充沛的旅行者，走遍了每一個洲。

ex.en: Old age brings infirmity to many people.
ex.zh: 年老讓許多人變得體弱多病。

ex.en: Despite his infirmity, he walked to the market every day.
ex.zh: 儘管身體虛弱，他每天仍走路去市場。

ex.en: The museum has a collection of Inuit art.
ex.zh: 博物館收藏了因紐特人的藝術品。

ex.en: Inuit communities live in the cold Arctic regions.
ex.zh: 因紐特人的社群住在寒冷的北極地區。

ex.en: The crowd shouted invective at the referee.
ex.zh: 群眾對裁判大聲辱罵。

ex.en: His speech was full of invective against his rivals.
ex.zh: 他的演說充滿對對手的謾罵。

ex.en: His ineptitude at cooking led to a burnt dinner.
ex.zh: 他不擅烹飪，結果晚餐燒焦了。

ex.en: The report criticized the manager's ineptitude.
ex.zh: 報告批評了經理的無能。

ex.en: She showed an indomitable spirit throughout her illness.
ex.zh: 她在病中展現出不屈不撓的精神。

ex.en: The team's indomitable will helped them win the match.
ex.zh: 球隊不屈不撓的意志幫助他們贏得比賽。

inarticulate.zh: 口齒不清的；表達不出的

ex.en: He was so nervous that he became inarticulate.
ex.zh: 他緊張到說不清楚話。

ex.en: She felt inarticulate with anger and could only shake her head.
ex.zh: 她氣得說不出話來，只能搖頭。

ex.en: Police said he was the instigator of the fight.
ex.zh: 警方說他是那場打鬥的始作俑者。

ex.en: Who was the instigator of this argument?
ex.zh: 是誰挑起這場爭吵的？

ex.en: The soup was cold and insipid.
ex.zh: 那碗湯又冷又淡而無味。

ex.en: I found the movie insipid and left early.
ex.zh: 我覺得那部電影乏味，提早離場了。

ex.en: The infielder caught the ball and threw it to first base.
ex.zh: 內野手接住球並傳向一壘。

ex.en: Our team needs a fast infielder this season.
ex.zh: 我們隊本季需要一位速度快的內野手。

ex.en: The language barrier proved an insuperable problem.
ex.zh: 語言障礙成了無法克服的問題。

ex.en: They faced what seemed like insuperable difficulties.
ex.zh: 他們面對著似乎無法克服的困難。

ex.en: The company improved its product incrementally over the years.
ex.zh: 公司這些年來逐步改進產品。

ex.en: Prices rose incrementally rather than all at once.
ex.zh: 價格是逐步上漲，而不是一次漲完。

ex.en: The air force sent an interceptor to meet the unknown plane.
ex.zh: 空軍派出了一架攔截機去攔下不明飛機。

ex.en: The interceptor caught the ball and ran down the field.
ex.zh: 那位攔截者抓住球並沿著球場跑去。

ex.en: The song has a long guitar intro.
ex.zh: 這首歌有一段很長的吉他前奏。

ex.en: Please give a short intro of yourself to the class.
ex.zh: 請向全班簡短地自我介紹一下。

ex.en: The film was criticized for its indecency.
ex.zh: 這部電影因其猥褻內容而受到批評。

ex.en: He was fined for public indecency.
ex.zh: 他因公然有傷風化而被罰款。

ex.en: He was too inhibited to dance in front of others.
ex.zh: 他太拘謹，不敢在別人面前跳舞。

ex.en: Wine made the shy guests feel less inhibited.
ex.zh: 酒讓害羞的客人放鬆了些。

inhibited.zh: 抑制；阻礙（inhibit 的過去式、過去分詞）

ex.en: The drug inhibited the growth of the bacteria.
ex.zh: 這種藥物抑制了細菌的生長。

ex.en: Fear inhibited her from speaking up in class.
ex.zh: 恐懼讓她不敢在課堂上發言。

institutionalised.zh: 使制度化（institutionalise 的過去式、過去分詞）

ex.en: The company institutionalised weekly feedback sessions.
ex.zh: 公司將每週的意見回饋會議制度化了。

ex.en: These habits were institutionalised over many years.
ex.zh: 這些習慣是經過多年才變成制度的。

ex.en: Discrimination can become institutionalised in old systems.
ex.zh: 在舊體制中，歧視可能變成制度化的問題。

ex.en: It is an institutionalised practice in many schools.
ex.zh: 這在許多學校是一種制度化的做法。

ex.en: The school wants to institutionalise the new reading program.
ex.zh: 學校想把新的閱讀計畫制度化。

ex.en: It takes time to institutionalise a new habit in a large company.
ex.zh: 在大公司裡，要把新習慣制度化需要時間。

ex.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
ex.zh: 帶把傘，以防下雨。

ex.en: I wrote down her number in case I lose my phone.
ex.zh: 我把她的號碼寫下來，以防手機弄丟。

ex.en: Keep some cash with you in case of an emergency.
ex.zh: 身上留一些現金，以防緊急狀況。

in case.en: used to say that something is done because something bad might happen

ex.en: I thought the test would be hard; in fact, it was easy.
ex.zh: 我以為考試會很難，事實上很簡單。

ex.en: He looks serious, but in fact he is very friendly.
ex.zh: 他看起來很嚴肅，其實非常友善。

in fact.en: used to add a fact that supports or stresses what was just said

ex.en: I don't mind at all; in fact, I'd love to help.
ex.zh: 我一點都不介意，說真的，我很樂意幫忙。

ex.en: The roads were not dangerous; in fact, they were almost empty.
ex.zh: 路況並不危險，實際上幾乎沒什麼車。

in fact.en: used to say what is really true, often against what people think

ex.en: We got to the station in time to catch the train.
ex.zh: 我們及時趕到車站搭上了火車。

ex.en: The ambulance arrived in time to save him.
ex.zh: 救護車及時趕到救了他。

in time.en: early enough to do something before it is too late

ex.en: In time, you will forget about this problem.
ex.zh: 時間一久，你會忘記這個問題的。

ex.en: The pain will fade in time.
ex.zh: 疼痛遲早會消退的。

in time.en: used to say that something will happen after a long period of time

ex.en: Who is in charge of the marketing team now?
ex.zh: 現在是誰負責行銷團隊？

ex.en: She was put in charge of organizing the school trip.
ex.zh: 她被指派負責籌劃校外教學。

ex.en: I'm in charge of the kitchen while the chef is away.
ex.zh: 主廚不在時，由我負責管理廚房。

in charge of.en: looking after something or someone, or having control of it

ex.en: She woke up early in order to catch the first train.
ex.zh: 她為了趕上第一班火車而早起。

ex.en: We saved money in order to buy a bigger apartment.
ex.zh: 我們為了買更大的公寓而存錢。

ex.en: In order to pass the exam, you need to review every day.
ex.zh: 為了通過考試，你必須每天複習。

in order to.en: used to show the reason or purpose for doing something

ex.en: Please book your tickets in advance to get a better price.
ex.zh: 請預先訂票才有比較好的價格。

ex.en: Thank you in advance for your help with the project.
ex.zh: 先謝謝你對這個專案的幫忙。

ex.en: We told the teacher in advance that we would be late.
ex.zh: 我們事先告訴老師我們會遲到。

in advance.en: before something happens or is needed

ex.en: In general, people in this city go to bed quite late.
ex.zh: 一般來說，這座城市的人睡得相當晚。

ex.en: The movie was good in general, but the ending was weak.
ex.zh: 這部電影大致上不錯，只是結局很弱。

ex.en: Students in general prefer short tests to long essays.
ex.zh: 學生大致上比較喜歡短測驗而不是長篇報告。

ex.en: I like fruit, mangoes in particular.
ex.zh: 我喜歡水果，特別是芒果。

ex.en: Is there anything in particular you want for dinner?
ex.zh: 晚餐你有什麼特別想吃的嗎？

ex.en: The teacher praised one student in particular for her effort.
ex.zh: 老師特別稱讚其中一位學生的努力。

ex.en: In addition, the hotel offers free breakfast to all guests.
ex.zh: 另外，這間旅館提供所有住客免費早餐。

ex.en: The job pays well, and in addition, the hours are flexible.
ex.zh: 這份工作薪水不錯，另外上班時間也很彈性。

ex.en: In addition to English, she speaks Japanese and French.
ex.zh: 除了英文，她還會說日文和法文。

in addition.en: also, used to add another point

ex.en: A tall man was standing in front of me in line.
ex.zh: 一位高個子男士排在我前面。

ex.en: The children played in front of the school after class.
ex.zh: 孩子們放學後在學校前面玩耍。

ex.en: Please don't park your car in front of my gate.
ex.zh: 請不要把車停在我家大門前面。

in front of.en: at the place directly before someone or something

ex.en: In spite of the rain, we had a great picnic.
ex.zh: 儘管下雨，我們還是野餐得很開心。

ex.en: He went to work in spite of his bad cold.
ex.zh: 儘管重感冒，他還是去上班了。

ex.en: In spite of her fear, she walked onto the stage.
ex.zh: 儘管害怕，她還是走上了舞台。

ex.en: In terms of price, this phone is a good choice.
ex.zh: 就價格而言，這支手機是不錯的選擇。

ex.en: The two cities are very different in terms of weather.
ex.zh: 這兩座城市在天氣方面差很多。

ex.en: We should think about the plan in terms of time and cost.
ex.zh: 我們應該從時間和成本方面來思考這個計畫。

in terms of.en: relating to a particular part of a subject

ex.en: I drank tea instead of coffee this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上喝了茶而不是咖啡。

ex.en: Let's walk instead of taking the bus today.
ex.zh: 我們今天走路吧，不要搭公車。

ex.en: Instead of watching TV, he decided to read a book.
ex.zh: 他決定看書，而不是看電視。

instead of.en: in place of someone or something else
